- **Yechim:** Oraliq fayllar (`.srt`, `.mp3`, `transcript.json`) mavjudligini tekshirish va agar fayl to'liq generatsiya bo'lgan bo'lsa, o'sha bosqichni o'tkazib yuborish (caching/checkpointing).

---

## 5. 🟡 O'RTA DARAJADAGI MANTIQIY VA FOYDALANUVCHI TAJRIBASI XATOLARI

### M-01: TTS Xato Bo'lganda Gaplarni Tashlab Ketishi (Silent Audio Drop)
- **Fayl:** `subtitr-bot/worker/tts.py`, `_synthesize_mp3` funksiyasi.
- **Kod:**
  ```python
  ok = [p for p in parts if p]
  final_audio = b"".join(ok)
  ```
- **Tahlil:** Agar Edge-TTS yoki ichki TTS provayderi videodagi 100 ta gapdan 5 tasida tarmoq xatosi tufayli `b""` (bo'sh bayt) qaytarsa, dastur hech qanday ogohlantirish bermaydi va faqat qolgan 95 ta qismni birlashtiradi.
- **Oqibati:** Ovozli videoda qahramon gapirayotganda ba'zi gaplar to'satdan jim bo'lib qoladi, subtitr bilan ovoz sinxronligi butunlay buziladi (audio desync). Foydalanuvchi esa nima uchun gaplar tushib qolganini tushunmaydi.
- **Yechim:** Agar biror bo'lak xato bersa, kamida 3 marta qayta urinish (retry with exponential backoff) va baribir o'xshamasa, foydalanuvchiga aniq xato haqida xabar berish. Shuningdek, bo'sh bo'lak o'rniga o'sha gapning davomiyligiga teng sukunat (silent mp3 padding) qo'yish kerak.

---

### M-02: Marketing va Cheklov Xabarlaridagi Tafovut (30 min vs 45 min)
- **Fayllar:** 
  - `subtitr-bot/access.py:48`
  - `subtitr-bot/tariffs.py`
- **Tahlil:**
  Foydalanuvchi 5 daqiqadan ortiq video yuklaganda bot quyidagicha xabar beradi:
  > *"BASIC obuna bilan 45 daqiqalik video ham bo'ladi!"*
  Biroq `tariffs.py` konfiguratsiyasida `basic` tarifi uchun maksimal davomiylik qat'iy **`max_minutes = 30`** qilib belgilangan!
- **Oqibati:** Foydalanuvchi 45 daqiqalik videosi borligi uchun pul to'lab "BASIC" tarifini sotib oladi, so'ngra videoni tashlaganida bot *"Video hajmi 30 daqiqadan oshmasligi kerak"* degan rad javobini beradi. Bu to'g'ridan-to'g'ri yolg'on reklama (false advertising) va obunani qaytarish talablariga sabab bo'ladi.
- **Yechim:** `access.py`dagi matnni `tariffs.py`dagi haqiqiy qiymat bilan dinamik sinxronlash:
  ```python
  from tariffs import PLANS
  basic_limit = PLANS.get("basic", {}).get("max_minutes", 30)
  msg = f"BASIC obuna bilan {basic_limit} daqiqalik video ham bo'ladi!"
  ```

---

### M-03: `publish_input` Sababli Server Diski To'lib Qolishi
- **Fayl:** `subtitr-bot/web/server.py`, `publish_input` funksiyasi.
- **Tahlil:** Har bir kiruvchi video fayl qayta ishlash uchun qabul qilinganda, u avtomatik tarzda `downloads/` statik katalogiga to'liq nusxalanadi va uning saqlanish muddati (TTL) 6 soat qilib qo'yilgan.
- **Oqibati:** 
  Oracle Cloud serverida jami disk hajmi 30 GB bo'lib, operatsion tizim va Docker konteynerlaridan keyin atigi 12-15 GB bo'sh joy qoladi. Agar foydalanuvchilar 500 MB dan 15 ta video yuklasa, disk 100% to'ladi. Natijada PostgreSQL tranzaksiyalarni to'xtatadi (`PANIC: could not write to log file: No space left on device`), bot to'liq muzlab qoladi.
- **Yechim:** Fayllarni nusxalamasdan, operatsion tizim darajasidagi qattiq havola (hardlink) yoki ramziy havola (symlink) ishlatish, va TTL vaqtini 1-2 soatga tushirish hamda disk hajmi 85% dan oshganda avtomatik eng eski fayllarni tozalash (garbage collection).

---

### M-04: Admin Monitoringida Event Loop'ni Bloklovchi `time.sleep(0.15)`
- **Fayl:** `subtitr-bot/web/admin_control.py`, 34-qator (`_cpu_percent` funksiyasi).
- **Kod:**
  ```python
  def _cpu_percent():
      # ...
      time.sleep(0.15)  # <--- Asinxron event loop ichida sinxron sleep!
  ```
- **Tahlil:** `aiohttp` to'liq asinxron arxitekturada ishlaydi. Uning ichida sinxron `time.sleep` chaqirilganda, butun Python asinxron hodisalar zanjiri (Event Loop) 150 millisekundga to'liq qotib qoladi.
- **Oqibati:** Admin panel ochilganda yoki monitoring ma'lumotlari yangilanganda, Telegram botdan xabar kutayotgan yoki to'lov qilayotgan barcha boshqa foydalanuvchilarning so'rovlari ushlanib qoladi.
- **Yechim:** `asyncio.sleep(0.15)` ishlatish yoki `psutil.cpu_percent(interval=None)` (blokirovkasiz) chaqiruviga o'tish.

---

### M-05: Desktop Subtitr Tahrirlagichida Asl Matnni O'zgartirib Bo'lmasligi
- **Fayl:** `subtitr-desktop/subtitr_app/lib/screens/translation_editor_screen.dart`
- **Tahlil:**
  Dasturning subtitr tahrirlash ekranida faqat tarjima matni uchun `TextEditingController` o'rnatilgan. Asl (original) subtitr matni esa oddiy `Text` vidjetida chiqarilgan bo'lib, uni tahrirlash imkoniyati yo'q.
- **Oqibati:** Whisper ovozni matnga aylantirganda xato qilsa (masalan, ismlar yoki texnik atamalarni noto'g'ri eshitsa), foydalanuvchi uni to'g'rilay olmaydi. Agar foydalanuvchi "original" yoki "dual" rejimida video chiqarmoqchi bo'lsa, Whisper'ning barcha xatolari videoda qolib ketadi.
- **Yechim:** Asl matn uchun ham tahrirlanadigan `TextFormField` kiritish va o'zgarishlarni JSON-RPC orqali Python backendga qaytarish.

---

### M-06: Home Relay Oflayn Bo'lganda Server Fallback Ishlamasligi
- **Fayl:** `subtitr-bot/bot/handlers/video.py`, 695-qator.
- **Tahlil:**
  Koddagi izohda: *"Agar uy kompyuteri (Home Relay) oflayn bo'lsa, avtomatik ravishda server orqali yuklab olinadi"* deb yozilgan.
  Biroq haqiqiy kodda:
  ```python
  if not is_relay_online():
      raise RuntimeError("Home relay offline!")
  ```
- **Oqibati:** Uy kompyuteri internetdan uzilishi bilan YouTube yoki Instagram videolarini yuklab olish darhol qulaydi, serverning o'zida yt-dlp bo'lsa ham undan foydalanilmaydi.
- **Yechim:** `RuntimeError` ko'tarish o'rniga, serverning o'zidagi mahalliy `download_video_local(url)` funksiyasiga fallback qilish.

---

### M-07: Dublikat va Eskirgan Fayllar Qoldiqlarining Saqlanishi
- **Fayllar:**
  - `subtitr-bot/miniapp.py` (ildiz papkada tashlab ketilgan, haqiqiy kod esa `web/miniapp.py`da).
  - `subtitr-bot/bot/bot/` (butun boshli eski bot katalogi dublikat sifatida turibdi).
- **Tahlil:** Yangi ishlab chiquvchilar yoki IDE qidiruvlari ushbu eskirgan fayllarni topadi va ularga o'zgartirish kiritishi mumkin. Bu katta tushunmovchiliklar va xatolarga yo'l ochadi.
- **Yechim:** Git orqali ushbu o'lik fayllarni butunlay o'chirish.

---

### M-08: Click Bridge PHP'da Xato Qaytarish va Xavfsizlik Kamchiliklari
- **Fayl:** `/home/shamsiddin/Downloads/Click/Soqqa/mustaqilish1bot/subtitr_bridge.php`
- **Tahlil:**
  1. `curl_exec` xato berganida HTTP 200 qaytarib, ichida to'liq bo'lmagan JSON chiqaradi. Click tizimi esa buni muvaffaqiyatli deb hisoblab yuborishi mumkin.
  2. Secret Key tekshiruvi doimiy vaqtli taqqoslash (`hash_equals`) o'rniga oddiy `==` bilan qilingan, bu esa timing attack zaifligiga yo'l qo'yadi.
- **Yechim:** `hash_equals` ishlatish va curl xatolarida Click protokoli bo'yicha aniq xato kodini (`error: -8`) qaytarish.

---

## 6. 💻 SUBTITR-DESKTOP BO'YICHA MAXSUS TAHLILI

### 6.1 Flutter UI va State Management
- **Holat:** `Provider` paketidan foydalanilgan, umumiy arxitektura toza va qismlarga ajratilgan.
- **Kamchiliklar:**
  1. **Video Player boshqaruvi:** Katta hajmli 4K videolarni ochganda `video_player` vidjeti Linux'da keshni tozalashda kechikadi. Bir nechta videoni ketma-ket yuklaganda RAM 1.5 GB dan oshadi.
  2. **Error Dialoglar:** Python backenddan kelgan xatoliklar foydalanuvchiga faqat bitta umumiy "Jarayonda xatolik" deb ko'rsatiladi. Foydalanuvchiga API kaliti noto'g'riligi yoki disk to'lganligi haqida tushunarli xabar berilmaydi.

### 6.2 Python Engine (`desktop_processor.py`)
- **Holat:** 3,452 qatorli monolit bitta fayl.
- **Kamchiliklar:**
  1. **Monolit struktura:** Bitta fayl ichida Whisper, AI tarjimonlar, FFmpeg buyruqlari, Edge-TTS, IPC aloqasi va yordamchi utilitlar aralashib ketgan. Kodni testlash va kengaytirish o'ta murakkab.
  2. **FFmpeg Path Discovery:** Tizimda o'rnatilgan FFmpeg yo'lini aniqlashda Windows'da qattiq bog'langan yo'llar (`C:\ffmpeg\bin`) tekshiriladi. Agar foydalanuvchi boshqa joyga o'rnatgan bo'lsa, dastur topolmay xato beradi.

---

## 7. 🤖 TELEGRAM BOT, CELERY VA BACKEND MAXSUS TAHLILI

### 7.1 Aiogram 3.x va Asinxronlik
- Bot arxitekturasi zamonaviy FSM (Finite State Machine) va Routerlar asosida qurilgan.
- Biroq, ayrim handlerlarda diskka yozish amallari (`open(..., 'wb')`) to'g'ridan-to'g'ri asinxron oqimda bajarilgan. Buni `aiofiles` orqali qilish lozim.

### 7.2 Celery Worker va Redis
- Celery sozlamalarida `task_acks_late = True` qilingan. Bu to'g'ri, lekin xatolik yuz berganda `max_retries` belgilanmagani sababli buzilgan video fayllar cheksiz ravishda qayta ishlanib serverni band qilib qo'yishi mumkin.
- Redis xotira limiti (`maxmemory`) belgilanmagan, bu esa kesh to'lib ketishiga olib kelishi mumkin.

---

## 8. 🚀 AMALIY TUZATISH VA MODERNIZATSIYA REJASI (ACTIONABLE ROADMAP)

Ushbu kamchiliklarni bartaraf etish uchun ishlarni 3 ta ketma-ket bosqichda amalga oshirish tavsiya etiladi:

### 1-bosqich: Shoshilinch Kritik Tuzatishlar (Hotfixes — 1-2 kun)
1. **Sintaksis xatosini yo'qotish:** `bot/bot/handlers/subscribe.py:76` dagi `from __future__` qatorini tozalash va `bot/bot/` katalogini o'chirish.
2. **Groq'ni tarjima zanjiriga qaytarish:** `worker/aiclient.py` va `translate.py` ga Groq API qo'shish (kvotalar tugaganda zaxira sifatida ishlashi uchun).
3. **Desktop "translate" rejimini yoqish:** `desktop_processor.py:3207` qatorida `render_modes` ro'yxatiga `"translate"`ni kiritish.
4. **Obuna kunlarini hisoblashni to'g'rilash:** `db/crud.py:set_plan`da qoldiq kunlarni saqlab qoluvchi mantiqni kiritish.
5. **MiniApp yuklamasini Celery'ga o'tkazish:** `web/miniapp.py:_run_job` o'rniga Celery taskini chaqirish.

### 2-bosqich: Barqarorlik va Xavfsizlik (Stability & Safety — 3-5 kun)
1. **Desktop Linux/macOS orphan jarayonlarni to'xtatish:** `desktop_processor_service.dart`da Process Group orqali to'liq guruhni o'ldirish.
2. **TTS Thread-Safety:** `worker/tts.py`da sessiyalarni har bir oqim uchun alohida qilish va bo'sh ovoz bo'laklariga sukunat qo'yish.
3. **HTML Injection himoyasi:** `bot/handlers/donate.py` va boshqa handlerlarda foydalanuvchi ma'lumotlarini `html.escape()` bilan o'rash.
4. **Click To'lov Tranzaksiyalarini atomik qilish:** Takroriy webhooklarda ikki marta yozilishning oldini olish.
5. **Marketing xabarlarini to'g'rilash:** `access.py:48`dagi 45 daqiqa xatosini haqiqiy tarifga moslash.

### 3-bosqich: Arxitektura va Refaktoring (Clean Architecture — 1-2 hafta)
1. **Desktop Engine modullashtirish:** `desktop_processor.py`ni alohida modullarga ajratish (`engine/whisper.py`, `engine/translator.py`, `engine/renderer.py`, `engine/tts.py`).
2. **Desktop Original Subtitr tahrirlash:** Flutter interfeysida original matnni ham to'g'rilash imkoniyatini yaratish.
3. **Avtomatik Disk Tozalash (Garbage Collector):** Serverda disk hajmi 80% ga yetganda 2 soatdan oshgan vaqtinchalik video fayllarni avtomatik o'chirish skriptini kiritish.
4. **Kesh va Checkpoint tizimi:** Celery pipeline'da har bir bosqich natijasini saqlab, uzilish bo'lganda to'xtagan joyidan davom etish tizimini yo'lga qo'yish.

---
*Hisobot Subtitr ekotizimining barcha qismlarini to'liq statik va mantiqiy tahlil qilish asosida tayyorlandi.*

topics.name: 1. Personal Pronouns
topics.content:
# Personal Pronouns (Shaxs Olmoshlari)

## Ta'rif
Personal pronouns — gapda ot (ism, narsa) o'rnida ishlatiladigan so'zlar. Ular ega (subject) yoki to'ldiruvchi (object) vazifasini bajaradi.

## Jadval

| Ega (Subject) | Tarjima | To'ldiruvchi (Object) | Tarjima |
|---|---|---|---|
| I | men | me | meni |
| You | sen/siz | you | seni/sizni |
| He | u (erkak) | him | uni |
| She | u (ayol) | her | uni |
| It | u (narsa/hayvon) | it | uni |
| We | biz | us | bizni |
| You | siz (ko'plik) | you | sizlarni |
| They | ular | them | ularni |

## Ishlatilishi

**Subject pronoun** — gapda ega (fe'ldan oldin) bo'lib keladi:
- **I** work every day. — Men har kuni ishlayman.
- **She** is a teacher. — U o'qituvchi.
- **They** live in Tashkent. — Ular Toshkentda yashaydi.

**Object pronoun** — fe'l yoki predlogdan keyin keladi:
- Can you help **me**? — Menga yordam bera olasizmi?
- I saw **her** yesterday. — Men uni kecha ko'rdim.
- Give it to **him**. — Buni unga bering.

## Muhim eslatmalar
- "It" — jonsiz narsalar, hayvonlar va noma'lum bolalar uchun ishlatiladi.
- "You" ham birlik, ham ko'plikda bir xil shaklda qoladi (siz/sizlar).
- Gap boshida hech qachon object pronoun (me, him, her...) ega sifatida ishlatilmaydi.

## Keng tarqalgan xatolar
- ❌ Me am tired. → ✅ **I** am tired.
- ❌ Her is my friend. → ✅ **She** is my friend.
- ❌ Give the book to she. → ✅ Give the book to **her**.

## Mashq uchun misollar
1. ___ (I/me) am from Uzbekistan.
2. Can you call ___ (they/them) tonight?
3. ___ (He/Him) works at a bank.

*Javoblar: 1-I, 2-them, 3-He*

topics.name: 2. Possessive Pronouns and Adjectives
topics.content:
# Possessive Pronouns / Adjectives (Egalik Olmoshlari)

## Ta'rif
Egalikni bildiruvchi so'zlar ikki turga bo'linadi:
1. **Possessive Adjectives** — otdan oldin keladi (my, your, his...)
2. **Possessive Pronouns** — otning o'rnini bosadi, mustaqil ishlatiladi (mine, yours, his...)

## Jadval

| Ega | Possessive Adjective | Tarjima | Possessive Pronoun | Tarjima |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| I | my | mening | mine | meniki |
| You | your | sening | yours | seniki |
| He | his | uning | his | uniki |
| She | her | uning | hers | uniki |
| It | its | uning | — | — |
| We | our | bizning | ours | bizniki |
| You | your | sizning | yours | sizniki |
| They | their | ularning | theirs | ularniki |

## Farqi

**Possessive Adjective + ot:**
- This is **my** book. — Bu mening kitobim.
- **Her** car is red. — Uning mashinasi qizil.

**Possessive Pronoun (ot ishlatilmaydi):**
- This book is **mine**. — Bu kitob meniki.
- Is this car **hers**? — Bu mashina uniki-mi?

## Muhim eslatma
- "It's" (apostrof bilan) = "it is" degani, "its" (apostrofsiz) — egalik bildiradi.
  - **It's** raining. (It is raining)
  - The dog wagged **its** tail.

## Keng tarqalgan xatolar
- ❌ This is mine book. → ✅ This is **my** book.
- ❌ The book is my. → ✅ The book is **mine**.
- ❌ The cat lost it's tail. → ✅ The cat lost **its** tail.

## Mashq uchun misollar
1. Is this ___ (you) pen? — Ha, ___ (I) mine.
2. The dog is wagging ___ (it) tail.
3. That house is ___ (they) — theirs.

topics.name: 3. Demonstrative Pronouns
topics.content:
# Demonstrative Pronouns (Ko'rsatish Olmoshlari)

## Ta'rif
This, that, these, those — narsa yoki shaxslarni ko'rsatish uchun ishlatiladi. Masofa (yaqin/uzoq) va son (birlik/ko'plik) ga qarab tanlanadi.

## Jadval

| | Birlik | Ko'plik |
|---|---|---|
| Yaqin (bu yerda) | this | these |
| Uzoq (u yerda) | that | those |

## Misollar

**This (bu) — yaqin, birlik:**
- **This** is my phone. — Bu mening telefonim.

**These (bular) — yaqin, ko'plik:**
- **These** are my friends. — Bular mening do'stlarim.

**That (u/o'sha) — uzoq, birlik:**
- **That** is his house over there. — Ana u uning uyi.

**Those (ular/o'shalar) — uzoq, ko'plik:**
- **Those** are expensive shoes. — Ana ular qimmat poyabzallar.

## Qo'shimcha ishlatilish
Vaqt bildirishda ham ishlatiladi:
- **This** week — shu hafta (hozirgi)
- **That** day — o'sha kun (o'tgan)

Telefon suhbatida:
- Hello, who is **this**? / **This** is John.

## Keng tarqalgan xatolar
- ❌ This are my books. → ✅ **These** are my books. (ko'plik bilan mos kelishi kerak)
- ❌ Those is my car. → ✅ **That** is my car.

## Mashq uchun misollar
1. ___ (this/these) apples are fresh.
2. Look at ___ (that/those) mountain far away.
3. Is ___ (this/that) your bag right here?

topics.name: 4. Reflexive Pronouns
topics.content:
# Reflexive Pronouns (O'zlik Olmoshlari)

## Ta'rif
Harakat egaga qaytib ta'sir qilganda ishlatiladi — "o'zi", "o'zini" ma'nosida.

## Jadval

| Ega | Reflexive Pronoun | Tarjima |
|---|---|---|
| I | myself | o'zim(ni) |
| You | yourself | o'zing(ni) |
| He | himself | o'zi(ni) |
| She | herself | o'zi(ni) |
| It | itself | o'zi(ni) |
| We | ourselves | o'zimiz(ni) |
| You (ko'plik) | yourselves | o'zingiz(ni) |
| They | themselves | o'zlari(ni) |

## Ishlatilish holatlari

**1. Harakat egaga qaytganda:**
- I cut **myself** while cooking. — Men ovqat pishirayotganda o'zimni kesib oldim.
- She looked at **herself** in the mirror. — U oynada o'ziga qaradi.

**2. Ta'kid uchun (emphatic use):**
- I did it **myself**. — Men buni o'zim qildim (boshqa hech kim emas).
- The teacher **himself** explained it. — O'qituvchining o'zi buni tushuntirdi.

**3. "By + reflexive" = yolg'iz, birovsiz:**
- She lives **by herself**. — U yolg'iz yashaydi.
- I traveled **by myself**. — Men yolg'iz sayohat qildim.

## Keng tarqalgan xatolar
- ❌ I washed me. → ✅ I washed **myself**.
- ❌ They enjoyed themself. → ✅ They enjoyed **themselves**. (ko'plik uchun -selves)
- ❌ He hurt hisself. → ✅ He hurt **himself**.

## Mashq uchun misollar
1. Be careful, don't hurt ___ (you)!
2. We made this cake ___ (we) — ourselves.
3. The cat cleaned ___ (it).

topics.name: 5. Indefinite Pronouns
topics.content:
# Indefinite Pronouns (Noaniqlik Olmoshlari)

## Ta'rif
Aniq bo'lmagan shaxs, narsa yoki miqdorni bildiradi — "kimdir", "hech kim", "hamma narsa" kabi ma'nolarda.

## Guruhlar

| Shaxs | Narsa | Joy |
|---|---|---|
| someone / somebody | something | somewhere |
| anyone / anybody | anything | anywhere |
| no one / nobody | nothing | nowhere |
| everyone / everybody | everything | everywhere |

## Ishlatilish qoidasi

**Some- guruhi** — darak gaplarda va taklif so'roqlarida:
- **Someone** is knocking at the door. — Kimdir eshikni taqillatyapti.
- Would you like **something** to drink? — Biror narsa ichasizmi? (taklif)

**Any- guruhi** — inkor va so'roq gaplarda:
- I don't know **anyone** here. — Men bu yerda hech kimni tanimayman.
- Is there **anything** in the fridge? — Muzlatgichda biror narsa bormi?

**No- guruhi** — o'zi inkor ma'no beradi (fe'l ijobiy bo'ladi):
- **Nobody** called me. — Hech kim menga qo'ng'iroq qilmadi.
- There is **nothing** here. — Bu yerda hech narsa yo'q.

**Every- guruhi** — barchasini bildiradi, birlik fe'l bilan keladi:
- **Everyone** knows the answer. — Hamma javobni biladi.
- **Everything** is ready. — Hamma narsa tayyor.

## Muhim eslatma
Indefinite pronouns birlik fe'l bilan keladi:
- **Everybody is** happy. (are emas!)
- **Somebody has** left their bag.

## Keng tarqalgan xatolar
- ❌ Nobody don't know. → ✅ Nobody **knows**. (double negative bo'lmaydi)
- ❌ Everyone are here. → ✅ Everyone **is** here.

## Mashq uchun misollar
1. I can't find ___ (something/anything) to wear.
2. ___ (Everybody/Everybodies) loves music.
3. There's ___ (nobody/anybody) at home.

topics.name: 6. Relative Pronouns
topics.content:
# Relative Pronouns (Nisbiy Olmoshlar)

## Ta'rif
Ergash gapni bosh gapga bog'lash uchun ishlatiladi: who, whom, whose, which, that.

## Jadval

| So'z | Kim/nima uchun | Misol |
|---|---|---|
| who | odamlar (ega) | The man **who** called is my uncle. |
| whom | odamlar (to'ldiruvchi, rasmiy) | The man **whom** I met is a doctor. |
| whose | egalik | The girl **whose** bag is red is here. |
| which | narsalar/hayvonlar | The book **which** I bought is great. |
| that | odamlar va narsalar (norasmiy) | The car **that** I drive is old. |

## Batafsil tushuntirish

**Who** — shaxslar haqida, ega vazifasida:
- She is the woman **who** teaches English. — U ingliz tilidan dars beruvchi ayol.

**Whom** — shaxslar haqida, to'ldiruvchi vazifasida (ko'proq yozma, rasmiy tilda):
- The person **whom** you saw is my brother. — Siz ko'rgan odam mening akam.

**Whose** — egalikni bildiradi:
- That's the boy **whose** father is a doctor. — Bu otasi shifokor bo'lgan bola.

**Which** — narsa, hayvon, va butun gapga izoh berish uchun:
- The film **which** we watched was boring. — Biz ko'rgan film zerikarli edi.

**That** — who yoki which o'rnida norasmiy tilda, ayniqsa defining clause'larda:
- This is the house **that** I grew up in. — Bu men o'sgan uy.

## Muhim eslatma
"That" izohli (non-defining) ergash gaplarda ishlatilmaydi (vergul bilan ajratilganda):
- ❌ My mother, that is 50, works here.
- ✅ My mother, **who** is 50, works here.

## Keng tarqalgan xatolar
- ❌ The man which called is my friend. → ✅ The man **who** called...
- ❌ This is book that I bought it. → ✅ This is the book **that** I bought. (ortiqcha "it" kerak emas)

## Mashq uchun misollar
1. The woman ___ (who/which) lives next door is a nurse.
2. This is the car ___ (whose/which) I want to buy.
3. He is the man ___ (whose/who) car was stolen.

topics.name: 7. Reciprocal Pronouns
topics.content:
# Reciprocal Pronouns (O'zaro Olmoshlar)

## Ta'rif
Ikki yoki undan ortiq shaxs bir-biriga nisbatan bir xil harakatni bajarganda ishlatiladi: **each other**, **one another**.

## Asosiy ma'no
- **Each other** — bir-biri (asosan ikki kishi orasida)
- **One another** — bir-biri (ko'proq uch va undan ortiq kishi orasida, lekin amalda ikkisi ham deyarli bir xil ishlatiladi)

## Misollar
- Anna and Tom love **each other**. — Anna va Tom bir-birini sevishadi.
- The students helped **one another** with homework. — O'quvchilar bir-biriga uy vazifasida yordam berishdi.
- We should respect **each other**. — Biz bir-birimizni hurmat qilishimiz kerak.

## Reciprocal vs Reflexive — farqi
Bu ikkisini adashtirmaslik kerak:
- **Reflexive** (o'zlik) — harakat o'ziga qaytadi: They blamed **themselves**. (ular o'zlarini ayblashdi)
- **Reciprocal** (o'zaro) — harakat bir-biriga qaratilgan: They blamed **each other**. (ular bir-birini ayblashdi)

## Egalik shakli
- **Each other's** / **one another's** — egalikni bildiradi:
  - They read **each other's** letters. — Ular bir-birining xatlarini o'qishdi.

## Keng tarqalgan xatolar
- ❌ They love themselves. (agar ma'no "bir-birini" bo'lsa) → ✅ They love **each other**.
- ❌ each others → ✅ **each other's** (apostrof "s" bilan)

## Mashq uchun misollar
1. Sarah and I always help ___ (each other/ourselves).
2. The team members trust ___ (each other's/each others) judgment.
3. Did you hurt ___ (yourself/each other) in the accident? (agar ikkalasi ham jarohat olgan bo'lsa)

topics.name: 1. This That These Those
topics.content:
# This / That / These / Those (Determiner sifatida)

## Ta'rif
Bu so'zlar determiner (aniqlovchi) sifatida otdan oldin kelib, qaysi narsa haqida gap ketayotganini ko'rsatadi.

## Qoida

| | Birlik | Ko'plik |
|---|---|---|
| Yaqin | this + ot | these + ot |
| Uzoq | that + ot | those + ot |

## Misollar
- **This** book is interesting. — Bu kitob qiziqarli.
- **These** shoes are new. — Bu poyabzallar yangi.
- **That** car belongs to my father. — Ana o'sha mashina otamniki.
- **Those** houses are old. — Ana o'sha uylar eski.

## Determiner vs Pronoun farqi
- Determiner: **This** phone is mine. (otdan oldin)
- Pronoun: **This** is mine. (ot o'rnida, mustaqil)

## Vaqt bilan ishlatilishi
- **this** morning/week/month/year — shu (hozirgi davr)
- **that** time — o'sha payt (o'tmish)

## Keng tarqalgan xatolar
- ❌ This shoes are nice. → ✅ **These** shoes are nice.
- ❌ Those book is mine. → ✅ **That** book is mine.

## Mashq
1. I like ___ (this/these) flowers in the garden.
2. ___ (That/Those) mountain is very tall.

topics.name: 2. Possessive Determiners
topics.content:
# Possessive Determiners (Egalik Aniqlovchilari)

## Ta'rif
My, your, his, her, its, our, their — otdan oldin kelib, kimga tegishli ekanini bildiradi.

## Jadval
| Ega | Determiner | Misol |
|---|---|---|
| I | my | **my** book |
| you | your | **your** car |
| he | his | **his** dog |
| she | her | **her** phone |
| it | its | **its** tail |
| we | our | **our** house |
| they | their | **their** children |

## Misollar
- **My** sister lives in London. — Mening singlim Londonda yashaydi.
- Is this **your** umbrella? — Bu sizning soyabonimgizmi?
- The company changed **its** name. — Kompaniya o'z nomini o'zgartirdi.

## Muhim eslatma: Its vs It's
- **Its** — egalik (apostrofsiz): The dog wagged **its** tail.
- **It's** — "it is" qisqartmasi: **It's** raining. (apostrof bilan)

Bu ikkalasini chalkashtirish — eng ko'p uchraydigan yozma xato.

## Keng tarqalgan xatolar
- ❌ Their's house is big. → ✅ **Their** house is big.
- ❌ The cat licked it's paw. → ✅ The cat licked **its** paw.

## Mashq
1. This is ___ (I) laptop.
2. The bird built ___ (it) nest.
3. ___ (they) parents are doctors.

topics.name: 3. Each vs Every
topics.content:
# Each vs Every

## Ta'rif
Ikkalasi ham "har bir" degan ma'noni bildiradi, lekin urg'u va ishlatilish jihatidan farqlanadi.

## Farqi

**Each** — guruhdagi har bir a'zoni **alohida-alohida** ta'kidlaydi (kamida 2 ta narsa/shaxs uchun):
- **Each** student has a book. — Har bir o'quvchining kitobi bor (bittalab qaraladi).
- **Each** of them received a prize. — Ularning har biri sovrin oldi.

**Every** — narsalarni **butun guruh sifatida**, umumlashtirib ta'kidlaydi (kamida 3 ta narsa/shaxs uchun):
- **Every** student passed the exam. — Barcha o'quvchilar imtihondan o'tdi (umumiy holat).
- **Every** day, I drink coffee. — Har kuni men qahva ichaman.

## Grammatik farq
- **Each** + of + ko'plik ot: **each of** the students
- **Every** — "of" bilan ishlatilmaydi: ~~every of~~ ❌

Ikkalasi ham birlik fe'l bilan keladi:
- **Each** boy **has** a pen. (have emas)
- **Every** girl **likes** music. (like emas)

## Qachon qaysi biri ishlatiladi
- Aniq son bilan: **each** (masalan, ikkita, uchta narsa haqida gapirilganda)
- Umumiy qoida/odat haqida: **every**

## Keng tarqalgan xatolar
- ❌ Every of the students. → ✅ **Each of** the students.
- ❌ Each students have... → ✅ **Each** student **has**...

## Mashq
1. ___ (Each/Every) day I go to school.
2. ___ (Each/Every) of the players scored a goal.

topics.name: 4. Either vs Neither
topics.content:
# Either vs Neither

## Ta'rif
Ikkala so'z ham **ikkita narsa/shaxs** haqida gapirganda ishlatiladi.
- **Either** — "ikkalasidan biri" (ijobiy ma'no)
- **Neither** — "ikkalasi ham emas" (inkor ma'no, o'zi negative)

## Ishlatilishi

**Either (+ birlik ot):**
- You can take **either** road. — Siz ikki yo'ldan birini tanlashingiz mumkin.
- **Either** option is fine with me. — Ikkala variant ham menga mos.

**Neither (+ birlik ot, fe'l ijobiy shaklda bo'ladi chunki neither o'zi inkor):**
- **Neither** answer is correct. — Ikkala javob ham noto'g'ri.
- **Neither** of them came. — Ularning hech biri kelmadi.

## "Either...or" va "Neither...nor" tuzilmalari
- **Either** tea **or** coffee — choy yoki qahva (ikkisidan biri)
  - You can have **either** tea **or** coffee.
- **Neither** tea **nor** coffee — na choy, na qahva (ikkisi ham emas)
  - She drinks **neither** tea **nor** coffee.

## Roziligimni bildirishda
- "I don't like it." — "**Neither** do I." (Men ham yoqtirmayman)
- "I like it." — "**So** do I." (Men ham yoqtiraman) — bu "So" mavzusida batafsil ko'riladi

## Keng tarqalgan xatolar
- ❌ Neither of them doesn't know. → ✅ **Neither** of them **knows**. (double negative bo'lmaydi)
- ❌ Either of the answers are correct. → ✅ Either of the answers **is** correct.

## Mashq
1. You can choose ___ (either/neither) color — red or blue.
2. ___ (Either/Neither) of us wants to go. (ikkalamiz ham xohlamaymiz)

topics.name: 5. Both
topics.content:
# Both (Ikkalasi Ham)

## Ta'rif
"Both" ikkita narsa yoki shaxsning ikkalasini ham bildiradi — ijobiy ma'noda.

## Ishlatilish shakllari

**1. Both + ko'plik ot:**
- **Both** boys are tall. — Ikkala bola ham baland bo'yli.

**2. Both of + the/my/these + ko'plik ot:**
- **Both of** the students passed. — Ikkala o'quvchi ham o'tdi.
- **Both of** my parents work. — Ikkala ota-onam ham ishlaydi.

**3. Both + pronoun (of bilan):**
- **Both of** us like tea. — Ikkalamiz ham choyni yoqtiramiz.
- **Both of** them are here. — Ikkalasi ham shu yerda.

## Both...and... tuzilmasi
Ikkita narsani bog'lash uchun:
- **Both** Anna **and** Tom are teachers. — Anna ham, Tom ham o'qituvchi.
- She speaks **both** English **and** French. — U ham ingliz, ham fransuz tilida gaplashadi.

## Gap ichidagi joylashuvi
"Both" ko'pincha fe'ldan oldin yoki "be" fe'lidan keyin keladi:
- They **both** work here. / They are **both** doctors.

## Keng tarqalgan xatolar
- ❌ Both the boy is tall. → ✅ **Both boys are** tall. (ko'plik fe'l kerak)
- ❌ Both of student came. → ✅ **Both of the** students came.

## Mashq
1. ___ (Both/Each) my brothers live abroad.
2. She likes ___ (both/either) coffee and tea.

topics.name: 1. Indefinite Article A An
topics.content:
# Indefinite Article: A / An (Noaniq Artikl)

## Ta'rif
"A" va "an" — sanaladigan, birlik va **noaniq** (aniq bo'lmagan, birinchi marta tilga olinayotgan) otlar oldida ishlatiladi.

## Qoida: A yoki An?
Bu **yozilishga emas, talaffuzga** bog'liq:
- **A** — undosh tovush bilan boshlangan so'zlar oldida: **a** book, **a** car, **a** university (talaffuzda "yu" — undosh tovush)
- **An** — unli tovush bilan boshlangan so'zlar oldida: **an** apple, **an** hour (h talaffuz qilinmaydi), **an** umbrella

## Misollar
- I have **a** dog. — Mening itim bor.
- She is **an** engineer. — U muhandis.
- It took **an** hour. — Bir soat vaqt oldi. ("h" talaffuz qilinmaydi → unli tovush kabi)
- He works at **a** university. — U universitetda ishlaydi. ("u" bu yerda "yu" deb talaffuz qilinadi → undosh)

## Qachon ishlatiladi
1. Narsa birinchi marta tilga olinganda: I saw **a** cat in the garden.
2. Kasb-hunar aytilganda: She is **a** doctor.
3. Umumiy bir dona narsa haqida: Can you give me **a** pen?

## Qachon ishlatilmaydi
- Ko'plik otlar bilan: ~~a books~~ ❌ → **books**
- Sanalmaydigan otlar bilan: ~~a water~~ ❌ → **water**

## Keng tarqalgan xatolar
- ❌ I need a advice. → ✅ I need **some advice**. (advice — sanalmaydigan)
- ❌ She has a umbrella. → ✅ She has **an** umbrella.
- ❌ He is an university student. → ✅ He is **a** university student.

## Mashq
1. I saw ___ elephant at the zoo.
2. She bought ___ new car.
3. It was ___ honest mistake.

topics.name: 2. Definite Article The
topics.content:
# Definite Article: The (Aniq Artikl)

## Ta'rif
"The" — allaqachon ma'lum bo'lgan, aniq, yagona yoki oldin tilga olingan narsa/shaxs haqida gapirganda ishlatiladi.

## Qachon ishlatiladi

**1. Oldin tilga olingan narsa haqida gapirilganda (ikkinchi marta):**
- I saw **a** dog. **The** dog was black. — Men itni ko'rdim. Bu it qora edi.

**2. Yagona narsalar haqida:**
- **The** sun, **the** moon, **the** sky, **the** Earth
- **The** sun rises in the east. — Quyosh sharqdan chiqadi.

**3. Superlativlar bilan:**
- She is **the** best student in class. — U sinfdagi eng yaxshi o'quvchi.

**4. Musiqa asboblari bilan:**
- He plays **the** guitar. — U gitara chaladi.

**5. Daryolar, dengizlar, okeanlar, tog' tizmalari, mamlakat nomlari (ko'plikda):**
- **the** Nile, **the** Pacific Ocean, **the** Alps, **the** United States, **the** Netherlands

**6. Aniq, tinglovchiga tanish narsalar:**
- Can you close **the** door? — Eshikni yopa olasizmi? (aniq bir eshik)

## Qachon ishlatilmaydi
- Umumiy ko'plik/sanalmaydigan otlar bilan (umumiy holatda): I like **music**. (the music emas)
- Ko'pchilik mamlakat nomlari bilan: **Uzbekistan**, **France** (the Uzbekistan emas)
- Til nomlari bilan: I speak **English**. (the English emas)

## Keng tarqalgan xatolar
- ❌ The Uzbekistan is beautiful. → ✅ **Uzbekistan** is beautiful.
- ❌ I like the music. (umumiy ma'noda) → ✅ I like **music**.
- ❌ Sun is hot. → ✅ **The** sun is hot.

## Mashq
1. ___ Amazon River is very long.
2. I love ___ classical music. (umumiy)
3. Can you pass me ___ salt? (stol ustidagi aniq tuz)

topics.name: 3. Zero Article
topics.content:
# Zero Article (Artikl Ishlatilmaydigan Holatlar)

## Ta'rif
Ba'zi holatlarda ingliz tilida "a/an" yoki "the" umuman ishlatilmaydi — bu "zero article" deb ataladi.

## Qachon artikl ishlatilmaydi

**1. Ko'plik yoki sanalmaydigan otlar bilan, umumiy ma'noda:**
- **Dogs** are loyal animals. — Itlar sodiq hayvonlar.
- **Water** is essential for life. — Suv hayot uchun zarur.

**2. Mamlakat, shahar nomlari bilan (ko'pchiligida):**
- **Uzbekistan**, **Tashkent**, **London**, **France**

**3. Til nomlari bilan:**
- She speaks **Russian** fluently.

**4. Ovqatlanish, mavsum, kunlar bilan umumiy holatda:**
- We have **breakfast** at 7 AM.
- I love **summer**.
- See you on **Monday**.

**5. Ish/maktab/uy/kasal bo'lish kabi umumiy iboralar bilan:**
- He goes to **school** every day. (o'qish maqsadida)
- She is at **home**.
- He went to **hospital**. (bemor sifatida — Britaniya ingliz tili)

**6. Sport turlari bilan:**
- I play **football** on weekends.

## Farqi: artikl bilan va artiklsiz
- I go to **school**. (o'qish uchun boraman)
- I go to **the school**. (aniq bir maktab binosiga boraman, masalan yig'ilishga)

## Keng tarqalgan xatolar
- ❌ I speak the English. → ✅ I speak **English**.
- ❌ The dogs are loyal. (umumiy ma'noda) → ✅ **Dogs** are loyal.
- ❌ He plays the football. → ✅ He plays **football**.

## Mashq
1. ___ Uzbekistan is in Central Asia.
2. I like ___ cats. (umumiy)
3. They speak ___ French at home.

topics.name: 1. Regular Plurals
topics.content:
# Regular Plurals (To'g'ri Ko'plik Shakllari)

## Ta'rif
Ko'pchilik ingliz otlari ko'plikka o'tishda muayyan qoidalarga bo'ysunadi — oxiriga -s yoki -es qo'shiladi.

## Qoidalar

**1. Asosiy qoida: -s qo'shiladi**
- book → book**s**, car → car**s**, girl → girl**s**

**2. -s, -ss, -sh, -ch, -x, -z bilan tugasa: -es qo'shiladi**
- bus → bus**es**, class → class**es**, box → box**es**, watch → watch**es**, brush → brush**es**

**3. Undosh + y bilan tugasa: y → i, + es**
- city → cit**ies**, baby → bab**ies**, country → countr**ies**

**4. Unli + y bilan tugasa: shunchaki -s qo'shiladi**
- boy → boy**s**, day → day**s**, toy → toy**s**

**5. -f yoki -fe bilan tugasa: ko'pincha f/fe → v + es**
- leaf → lea**ves**, knife → kni**ves**, wife → wi**ves**
- (Istisno: roof → roof**s**, belief → belief**s**)

**6. Undosh + o bilan tugasa: ko'pincha -es qo'shiladi**
- tomato → tomato**es**, potato → potato**es**
- (Istisno: photo → photo**s**, piano → piano**s**)

## Talaffuz qoidasi
- /s/ tovushi: cats, books
- /z/ tovushi: dogs, boys
- /ɪz/ tovushi: buses, watches

## Keng tarqalgan xatolar
- ❌ citys → ✅ cit**ies**
- ❌ boxs → ✅ box**es**
- ❌ leafs → ✅ lea**ves**

## Mashq
1. box → ___
2. baby → ___
3. knife → ___
4. day → ___

topics.name: 2. Irregular Plurals
topics.content:
# Irregular Plurals (Noto'g'ri Ko'plik Shakllari)

## Ta'rif
Ba'zi otlar ko'plikka o'tganda umumiy qoidalarga bo'ysunmaydi — ular butunlay boshqa shaklga ega bo'ladi yoki umuman o'zgarmaydi.

## Eng ko'p uchraydigan noto'g'ri ko'pliklar

| Birlik | Ko'plik |
|---|---|
| man | men |
| woman | women |
| child | children |
| foot | feet |
| tooth | teeth |
| mouse | mice |
| goose | geese |
| person | people |
| ox | oxen |

## O'zgarmaydigan otlar (birlik = ko'plik)
- sheep → sheep
- fish → fish (ba'zan "fishes" ham ishlatiladi, turli baliq turlari haqida)
- deer → deer
- series → series
- species → species

## Lotin/Grek kelib chiqishi bo'lgan otlar
| Birlik | Ko'plik |
|---|---|
| cactus | cacti |
| fungus | fungi |
| analysis | analyses |
| crisis | crises |
| phenomenon | phenomena |
| criterion | criteria |
| datum | data |

## Misollar
- Two **children** are playing outside. — Ikkita bola tashqarida o'ynayapti.
- She brushed her **teeth**. — U tishlarini yuvdi.
- There are five **sheep** in the field. — Dalada beshta qo'y bor.

## Keng tarqalgan xatolar
- ❌ childs, mans, tooths → ✅ **children**, **men**, **teeth**
- ❌ peoples (ko'pincha) → ✅ **people** (allaqachon ko'plik)

## Mashq
1. one child, two ___
2. one foot, two ___
3. one mouse, two ___

topics.name: 3. Countable Nouns
topics.content:
# Countable Nouns (Sanaladigan Otlar)

## Ta'rif
Sanash mumkin bo'lgan narsalar — birlik va ko'plik shakliga ega, raqamlar bilan ishlatiladi.

## Xususiyatlari
- Birlik shaklda **a/an** artikli bilan keladi: **a** book, **an** apple
- Ko'plikda -s/-es qo'shiladi: book**s**, apple**s**
- Raqamlar bilan ishlatiladi: one book, two books, three books
- Ko'plikda "how many" bilan so'raladi: **How many** books do you have?
- "some/any/a few/many" bilan ishlatiladi

## Misollar
- I have **a** cat and **two** dogs. — Mening bitta mushugim va ikkita itim bor.
- There are **many** students in the class. — Sinfda ko'p o'quvchi bor.
- **How many** apples did you buy? — Nechta olma sotib olding?

## Sanaladigan otlarga misollar
book, car, chair, dog, apple, student, city, idea, question

## Miqdor so'zlari bilan
- **a few** books (bir necha kitob)
- **many** books (ko'p kitob)
- **several** books (bir qancha kitob)
- **a couple of** books (ikkita atrofida)

## Keng tarqalgan xatolar
- ❌ I have much book. → ✅ I have **many** books.
- ❌ How much books? → ✅ **How many** books?

## Mashq
1. There are ___ (many/much) chairs in the room.
2. She bought three ___ (apple/apples).
3. ___ (How much/How many) students are there?

topics.name: 4. Uncountable Nouns
topics.content:
# Uncountable Nouns (Sanalmaydigan Otlar)

## Ta'rif
Sanab bo'lmaydigan narsalar — yagona (butun, ajratilmagan) massani bildiradi, odatda ko'plik shakliga ega emas.

## Xususiyatlari
- **a/an** bilan ishlatilmaydi: ~~a water~~ ❌
- Ko'plik shakli yo'q: ~~waters~~ ❌ (ba'zi maxsus holatlar bundan mustasno)
- Doim birlik fe'l bilan keladi: Water **is** important.
- "how much" bilan so'raladi: **How much** water do you need?
- "some/any/a little/much" bilan ishlatiladi

## Sanalmaydigan otlarga misollar
water, milk, rice, sugar, money, information, advice, furniture, luggage, news, homework, music, traffic, weather, knowledge

## Miqdorni bildirish uchun maxsus so'zlar
Sanalmaydigan otlarni sanash uchun maxsus birliklar ishlatiladi:
- **a piece of** advice/information/furniture
- **a glass of** water/milk
- **a bottle of** water
- **a loaf of** bread
- **a cup of** tea/coffee

## Misollar
- Can I have **some** water? — Menga biroz suv bera olasizmi?
- I need **a piece of** advice. — Menga bir maslahat kerak.
- **How much** money do you have? — Sizda qancha pul bor?

## Keng tarqalgan xatolar
- ❌ I need an advice. → ✅ I need **some advice** / **a piece of advice**.
- ❌ How many money? → ✅ **How much** money?
- ❌ furnitures, informations → ✅ **furniture**, **information** (ko'plik shakli yo'q)

## Mashq
1. She gave me some good ___ (advice/advices).
2. ___ (How much/How many) sugar do you want in your tea?
3. I bought new ___ (furniture/furnitures) for my room.

topics.name: 5. Possessive S
topics.content:
# Possessive 's (Egalik Qo'shimchasi)

## Ta'rif
Ega bo'lish (kimning narsasi ekanligini) bildirish uchun otga **'s** qo'shiladi.

## Qoidalar

**1. Birlik otlarga 's qo'shiladi:**
- John**'s** car — Jonning mashinasi
- the girl**'s** bag — qizning sumkasi

**2. -s bilan tugagan ko'plik otlarga faqat apostrof (') qo'shiladi:**
- the student**s'** books — o'quvchilarning kitoblari
- my parent**s'** house — ota-onamning uyi

**3. -s bilan tugamagan ko'plik otlarga 's qo'shiladi:**
- the children**'s** toys — bolalarning o'yinchoqlari
- the men**'s** room — erkaklar xonasi

**4. -s bilan tugagan ismlarga ('s yoki faqat ') qo'shilishi mumkin:**
- James**'s** book yoki James**'** book — Jeymsning kitobi

## "Of" bilan solishtirish
Jonsiz narsalar uchun ko'pincha "of" ishlatiladi:
- the roof **of the house** (uyning tomi) — the house's roof dan ko'ra tabiiyroq
- Lekin: **John's** car (shaxs uchun 's tabiiyroq)

## Misollar
- This is **Anna's** phone. — Bu Annaning telefoni.
- **Where's** the cat**'s** food? — Mushukning ovqati qayerda?
- My **sister-in-law's** birthday is today. — Kelinimning tug'ilgan kuni bugun.

## Keng tarqalgan xatolar
- ❌ The girls bag (apostrofsiz) → ✅ The girl**'s** bag
- ❌ The childrens' toys → ✅ The **children's** toys (children — allaqachon ko'plik, -s bilan tugamaydi)
- ❌ Its' vs it's vs its — faqat **its** (egalik) va **it's** (it is) to'g'ri, "its'" umuman yo'q

## Mashq
1. This is ___ (Maria) house.
2. The ___ (boys) locker room is upstairs.
3. I found the ___ (children) shoes.

topics.name: 1. There is There are
topics.content:
# There is / There are

## Ta'rif
"There is/are" — biror narsaning mavjudligini bildirish uchun ishlatiladi ("bor" ma'nosida).

## Qoida
- **There is** + birlik/sanalmaydigan ot
- **There are** + ko'plik ot

## Misollar
- **There is** a book on the table. — Stolda kitob bor.
- **There are** three chairs in the room. — Xonada uchta stul bor.
- **There is** some water in the bottle. — Shishada biroz suv bor.

## Inkor shakli
- **There is not (isn't)** a pen here. — Bu yerda ruchka yo'q.
- **There are not (aren't)** any books. — Hech qanday kitob yo'q.

## So'roq shakli
- **Is there** a bank near here? — Yaqinda bank bormi?
- **Are there** any students in class? — Sinfda o'quvchilar bormi?

## Qisqa javoblar
- Is there a problem? — **Yes, there is.** / **No, there isn't.**
- Are there any apples? — **Yes, there are.** / **No, there aren't.**

## "There" vs "It"
- **There is** a cat in the garden. (mavjudlikni bildiradi)
- **It is** a beautiful cat. (tavsif beradi)

## Keng tarqalgan xatolar
- ❌ There is three books. → ✅ **There are** three books.
- ❌ Is there some milk? (savolda odatda "any" ishlatiladi) → ✅ Is there **any** milk?

## Mashq
1. ___ (There is/There are) a lot of people at the party.
2. ___ (Is there/Are there) any coffee left?
3. ___ (There isn't/There aren't) any milk in the fridge.

topics.name: 2. There was There were
topics.content:
# There was / There were (O'tgan Zamonda)

## Ta'rif
"There is/are" ning o'tgan zamon (Past Simple) shakli — o'tmishda biror narsaning mavjud bo'lganini bildiradi.

## Qoida
- **There was** + birlik/sanalmaydigan ot
- **There were** + ko'plik ot

## Misollar
- **There was** a big tree in front of the house. — Uy oldida katta daraxt bor edi.
- **There were** many people at the concert. — Konsertda ko'p odam bor edi.
- **There was** no water in the village. — Qishloqda suv yo'q edi.

## Inkor shakli
- **There wasn't** any food left. — Hech qanday ovqat qolmagan edi.
- **There weren't** enough chairs. — Yetarli stul yo'q edi.

## So'roq shakli
- **Was there** a party last night? — Kecha kechqurun ziyofat bo'lganmidi?
- **Were there** any problems? — Muammolar bo'lganmidi?

## Qisqa javoblar
- Was there a meeting? — **Yes, there was.** / **No, there wasn't.**
- Were there many guests? — **Yes, there were.** / **No, there weren't.**

## Keng tarqalgan xatolar
- ❌ There was many books. → ✅ **There were** many books.
- ❌ There were a car. → ✅ **There was** a car.

## Mashq
1. ___ (There was/There were) a storm last night.
2. ___ (There wasn't/There weren't) any tickets available.
3. ___ (Was there/Were there) a lot of traffic yesterday?

topics.name: 3. There has been There will be
topics.content:
# There has been / There will be (Perfect va Future Shakllar)

## Ta'rif
"There" tuzilmasi boshqa zamonlarda ham ishlatilishi mumkin — Present Perfect va Future Simple'da.

## There has/have been (Present Perfect)
Natija yoki tajriba haqida gapirganda:
- **There has been** an accident on the road. — Yo'lda avariya bo'lgan (hozirgi natija).
- **There have been** many changes recently. — So'nggi paytda ko'p o'zgarishlar bo'ldi.

Qoida: **has been** (birlik) / **have been** (ko'plik)

## There will be (Future Simple)
Kelajakda biror narsa mavjud bo'lishini bashorat qilganda:
- **There will be** a meeting tomorrow. — Ertaga yig'ilish bo'ladi.
- **There will be** many changes next year. — Kelasi yili ko'p o'zgarishlar bo'ladi.

Inkor: **There won't be** any problems. — Hech qanday muammo bo'lmaydi.
So'roq: **Will there be** a test next week? — Kelasi hafta test bo'ladimi?

## Boshqa zamonlarda ishlatilishi
- **There is going to be** a storm. — Bo'ron bo'ladi (yaqin kelajak, aniq belgi bilan).
- **There used to be** a park here. — Bu yerda avval bog' bo'lgan.
- **There must be** a reason. — Buning sababi bo'lishi kerak (taxmin).

## Solishtirma jadval

| Zamon | Shakl | Misol |
|---|---|---|
| Present Simple | There is/are | There is a problem. |
| Past Simple | There was/were | There was a problem. |
| Present Perfect | There has/have been | There has been a problem. |
| Future Simple | There will be | There will be a problem. |

## Keng tarqalgan xatolar
- ❌ There will been a party. → ✅ **There will be** a party.
- ❌ There has been many storms. → ✅ **There have been** many storms.

## Mashq
1. ___ (There will be/There has been) a football match next Sunday.
2. ___ (There has been/There have been) three earthquakes this year.

topics.name: 1. Telling Time
topics.content:
# Telling Time (Soatni Aytish)

## Asosiy qoida
Ingliz tilida soat ikki xil usulda aytiladi: raqamli (digital) va an'anaviy (analog) usul.

## Raqamli usul (oddiy)
Soat va daqiqani ketma-ket aytish:
- 7:00 — seven o'clock
- 7:15 — seven fifteen
- 7:30 — seven thirty
- 7:45 — seven forty-five

## An'anaviy usul (past/to)

**Yarim soatgacha — "past" ishlatiladi:**
- 7:05 — five **past** seven — yettidan besh minut o'tdi
- 7:15 — (a) quarter **past** seven — yettidan chorak o'tdi
- 7:30 — half **past** seven — yettidan yarim o'tdi

**Yarim soatdan keyin — "to" ishlatiladi:**
- 7:45 — (a) quarter **to** eight — sakkizga chorak qoldi
- 7:50 — ten **to** eight — sakkizga o'n minut qoldi
- 7:55 — five **to** eight — sakkizga besh minut qoldi

## Muhim so'zlar
- **o'clock** — aniq soat (7:00 → seven o'clock)
- **a quarter** — chorak (15 daqiqa)
- **half** — yarim (30 daqiqa)
- **AM** — tongdan peshingacha (00:00–11:59)
- **PM** — peshindan kechgacha (12:00–23:59)

## Savol berish
- **What time is it?** — Soat necha?
- **What time does the train leave?** — Poyezd soat nechada jo'naydi?

## Misollar
- The meeting starts **at half past nine**. — Yig'ilish to'qqiz yarimda boshlanadi.
- I wake up **at a quarter to seven**. — Men yettiga chorak qolganda uyg'onaman.

## Keng tarqalgan xatolar
- ❌ half to seven → ✅ **half past** seven
- ❌ seven and half → ✅ **half past seven**

## Mashq
1. 3:30 → ___
2. 9:15 → ___
3. 10:45 → ___

topics.name: 2. Dates
topics.content:
# Dates (Sanalarni Aytish)

## Yozish tartibi
- **Britaniya usuli:** kun/oy/yil — 25/12/2026 → 25th December 2026
- **Amerika usuli:** oy/kun/yil — 12/25/2026 → December 25th, 2026

## O'qish tartibi
Sanalar odatda **tartib son (ordinal number)** bilan o'qiladi:
- 1st — first
- 2nd — second
- 3rd — third
- 4th — fourth
- 21st — twenty-first
- 25th — twenty-fifth
- 31st — thirty-first

## Sana aytish namunalari
- December 25th → "**the twenty-fifth of December**" (British) yoki "**December twenty-fifth**" (American)
- 1st January → "**the first of January**"

## Yillarni aytish
- 1990 → nineteen ninety
- 2000 → two thousand
- 2015 → two thousand and fifteen / twenty fifteen
- 2026 → twenty twenty-six

## Predloglar bilan ishlatilishi
- **in** + oy/yil: **in** December, **in** 2026
- **on** + aniq sana/kun: **on** 25th December, **on** Monday
- **at** + aniq vaqt: **at** midnight, **at** 5 o'clock

## Misollar
- My birthday is **on** the 3rd of May. — Mening tug'ilgan kunim 3-may.
- We got married **in** 2020. — Biz 2020-yilda turmush qurganmiz.
- The exam is **on** March 15th. — Imtihon 15-martda.

## Keng tarqalgan xatolar
- ❌ on 2026 → ✅ **in** 2026
- ❌ in Monday → ✅ **on** Monday
- ❌ the two of May → ✅ the **second** of May

## Mashq
1. My birthday is ___ 12th of July.
2. She was born ___ 1998.
3. The party is ___ Saturday.

topics.name: 3. Cardinal and Ordinal Numbers
topics.content:
# Cardinal & Ordinal Numbers (Sanoq va Tartib Sonlar)

## Cardinal Numbers (Sanoq Sonlar) — necha?
Miqdorni bildiradi: one, two, three...

| Raqam | So'z |
|---|---|
| 1 | one |
| 2 | two |
| 10 | ten |
| 11 | eleven |
| 12 | twelve |
| 13 | thirteen |
| 20 | twenty |
| 21 | twenty-one |
| 100 | a/one hundred |
| 1,000 | a/one thousand |
| 1,000,000 | a/one million |

## Ordinal Numbers (Tartib Sonlar) — nechanchi?
Tartibni bildiradi: first, second, third...

| Raqam | So'z |
|---|---|
| 1st | first |
| 2nd | second |
| 3rd | third |
| 4th | fourth |
| 5th | fifth |
| 8th | eighth |
| 9th | ninth |
| 12th | twelfth |
| 20th | twentieth |
| 21st | twenty-first |

## Yasalish qoidasi
Ko'pchilik tartib sonlar cardinal songa **-th** qo'shish orqali yasaladi:
- four → four**th**, six → six**th**, ten → ten**th**

Istisnolar: **first, second, third**, va ulardan hosil bo'lgan qo'shma sonlar (twenty-**first**, thirty-**second**)

## Ishlatilishi
**Cardinal:**
- I have **three** brothers. — Mening uchta akam bor.

**Ordinal:**
- She finished in **first** place. — U birinchi o'rinni egalladi.
- This is my **third** attempt. — Bu mening uchinchi urinishim.
- Today is the **fifth of** May. — Bugun 5-may.

## Keng tarqalgan xatolar
- ❌ the two floor → ✅ the **second** floor
- ❌ fiveth → ✅ **fifth**
- ❌ nineth → ✅ **ninth**

## Mashq
1. He lives on the ___ (5) floor.
2. This is my ___ (1) time here.
3. I bought ___ (21) books.

topics.name: 4. Fractions and Percentages
topics.content:
# Fractions & Percentages (Kasr va Foizlar)

## Fractions (Kasrlar)
Kasrlar odatda **ordinal number** (maxraj) va **cardinal number** (surat) yordamida aytiladi.

| Kasr | Ingliz tilida |
|---|---|
| 1/2 | a half / one half |
| 1/3 | a third / one third |
| 1/4 | a quarter / one fourth |
| 2/3 | two thirds |
| 3/4 | three quarters |
| 1/5 | a fifth / one fifth |

**Qoida:** Agar surat 1 dan katta bo'lsa, maxraj ko'plikda bo'ladi:
- 1/3 → a **third** (birlik)
- 2/3 → two **thirds** (ko'plik, -s qo'shiladi)

## Aralash sonlar (Mixed numbers)
- 1½ — one and a half
- 2¾ — two and three quarters

## Percentages (Foizlar)
"Percent" yoki "per cent" so'zi bilan aytiladi:
- 50% — fifty percent
- 100% — one hundred percent
- 3.5% — three point five percent

## Misollar
- **Half** of the students passed. — O'quvchilarning yarmi o'tdi.
- **Three quarters** of the cake is gone. — Tortning uchdan uch qismi tugagan.
- Prices rose by **ten percent**. — Narxlar o'n foizga oshdi.
- Only **a third** of the work is done. — Ishning faqat uchdan biri bajarilgan.

## O'nlik kasrlar (Decimals)
Nuqta "point" deb o'qiladi, undan keyingi raqamlar bittalab aytiladi:
- 3.5 — three point five
- 0.75 — zero point seven five (yoki nought point seven five — British)

## Keng tarqalgan xatolar
- ❌ two third → ✅ two **thirds**
- ❌ fifty percents → ✅ fifty **percent** (ko'plik shakli yo'q)

## Mashq
1. 1/4 → ___
2. 3/5 → ___
3. 75% → ___

topics.name: 1. Yes-No Questions
topics.content:
# Yes/No Questions (Ha/Yo'q Savollari)

## Ta'rif
Javobi faqat "Ha" yoki "Yo'q" bo'ladigan savollar. Auxiliary (yordamchi) fe'l gap boshiga chiqariladi.

## Tuzilish formulasi
**Auxiliary fe'l + ega + asosiy fe'l + ...?**

## Zamonlar bo'yicha misollar

**Present Simple:**
- **Do** you like coffee? — Yes, I do. / No, I don't.
- **Does** she work here? — Yes, she does. / No, she doesn't.

**Past Simple:**
- **Did** you go to school? — Yes, I did. / No, I didn't.

**Present Continuous:**
- **Are** you studying? — Yes, I am. / No, I'm not.

**Present Perfect:**
- **Have** you finished? — Yes, I have. / No, I haven't.

**To be fe'li bilan:**
- **Is** she a teacher? — Yes, she is. / No, she isn't.
- **Are** they students? — Yes, they are. / No, they aren't.

**Modal fe'llar bilan:**
- **Can** you swim? — Yes, I can. / No, I can't.
- **Should** I call him? — Yes, you should. / No, you shouldn't.

## Muhim qoida
Agar gapda "be" fe'li yoki modal fe'l bo'lsa, "do/does/did" qo'shilmaydi — ular o'zlari gap boshiga chiqadi.

## Keng tarqalgan xatolar
- ❌ Do you are hungry? → ✅ **Are** you hungry?
- ❌ Does she can swim? → ✅ **Can** she swim?
- ❌ You like coffee? (auxiliary yo'q) → ✅ **Do** you like coffee?

## Mashq
1. ___ you speak English? (Do/Are)
2. ___ she watching TV now? (Does/Is)
3. ___ they finished the project? (Have/Do)

topics.name: 2. Wh-Questions
topics.content:
# Wh-Questions (Ma'lumot So'rovchi Savollar)

## Ta'rif
Aniq ma'lumot olish uchun so'raladigan savollar — what, where, when, who, why, how, which, whose bilan boshlanadi.

## So'roq so'zlari

| So'z | Ma'nosi | Misol |
|---|---|---|
| What | nima | **What** is your name? |
| Where | qayerda | **Where** do you live? |
| When | qachon | **When** does the film start? |
| Who | kim | **Who** is that man? |
| Whom | kimni (rasmiy) | **Whom** did you see? |
| Whose | kimniki | **Whose** book is this? |
| Why | nima uchun | **Why** are you late? |
| How | qanday | **How** are you? |
| Which | qaysi | **Which** color do you prefer? |
| How much/many | qancha/nechta | **How much** does it cost? |

## Tuzilish formulasi
**Wh-so'z + auxiliary fe'l + ega + asosiy fe'l + ...?**

## Misollar
- **What** do you do? — Siz nima ish qilasiz?
- **Where** did you go yesterday? — Kecha qayerga borgan eding?
- **Why** is she crying? — U nega yig'layapti?
- **How** does this machine work? — Bu mashina qanday ishlaydi?
- **How much** is this shirt? — Bu ko'ylak qancha turadi?
- **How many** brothers do you have? — Nechta akang bor?

## Muhim eslatma: Ega haqida savol berish
Agar savol egaga qaratilgan bo'lsa, auxiliary ishlatilmaydi:
- **Who** called you? (Who — ega) — auxiliary yo'q
- **Whom** did you call? (Whom — to'ldiruvchi) — auxiliary "did" bor

## Keng tarqalgan xatolar
- ❌ What means this word? → ✅ **What does** this word **mean**?
- ❌ Who did call you? → ✅ **Who called** you? (ega uchun auxiliary kerak emas)

## Mashq
1. ___ is your favorite food?
2. ___ did you finish your homework?
3. ___ made this noise? (Who/What)

topics.name: 3. Subject vs Object Questions
topics.content:
# Subject vs Object Questions

## Ta'rif
Savollar ikki turga bo'linadi: ega haqidagi savol (subject question) va to'ldiruvchi haqidagi savol (object question). Bu ikkisining tuzilishi farq qiladi.

## Subject Question (Ega Haqida Savol)
Savol so'zi gapning **egasi** o'rniga qo'yiladi. Auxiliary fe'l (do/does/did) **ishlatilmaydi**.

Formula: **Wh-so'z (ega) + fe'l + ...?**

- **Who** broke the window? — Kim derazani sindirdi? (Tom broke the window → Who broke...)
- **What** happened? — Nima bo'ldi?
- **Which** team won? — Qaysi jamoa yutdi?

## Object Question (To'ldiruvchi Haqida Savol)
Savol so'zi gapning **to'ldiruvchisi** o'rniga qo'yiladi. Auxiliary fe'l **kerak bo'ladi**.

Formula: **Wh-so'z (obyekt) + auxiliary + ega + fe'l + ...?**

- **Who(m)** did Tom see? — Tom kimni ko'rdi? (Tom saw Sarah → Who did Tom see?)
- **What** did she buy? — U nima sotib oldi?
- **Which** book did you read? — Qaysi kitobni o'qiding?

## Solishtirma jadval

| Gap | Ega haqida savol | Obyekt haqida savol |
|---|---|---|
| Tom called Mary. | **Who** called Mary? | **Who(m)** did Tom call? |
| The dog bit the man. | **What** bit the man? | **What** did the dog bite? |

## Qanday farqlash mumkin
Asl gapni tasavvur qiling — agar savol so'zi fe'ldan **oldin** kelgan so'zni almashtirsa (ega), auxiliary kerak emas. Agar fe'ldan **keyingi** so'zni almashtirsa (obyekt), auxiliary kerak.

## Keng tarqalgan xatolar
- ❌ Who did break the window? → ✅ **Who broke** the window? (ega uchun "did" ishlatilmaydi)
- ❌ What Tom bought? → ✅ **What did Tom buy**? (obyekt uchun "did" kerak)

## Mashq
1. ___ (Who/Who did) wrote this book?
2. ___ (What/What did) you cook for dinner?
3. ___ (Who/Whom did) you meet at the party?

topics.name: 4. Question Tags
topics.content:
# Question Tags (Tasdiqlash Savollari)

## Ta'rif
Gap oxiriga qo'shiladigan qisqa savol — tinglovchidan tasdiqlash yoki rozilik olish uchun ishlatiladi. O'zbek tilidagi "shundaymi?", "to'g'rimi?" ga to'g'ri keladi.

## Asosiy qoida
**Agar bosh gap ijobiy bo'lsa → tag inkor bo'ladi.**
**Agar bosh gap inkor bo'lsa → tag ijobiy bo'ladi.**

## Misollar

**Ijobiy gap + inkor tag:**
- You **are** a student, **aren't you**? — Siz talabasiz, shunday emasmi?
- She **likes** coffee, **doesn't she**? — U qahvani yoqtiradi, shunday emasmi?
- They **have** finished, **haven't they**? — Ular tugatishdi, shunday emasmi?

**Inkor gap + ijobiy tag:**
- You **aren't** tired, **are you**? — Siz charchamagansiz, shundaymi?
- She **doesn't** like tea, **does she**? — U choyni yoqtirmaydi, shundaymi?

## Maxsus holatlar

- **I am** → tag: **aren't I?** (am not emas!)
  - I am late, **aren't I**?
- **Let's** → tag: **shall we?**
  - Let's go, **shall we**?
- **Imperative (buyruq)** → tag: **will you?**
  - Close the door, **will you**?
- Modal fe'llar bilan (can, should, must...): o'sha modal takrorlanadi
  - You can swim, **can't you**?

## Ohang (intonatsiya)
- Tushuvchi ohang — haqiqatan tasdiqlash so'rayapti (savol emas, taxminan bilgan holda so'raydi)
- Ko'tariluvchi ohang — haqiqiy savol, javobga ishonchi yo'q

## Keng tarqalgan xatolar
- ❌ You are happy, are you? → ✅ You are happy, **aren't you**?
- ❌ She doesn't smoke, doesn't she? → ✅ She doesn't smoke, **does she**?

## Mashq
1. It's a nice day, ___?
2. You don't smoke, ___?
3. Let's go to the cinema, ___?

topics.name: 5. Indirect Questions
topics.content:
# Indirect Questions (Bilvosita Savollar)

## Ta'rif
Savolni yumshoqroq, rasmiyroq shaklda berish uchun ishlatiladi. Odatda quyidagi iboralar bilan boshlanadi: "Could you tell me...", "Do you know...", "I wonder...", "I'd like to know..."

## Muhim qoida: SO'Z TARTIBI O'ZGARADI
Bilvosita savolda **savol tartibi emas, darak gap tartibi** ishlatiladi (auxiliary ega bilan joy almashmaydi).

## To'g'ridan-to'g'ri va bilvosita savol solishtirmasi

| To'g'ridan-to'g'ri savol | Bilvosita savol |
|---|---|
| Where **is** the station? | Could you tell me where **the station is**? |
| What **time is** it? | Do you know what **time it is**? |
| **Does** she **work** here? | I wonder if she **works** here. |
| **Is** he coming? | Do you know if he **is coming**? |

## Yes/No savollar uchun "if/whether" ishlatiladi
- **Is** he married? → Do you know **if** he **is married**?
- **Did** she call? → I wonder **whether** she **called**.

## Wh-savollar uchun so'roq so'zi saqlanadi, lekin tartib o'zgaradi
- Where **does he live**? → Can you tell me where **he lives**?
- What **did she say**? → I'd like to know what **she said**.

## Ishlatiladigan boshlang'ich iboralar
- Could you tell me...?
- Do you know...?
- I wonder...
- I'd like to know...
- Can you explain...?

## Keng tarqalgan xatolar
- ❌ Could you tell me where is the bank? → ✅ Could you tell me where **the bank is**?
- ❌ Do you know does she live here? → ✅ Do you know **if** she **lives** here?
- ❌ I wonder what is the time. → ✅ I wonder what **the time is**.

## Mashq
1. Could you tell me ___ (where is the museum / where the museum is)?
2. Do you know ___ (if he is coming / is he coming)?
3. I wonder ___ (what time does it start / what time it starts).

topics.name: 1. Not Don't Doesn't
topics.content:
# Not / Don't / Doesn't (Oddiy Inkor)

## Ta'rif
Inkor gaplar harakat yoki holatning bo'lmaganini bildiradi. Zamonga qarab turli auxiliary fe'llar + "not" ishlatiladi.

## Present Simple'da inkor
- I/You/We/They + **don't** + fe'l
- He/She/It + **doesn't** + fe'l

Misollar:
- I **don't** like fish. — Men baliqni yoqtirmayman.
- She **doesn't** work on Sundays. — U yakshanba kunlari ishlamaydi.

## To be fe'li bilan inkor
- I **am not** (I'm not)
- You/We/They **are not** (aren't)
- He/She/It **is not** (isn't)

Misol: She **isn't** at home. — U uyda emas.

## Boshqa zamonlarda
- Past Simple: I **didn't** go. — Men bormadim.
- Present Continuous: She **isn't** working. — U ishlamayapti.
- Present Perfect: I **haven't** finished. — Men tugatmadim.
- Future: I **won't** come. — Men kelmayman.

## Qisqartma shakllar
| To'liq | Qisqartma |
|---|---|
| do not | don't |
| does not | doesn't |
| did not | didn't |
| is not | isn't |
| are not | aren't |
| will not | won't |
| have not | haven't |

## Keng tarqalgan xatolar
- ❌ She don't like it. → ✅ She **doesn't** like it.
- ❌ I not like it. → ✅ I **don't** like it.
- ❌ She doesn't likes it. → ✅ She **doesn't like** it. (doesn't dan keyin fe'l -s olmaydi)

## Mashq
1. He ___ (don't/doesn't) play football.
2. I ___ (am not/isn't) hungry.
3. They ___ (didn't/doesn't) come yesterday.

topics.name: 2. Never No None
topics.content:
# Never, No, None (Kuchli Inkor So'zlari)

## Ta'rif
Bu so'zlar o'zlari inkor ma'no bildiradi — shuning uchun ular bilan gapda qo'shimcha "not" ishlatilmaydi (fe'l ijobiy shaklda qoladi).

## Never (hech qachon)
Vaqtga oid inkor — "hech qachon" ma'nosida:
- I **never** eat meat. — Men hech qachon go'sht yemayman.
- She has **never** been to Paris. — U hech qachon Parijda bo'lmagan.

## No (hech qanday, yo'q)
Otdan oldin keladi, "not any" bilan bir xil ma'noni beradi:
- I have **no** money. = I **don't** have **any** money. — Menda pul yo'q.
- There is **no** food left. — Ovqat qolmagan.

## None (hech biri)
Mustaqil ishlatiladi (ot o'rnini bosadi), guruhning hech bir a'zosi degan ma'noda:
- **None** of the students passed. — O'quvchilarning hech biri o'tmadi.
- I asked everyone, but **none** knew the answer. — Hammadan so'radim, lekin hech kim javobni bilmadi.

## Muhim qoida: Double Negative bo'lmaydi
Bu so'zlar allaqachon inkor ma'no berganligi uchun, ular bilan bir gapda yana "not" ishlatilmaydi:
- ❌ I don't never eat meat.
- ✅ I **never** eat meat.

## Solishtirish jadvali

| Ijobiy tuzilma | Ekvivalent inkor tuzilma |
|---|---|
| don't have any | have **no** |
| doesn't ever | **never** |
| not any of them | **none** of them |

## Keng tarqalgan xatolar
- ❌ I have not no money. → ✅ I have **no** money.
- ❌ She doesn't never smile. → ✅ She **never** smiles.

## Mashq
1. He has ___ (no/not) friends here.
2. I ___ (never/not never) watch horror films.
3. ___ (None/No) of them called me.

topics.name: 3. Double Negatives
topics.content:
# Double Negatives (Ikki Marta Inkor — Xato Holat)

## Ta'rif
Standart ingliz tilida bir gapda **ikkita inkor so'z** ishlatish grammatik xato hisoblanadi (o'zbek tilidan farqli o'laroq, bu yerda "hech kim kelmadi" kabi qo'sh inkor tabiiy emas).

## Nega bu xato?
O'zbek tilida: "Men hech narsa **yemadim**" — ikkita inkor tabiiy.
Ingliz tilida: faqat **bitta** inkor elementi bo'lishi kerak.

## Xato va to'g'ri variantlar

| ❌ Xato (double negative) | ✅ To'g'ri |
|---|---|
| I don't know nothing. | I **don't know anything**. / I **know nothing**. |
| She doesn't have no money. | She **doesn't have any money**. / She **has no money**. |
| He didn't say nothing. | He **didn't say anything**. |
| I can't get no satisfaction. | I **can't get any satisfaction**. |
| Nobody doesn't like him. | **Nobody likes** him. |

## Qoida
Agar gapda **not/don't/doesn't/didn't/can't** kabi inkor auxiliary bo'lsa, undan keyin **any-, never, nothing, nobody** emas, balki **any-** guruhi (anything, anyone, anywhere) ishlatiladi:
- I don't have **anything**. (nothing emas)
- She didn't see **anyone**. (no one emas)

Agar gapda inkor so'z (no, never, nothing, nobody) allaqachon bo'lsa, fe'l **ijobiy** shaklda qoladi:
- **Nothing** happened. (Nothing didn't happen emas)
- **Nobody** came. (Nobody didn't come emas)

## Muhim eslatma
Ayrim she'riy, dialektal yoki og'zaki (norasmiy, slang) ingliz tilida double negative uchraydi (masalan qo'shiqlarda "I can't get no satisfaction"), lekin bu **grammatik jihatdan noto'g'ri** va yozma/rasmiy tilda ishlatilmaydi.

## Mashq (xatoni tuzating)
1. I don't want nothing. → ___
2. She doesn't know nobody here. → ___
3. We didn't go nowhere. → ___

topics.name: 1. Imperatives
topics.content:
# Imperatives (Buyruq Gaplar)

## Ta'rif
Buyruq, taklif, ko'rsatma yoki iltimos bildirish uchun ishlatiladi. Ega (you) odatda tushirib qoldiriladi, fe'l bazaviy (infinitive without "to") shaklda ishlatiladi.

## Ijobiy shakl
**Fe'l (bazaviy shakl) + ...**
- **Open** the door. — Eshikni oching.
- **Sit** down, please. — O'tiring, iltimos.
- **Be** quiet! — Jim bo'ling!

## Inkor shakl
**Don't + fe'l**
- **Don't** touch that! — Buni ushlamang!
- **Don't** be late. — Kech qolmang.
- **Never** give up. — Hech qachon taslim bo'lmang.

## Yumshoqroq buyruq berish
Qo'pol eshitilmasligi uchun "please" qo'shiladi yoki savol shaklida beriladi:
- **Please** close the window. — Iltimos, derazani yoping.
- **Could you** close the window, please? — Derazani yopa olasizmi, iltimos?

## "Let's" bilan taklif
Birgalikdagi harakatni taklif qilish uchun:
- **Let's** go to the park. — Bog'ga boraylik.
- **Let's not** argue. — Janjallashmaylik.

## Ishlatilish sohalari
1. Ko'rsatmalar: **Turn** left at the corner.
2. Ogohlantirish: **Watch out**!
3. Retseptlar: **Add** two eggs and **mix** well.
4. Taklif/maslahat: **Try** this cake, it's delicious.

## Keng tarqalgan xatolar
- ❌ You open the door. (buyruqda "you" kerak emas) → ✅ **Open** the door.
- ❌ Not touch that. → ✅ **Don't touch** that.
- ❌ Opens the door. (fe'l -s olmaydi) → ✅ **Open** the door.

## Mashq
1. ___ (Close/Closes) the window, please.
2. ___ (Don't/Not) forget your keys.
3. ___ (Let's/Lets) watch a movie tonight.

topics.name: 2. Let's Let us
topics.content:
# Let's / Let us (Taklif Gaplar)

## Ta'rif
"Let's" — "let us" ning qisqartmasi, birgalikda biror ish qilishni taklif qilish uchun ishlatiladi ("keling, ...aylik" ma'nosida).

## Ijobiy shakl
**Let's + fe'l (bazaviy shakl)**
- **Let's go** to the cinema. — Keling, kinoga boraylik.
- **Let's eat** something. — Keling, biror narsa yeylik.
- **Let's start** the meeting. — Keling, yig'ilishni boshlaylik.

## Inkor shakl
**Let's not + fe'l**
- **Let's not** waste time. — Keling, vaqtni behuda sarflamaylik.
- **Let's not** talk about it now. — Keling, bu haqda hozir gaplashmaylik.

## "Let's" vs "Let us" — farqi
- **Let's** — norasmiy, kundalik nutqda, taklif ma'nosida (juda keng tarqalgan)
- **Let us** — to'liq shakl, ko'proq rasmiy yoki "ruxsat bering" ma'nosida ishlatiladi:
  - **Let us** know if you need help. — Agar yordam kerak bo'lsa, bizga xabar bering. (bu yerda "us" — bizga, "let" — ruxsat bering)

## Javob berish (rozilik/norozilik)
- Let's go to the beach! — **Yes, let's!** / **Good idea!** / **Sorry, I can't.**

## Question tag bilan
- Let's go, **shall we**?

## Keng tarqalgan xatolar
- ❌ Let's to go. → ✅ **Let's go**. ("to" kerak emas)
- ❌ Let's not to argue. → ✅ **Let's not argue**.
- ❌ Lets go (apostrofsiz) → ✅ **Let's** go.

## Mashq
1. ___ (Let's/Let's to) have some tea.
2. ___ (Let's not/Not let's) be late.
3. Let's go for a walk, ___? (shall we/will we)

topics.name: 3. Exclamative Sentences
topics.content:
# Exclamative Sentences (Undov Gaplar)

## Ta'rif
Kuchli hissiyot (hayrat, xursandchilik, g'azab, ta'sirlanish) ifodalash uchun ishlatiladigan gaplar. Odatda **What** yoki **How** bilan boshlanadi va undov belgisi (!) bilan tugaydi.

## What bilan yasalish

**Formula 1:** What + a/an + sifat + ot (birlik, sanaladigan)!
- **What a** beautiful day**!** — Qanday go'zal kun!
- **What an** amazing idea**!** — Qanday ajoyib fikr!

**Formula 2:** What + sifat + ot (ko'plik yoki sanalmaydigan)!
- **What** delicious food**!** — Qanday mazali ovqat!
- **What** nice people**!** — Qanday yaxshi odamlar!

## How bilan yasalish

**Formula:** How + sifat/ravish (+ ega + fe'l)!
- **How** beautiful**!** — Qanday chiroyli!
- **How** beautiful she is**!** — U qanday chiroyli!
- **How** fast he runs**!** — U qanday tez yuguradi!

## What vs How farqi
- **What** — otdan oldin ishlatiladi (a/an bilan yoki bo'lmasdan)
- **How** — sifat yoki ravishdan oldin ishlatiladi (ot ishlatilmaydi)

| What tuzilmasi | How tuzilmasi |
|---|---|
| What a nice house! | How nice the house is! |
| What lovely flowers! | How lovely the flowers are! |

## Boshqa undov turlari
- Oddiy undov so'zlar: **Wow!**, **Ouch!**, **Oh no!**, **Great!**
- To'liq gap bilan: **I can't believe it!**, **That's amazing!**

## Keng tarqalgan xatolar
- ❌ What beautiful day! (birlik, sanaladigan ot uchun "a" kerak) → ✅ **What a** beautiful day!
- ❌ How a beautiful day! → ✅ **What a** beautiful day! / **How beautiful** the day is!
- ❌ What nice she is! → ✅ **How nice** she is!

## Mashq
1. ___ a wonderful surprise!
2. ___ tall he is!
3. ___ delicious this soup is!

topics.name: 1. Prepositions
topics.content:
# Prepositions: In, On, At (Vaqt va Joy Predloglari)

## Ta'rif
Predloglar (prepositions) — vaqt, joy, yo'nalish va boshqa munosabatlarni bildiruvchi so'zlar. Eng ko'p ishlatiladigani: in, on, at.

## VAQT uchun

**AT** — aniq vaqt bilan:
- **at** 5 o'clock, **at** noon, **at** midnight, **at** night

**ON** — kunlar va sanalar bilan:
- **on** Monday, **on** 25th December, **on** my birthday

**IN** — oy, yil, fasl, uzoqroq davrlar bilan:
- **in** May, **in** 2026, **in** summer, **in** the morning/afternoon/evening

Eslatma: **at night** — istisno (in the night emas)

## JOY uchun

**AT** — aniq nuqta (manzil, tadbir):
- **at** the door, **at** the bus stop, **at** home, **at** school, **at** the party

**ON** — sirt ustida:
- **on** the table, **on** the wall, **on** the second floor, **on** the bus/train

**IN** — ichida, katta hudud:
- **in** the box, **in** the room, **in** Tashkent, **in** the car

## Solishtirma jadval

| | Vaqt | Joy |
|---|---|---|
| AT | aniq vaqt (at 5 PM) | aniq nuqta (at the station) |
| ON | kun/sana (on Monday) | sirt (on the desk) |
| IN | oy/yil/fasl (in June) | ichida/hudud (in the city) |

## Boshqa keng tarqalgan predloglar
- **under, over, above, below** — pastda/tepada
- **between, among** — orasida
- **in front of, behind** — oldida/orqasida
- **next to, near, beside** — yonida

## Keng tarqalgan xatolar
- ❌ at Monday → ✅ **on** Monday
- ❌ in 5 o'clock → ✅ **at** 5 o'clock
- ❌ on the morning → ✅ **in** the morning
- ❌ in night → ✅ **at** night

## Mashq
1. I have a meeting ___ Friday.
2. She was born ___ 1995.
3. Let's meet ___ the entrance ___ 6 PM.

topics.name: 2. Linking Words
topics.content:
# Linking Words (Bog'lovchi So'zlar)

## Ta'rif
Gaplarni yoki fikrlarni bir-biriga bog'lash uchun ishlatiladigan so'zlar. Ular fikrlar orasidagi mantiqiy munosabatni ko'rsatadi (qarama-qarshilik, sabab, natija, qo'shimcha).

## Turlari va misollar

**1. Qarama-qarshilik (Contrast) — However, Although, But, Despite**
- I was tired. **However**, I finished the work. — Men charchagan edim. Biroq, ishni tugatdim.
- **Although** it was raining, we went out. — Yomg'ir yog'ayotgan bo'lsa-da, biz tashqariga chiqdik.
- **Despite** the rain, we went out. — Yomg'irga qaramay, biz tashqariga chiqdik.

**2. Sabab (Reason) — Because, Since, As**
- I stayed home **because** I was sick. — Men kasal bo'lganim uchun uyda qoldim.
- **Since** you're here, let's talk. — Siz bu yerda bo'lganingiz uchun, gaplashaylik.

**3. Natija (Result) — So, Therefore, As a result**
- It was raining, **so** we stayed home. — Yomg'ir yog'ayotgan edi, shuning uchun uyda qoldik.
- He didn't study. **Therefore**, he failed. — U o'qimadi. Shu sababli, yiqildi.

**4. Qo'shimcha (Addition) — And, Also, In addition, Moreover**
- She is smart **and** hardworking. — U aqlli va mehnatsevar.
- **Moreover**, she speaks three languages. — Bundan tashqari, u uch tilda gapiradi.

## Grammatik farq: Although vs Despite/In spite of
- **Although/Even though** + ega + fe'l (to'liq gap): **Although** it rained, we went out.
- **Despite/In spite of** + ot/gerund: **Despite** the rain, we went out. / **Despite raining**, we went out.

## Keng tarqalgan xatolar
- ❌ Despite it was raining. → ✅ **Despite the rain** / **Although it was raining**.
- ❌ Because of she was late, she missed the bus. → ✅ **Because she was late**... / **Because of her lateness**...

## Mashq
1. ___ (Although/Despite) he is young, he is very wise.
2. She was late ___ (because/because of) the traffic.
3. It was expensive. ___ (However/Because), we bought it.

topics.name: 1. Some vs Any
topics.content:
# Some vs Any

## Ta'rif
Ikkalasi ham "biroz, ba'zi" ma'nosini bildiradi, lekin gap turiga qarab farqlanadi.

## Asosiy qoida
- **Some** — ijobiy (darak) gaplarda
- **Any** — inkor va so'roq gaplarda

## Misollar

**Some (darak gaplar):**
- I have **some** money. — Menda biroz pul bor.
- There are **some** books on the table. — Stolda bir nechta kitob bor.

**Any (inkor gaplar):**
- I don't have **any** money. — Menda hech qanday pul yo'q.
- There aren't **any** books here. — Bu yerda hech qanday kitob yo'q.

**Any (so'roq gaplar):**
- Do you have **any** questions? — Sizda savollar bormi?
- Is there **any** milk left? — Biroz sut qolganmi?

## Muhim istisno: Taklif va iltimosda "some"
So'roq gap bo'lsa-da, taklif qilish yoki iltimos qilishda **some** ishlatiladi:
- Would you like **some** tea? — Choy ichasizmi? (taklif)
- Can I have **some** water, please? — Menga biroz suv bera olasizmi? (iltimos)

## Some-/Any- bilan hosil bo'lgan so'zlar
- somebody/anybody, something/anything, somewhere/anywhere — xuddi shu qoida bo'yicha ishlatiladi.

## Keng tarqalgan xatolar
- ❌ I don't have some money. → ✅ I don't have **any** money.
- ❌ Do you have some questions? (odatiy so'roqda) → ✅ Do you have **any** questions?
- ❌ Can I have any water? (iltimosda) → ✅ Can I have **some** water?

## Mashq
1. There isn't ___ (some/any) sugar left.
2. Would you like ___ (some/any) coffee?
3. Do you need ___ (some/any) help?

topics.name: 2. Much vs Many
topics.content:
# Much vs Many

## Ta'rif
Ikkalasi ham "ko'p" ma'nosini bildiradi, lekin otning turiga qarab tanlanadi.

## Qoida
- **Many** + sanaladigan ko'plik ot (countable)
- **Much** + sanalmaydigan ot (uncountable)

## Misollar

**Many:**
- There are **many** students in the class. — Sinfda ko'p o'quvchi bor.
- I don't have **many** friends. — Mening ko'p do'stim yo'q.
- **How many** books did you read? — Nechta kitob o'qiding?

**Much:**
- I don't have **much** time. — Mening ko'p vaqtim yo'q.
- She doesn't drink **much** water. — U ko'p suv ichmaydi.
- **How much** money do you need? — Sizga qancha pul kerak?

## Muhim eslatma
"Much" asosan **inkor va so'roq** gaplarda ishlatiladi. Ijobiy (darak) gaplarda odatda **a lot of** ishlatiladi:
- ❌ I have much money. (norasmiy holatda kamdan-kam ishlatiladi)
- ✅ I have **a lot of** money. (tabiiyroq)
- ✅ I don't have **much** money. (inkorda tabiiy)
- ✅ **How much** money do you have? (so'roqda tabiiy)

## Solishtirma jadval

| | Sanaladigan (Countable) | Sanalmaydigan (Uncountable) |
|---|---|---|
| Ijobiy | many / a lot of | a lot of |
| Inkor | many / a lot of | much |
| So'roq | How many? | How much? |

## Keng tarqalgan xatolar
- ❌ How much books? → ✅ **How many** books?
- ❌ How many water? → ✅ **How much** water?
- ❌ I have much books. → ✅ I have **many** books.

## Mashq
1. ___ (How much/How many) people came to the party?
2. I don't have ___ (much/many) experience.
3. She has ___ (much/many) friends in London.

topics.name: 3. A lot of Lots of
topics.content:
# A lot of / Lots of (Universal Miqdor So'zi)

## Ta'rif
"A lot of" va "lots of" — "ko'p" ma'nosini bildiradi va **ham sanaladigan, ham sanalmaydigan** otlar bilan ishlatiladi. Ular many/much ga qaraganda ko'proq norasmiy va keng qo'llaniladi.

## Ishlatilishi

**Sanaladigan otlar bilan:**
- I have **a lot of** friends. — Mening ko'p do'stlarim bor.
- There are **lots of** apples in the basket. — Savatda ko'p olma bor.

**Sanalmaydigan otlar bilan:**
- She has **a lot of** money. — Uning ko'p puli bor.
- We drank **lots of** water. — Biz ko'p suv ichdik.

## A lot of vs Lots of — farqi
Amalda ma'no jihatidan farq yo'q, ikkalasi ham bir xil:
- **a lot of** — biroz ko'proq neytral/keng qo'llaniladigan
- **lots of** — yanada norasmiy, og'zaki nutqda ko'proq

## "A lot" (of siz) — ravish sifatida
Fe'ldan keyin, "of" siz ishlatilganda, "juda ko'p" ma'nosini beradi:
- I like her **a lot**. — Men uni juda yoqtiraman.
- Thanks **a lot**! — Katta rahmat!

## Ijobiy gapda: many/much o'rniga
Darak gaplarda "a lot of" — "much/many" dan ko'ra tabiiyroq va keng tarqalgan:
- ✅ I have **a lot of** work today. (much/many dan tabiiyroq)

## Keng tarqalgan xatolar
- ❌ a lot of an apples → ✅ **a lot of** apples
- ❌ I like it a lot of. → ✅ I like it **a lot**. ("of" kerak emas, ot yo'q bo'lsa)

## Mashq
1. There are ___ (a lot of/much) tourists in this city.
2. I don't have ___ (a lot of/lot of) time today.
3. Thank you ___ (a lot/a lot of) for your help!

topics.name: 4. Few vs Little
topics.content:
# Few vs Little (Kam Miqdor)

## Ta'rif
"Kam" ma'nosini bildiradi, ammo otning turiga qarab tanlanadi. Har birining ham ijobiy, ham salbiy ma'noli varianti bor.

## Qoida
- **Few** + sanaladigan ko'plik ot (countable)
- **Little** + sanalmaydigan ot (uncountable)

## Salbiy ma'no (deyarli yo'q, yetarli emas)
- I have **few** friends here. — Mening bu yerda deyarli do'stim yo'q. (kam, achinarli)
- We have **little** time. — Bizda deyarli vaqt yo'q. (yetarli emas)

## Ijobiy ma'no: "a few" / "a little"
Oldiga **"a"** qo'shilsa, ma'no ijobiy tomonga o'zgaradi — "bir oz bor, yetarli" degan ma'noda:
- I have **a few** friends here. — Mening bu yerda bir necha do'stim bor. (yetarlicha, ijobiy)
- We have **a little** time. — Bizda biroz vaqt bor. (yetarli, ijobiy)

## Solishtirma jadval

| | Sanaladigan | Sanalmaydigan |
|---|---|---|
| Kam, deyarli yo'q (salbiy) | **few** | **little** |
| Biroz bor, yetarli (ijobiy) | **a few** | **a little** |

## Misollar
- **Few** people understood the lecture. — Odamlarning kami tushundi ma'ruzani. (achinarli)
- **A few** people understood the lecture. — Bir necha kishi tushundi. (neytral/ijobiy)
- There's **little** hope left. — Umid deyarli qolmagan.
- There's **a little** hope left. — Biroz umid bor.

## Keng tarqalgan xatolar
- ❌ I have a few money. → ✅ I have **a little** money. (money — sanalmaydigan)
- ❌ few water → ✅ **little** water
- ❌ little books → ✅ **few** books

## Mashq
1. She has ___ (few/little) patience with children.
2. I have ___ (a few/a little) questions to ask.
3. There is ___ (few/little) milk left in the fridge.

topics.name: 5. All vs Whole
topics.content:
# All vs Whole (Barcha / Butun)

## Ta'rif
Ikkalasi ham "hamma, butun" ma'nosini bildiradi, lekin gap tuzilishida farqlanadi.

## All — qoidasi
**All** + (the) + ko'plik ot / sanalmaydigan ot:
- **All** students must attend. — Barcha o'quvchilar qatnashishi shart.
- **All** the water is gone. — Barcha suv tugadi.
- **All of** my friends came. — Barcha do'stlarim keldi.

## Whole — qoidasi
**Whole** — birlik ot bilan ishlatiladi, "the/a/my" kabi determiner **whole**'dan oldin keladi:
- The **whole** cake was eaten. — Butun tort yeyilgan.
- I read the **whole** book in one day. — Men butun kitobni bir kunda o'qidim.
- She spent her **whole** life here. — U butun umrini shu yerda o'tkazdi.

## Asosiy farq

| All | Whole |
|---|---|
| **All** the students (ko'plik) | The **whole** class (birlik) |
| **All** the water (sanalmaydigan) | The **whole** bottle (birlik ot) |
| Determinerdan oldin keladi (all the) | Determinerdan keyin keladi (the whole) |

## Vaqt so'zlari bilan
- **All** day / **all** night / **all** year — kun/tun/yil davomida
- The **whole** day / the **whole** night — butun kun/tun

Ikkalasi ham deyarli bir xil ma'noda ishlatiladi vaqt bilan:
- I worked **all day**. = I worked the **whole day**.

## Keng tarqalgan xatolar
- ❌ The all cake → ✅ The **whole** cake / **All** the cake
- ❌ Whole students → ✅ **All** students / The **whole** class
- ❌ All my whole life → ✅ **All my life** / My **whole life**

## Mashq
1. I spent ___ (all/whole) my money on books.
2. She ate the ___ (all/whole) pizza by herself.
3. ___ (All/Whole) the guests enjoyed the party.

topics.name: 1. Order of Adjectives
topics.content:
# Order of Adjectives (Sifatlarning Ketma-ketligi — OSASCOMP)

## Ta'rif
Bir otdan oldin bir nechta sifat ishlatilganda, ular qat'iy tartibda joylashadi. Bu tartib **OSASCOMP** qisqartmasi bilan yodda saqlanadi.

## OSASCOMP tartibi

| Tartib | Ingliz nomi | Misol |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | **O**pinion (fikr) | beautiful, ugly, nice |
| 2 | **S**ize (o'lcham) | big, small, tall |
| 3 | **A**ge (yosh) | old, young, new |
| 4 | **S**hape (shakl) | round, square |
| 5 | **C**olor (rang) | red, blue, black |
| 6 | **O**rigin (kelib chiqishi) | French, Uzbek, Japanese |
| 7 | **M**aterial (material) | wooden, cotton, metal |
| 8 | **P**urpose (maqsad) | sleeping (bag), cooking (oil) |

## Misollar
