- a **beautiful** (opinion) **small** (size) **old** (age) **French** (origin) **wooden** (material) table
- a **lovely** (opinion) **little** (size) **red** (color) sports car
- an **old** (age) **round** (shape) **wooden** (material) table

## Amaliy misollar to'liq gapda
- She bought a **nice big new** house. — U yoqimli, katta, yangi uy sotib oldi. (opinion-size-age)
- I saw a **strange small black** cat. — Men g'alati kichkina qora mushukni ko'rdim. (opinion-size-color)

## Muhim eslatma
Odatda 2-3 tadan ortiq sifat bir vaqtda ishlatilmaydi — bu tabiiy emas. Ko'pincha eng ko'p ishlatiladigan kombinatsiya: **opinion + size + color/age + noun**.

## Keng tarqalgan xatolar
- ❌ a wooden old table → ✅ an **old wooden** table (age → material tartibida)
- ❌ a red big car → ✅ a **big red** car (size → color tartibida)

## Mashq (to'g'ri tartibni tuzing)
1. (leather / black / new) jacket → ___
2. (French / delicious / old) cheese → ___
3. (round / small / wooden) box → ___

topics.name: 2. -ed vs -ing Adjectives
topics.content:
# -ed vs -ing Adjectives (Bored vs Boring)

## Ta'rif
Fe'ldan yasalgan sifatlar ikki xil shaklga ega bo'lishi mumkin: **-ing** va **-ed**. Ular butunlay boshqa ma'noni bildiradi.

## Qoida

**-ING sifatlar** — narsaning/vaziyatning **xususiyatini** bildiradi (narsa "his qiladigan"):
- The film is **boring**. — Film zerikarli. (film o'zi zerikarli xususiyatga ega)
- This book is **interesting**. — Bu kitob qiziqarli.

**-ED sifatlar** — shaxsning **his qilishini/holatini** bildiradi (odam nima "his qiladi"):
- I am **bored**. — Men zerikkanman. (men zerikish hissini boshdan kechiryapman)
- I am **interested** in this book. — Men bu kitobga qiziqaman.

## Solishtirish
- The lecture was **boring**, so the students were **bored**.
  — Ma'ruza zerikarli edi, shuning uchun o'quvchilar zerikishdi.

## Keng ishlatiladigan juftliklar

| -ING (sabab/xususiyat) | -ED (his/holat) |
|---|---|
| boring | bored |
| interesting | interested |
| exciting | excited |
| tiring | tired |
| confusing | confused |
| surprising | surprised |
| annoying | annoyed |
| frightening | frightened |

## Eslab qolish usuli
- **-ing** = narsa/odam **boshqalarga shu hissiyotni beradi** (the film IS boring)
- **-ed** = shaxs **shu hissiyotni his qiladi** (I FEEL bored)

## Keng tarqalgan xatolar
- ❌ I am boring. (agar "zerikkanman" demoqchi bo'lsangiz) → ✅ I am **bored**.
- ❌ The movie was interested. → ✅ The movie was **interesting**.
- ❌ I'm very exciting about the trip. → ✅ I'm very **excited** about the trip.

## Mashq
1. This game is really ___ (excited/exciting).
2. I was so ___ (tired/tiring) after work.
3. The news was very ___ (surprised/surprising).

topics.name: 3. Comparatives
topics.content:
# Comparatives (Solishtirma Daraja)

## Ta'rif
Ikki narsa yoki shaxsni solishtirish uchun ishlatiladi — "...dan ...roq" ma'nosida.

## Yasalish qoidalari

**1. Qisqa sifatlar (1 bo'g'inli): + -er**
- tall → tall**er**, fast → fast**er**, small → small**er**

**2. -e bilan tugagan sifatlar: + -r**
- nice → nice**r**, large → large**r**

**3. Undosh+unli+undosh bilan tugagan qisqa sifatlar: oxirgi undosh ikkilanadi**
- big → big**ger**, hot → hot**ter**, thin → thin**ner**

**4. Undosh + y bilan tugagan sifatlar: y → i + er**
- happy → happ**ier**, easy → eas**ier**

**5. Uzun sifatlar (2+ bo'g'inli): more + sifat**
- beautiful → **more** beautiful, expensive → **more** expensive, interesting → **more** interesting

## "Than" bilan solishtirish
- She is **taller than** her brother. — U akasidan baland bo'yli.
- This car is **more expensive than** that one. — Bu mashina u mashinadan qimmatroq.

## Noto'g'ri (irregular) shakllar

| Sifat | Comparative |
|---|---|
| good | **better** |
| bad | **worse** |
| far | **further/farther** |
| little | **less** |
| many/much | **more** |

## Teng darajani bildirish: as...as
- She is **as tall as** her brother. — U akasi bilan bir xil bo'yda.
- This book is **not as interesting as** that one. — Bu kitob u kitobdek qiziqarli emas.

## Keng tarqalgan xatolar
- ❌ more taller → ✅ **taller** (ikkalasini birga ishlatib bo'lmaydi)
- ❌ gooder → ✅ **better**
- ❌ more beautifuler → ✅ **more beautiful**

## Mashq
1. This exercise is ___ (difficult) than the last one.
2. My sister is ___ (young) than me.
3. Health is ___ (important) than money.

topics.name: 4. Superlatives
topics.content:
# Superlatives (Orttirma Daraja)

## Ta'rif
Uch va undan ortiq narsa/shaxs orasida **eng...** ekanini bildirish uchun ishlatiladi.

## Yasalish qoidalari

**1. Qisqa sifatlar (1 bo'g'inli): the + sifat + -est**
- tall → **the** tall**est**, fast → **the** fast**est**

**2. -e bilan tugagan sifatlar: the + sifat + -st**
- nice → **the** nice**st**, large → **the** large**st**

**3. Undosh+unli+undosh: oxirgi undosh ikkilanadi**
- big → **the** big**gest**, hot → **the** hot**test**

**4. Undosh + y: y → i + est**
- happy → **the** happ**iest**, easy → **the** eas**iest**

**5. Uzun sifatlar (2+ bo'g'inli): the most + sifat**
- beautiful → **the most** beautiful, expensive → **the most** expensive

## Misollar
- Everest is **the highest** mountain in the world. — Everest dunyodagi eng baland tog'.
- She is **the smartest** student in class. — U sinfdagi eng aqlli o'quvchi.
- This is **the most expensive** restaurant in town. — Bu shahardagi eng qimmat restoran.

## Noto'g'ri (irregular) shakllar

| Sifat | Superlative |
|---|---|
| good | **the best** |
| bad | **the worst** |
| far | **the furthest/farthest** |
| little | **the least** |
| many/much | **the most** |

## "The" ning muhimligi
Superlative doim **the** artikli bilan ishlatiladi (yagona, aniq narsani bildiradi):
- He is **the** tallest in his family. (the tushirib qoldirilmaydi)

## Qo'shimcha tuzilma: one of the + superlative + ko'plik ot
- She is **one of the best** students in school. — U maktabdagi eng yaxshi o'quvchilardan biri.

## Keng tarqalgan xatolar
- ❌ the most tallest → ✅ **the tallest** (ikkalasini birga ishlatib bo'lmaydi)
- ❌ the goodest → ✅ **the best**
- ❌ She is tallest in class. (the tushib qolgan) → ✅ She is **the** tallest in class.

## Mashq
1. This is ___ (interesting) book I've ever read.
2. He is ___ (good) football player in the team.
3. That was ___ (bad) day of my life.

topics.name: 1. Adverb Formation
topics.content:
# Adverb Formation (Sifatdan Ravish Yasash)

## Ta'rif
Ravishlar (adverbs) fe'l, sifat yoki boshqa ravishni tavsiflaydi — "qanday qilib?" degan savolga javob beradi. Ko'pchiligi sifatga **-ly** qo'shish orqali yasaladi.

## Asosiy qoida: sifat + -ly
- slow → slow**ly**, quick → quick**ly**, careful → careful**ly**, quiet → quiet**ly**

## Maxsus yasalish qoidalari

**1. -y bilan tugagan sifatlar: y → i + ly**
- happy → happ**ily**, easy → eas**ily**

**2. -le bilan tugagan sifatlar: e → y**
- gentle → gent**ly**, simple → simp**ly**, terrible → terrib**ly**

**3. -ic bilan tugagan sifatlar: + ally**
- basic → basic**ally**, tragic → tragic**ally**

**4. -ll bilan tugagan sifatlar: + y (faqat)**
- full → full**y**

## Noto'g'ri (irregular) ravishlar
Ba'zi ravishlar sifat bilan bir xil shaklda bo'ladi yoki butunlay boshqacha:

| Sifat | Ravish |
|---|---|
| good | **well** |
| fast | **fast** |
| hard | **hard** |
| late | **late** |
| early | **early** |

Eslatma: "hardly" — "hard" ning -ly shakli emas, "deyarli emas" degan mustaqil ma'noga ega!

## Ravish gapda qayerda keladi
- Odatda fe'ldan keyin: She sings **beautifully**.
- Sifatdan oldin: He is **extremely** tired.
- Gap boshida (ta'kid uchun): **Suddenly**, it started raining.

## Misollar
- He drives **carefully**. — U ehtiyotkorlik bilan haydaydi.
- She speaks English **fluently**. — U ingliz tilida ravon gapiradi.
- They finished the work **quickly**. — Ular ishni tez tugatishdi.

## Keng tarqalgan xatolar
- ❌ She sings good. → ✅ She sings **well**.
- ❌ He runs quick. → ✅ He runs **quickly**.
- ❌ easily → easyly emas → ✅ eas**ily**

## Mashq
1. He solved the problem ___ (quick).
2. She dances ___ (beautiful).
3. My grandfather still works ___ (hard).

topics.name: 2. Adverbs of Frequency
topics.content:
# Adverbs of Frequency (Chastota Ravishlari)

## Ta'rif
Harakatning qanchalik tez-tez sodir bo'lishini bildiradi — Always, Usually, Often, Sometimes, Rarely, Never kabi.

## Chastota shkalasi (100% dan 0% gacha)

| Ravish | Foiz | Tarjima |
|---|---|---|
| always | 100% | doim |
| usually | ~90% | odatda |
| often | ~70% | tez-tez |
| sometimes | ~50% | ba'zan |
| occasionally | ~30% | vaqti-vaqti bilan |
| rarely/seldom | ~10% | kamdan-kam |
| never | 0% | hech qachon |

## Gapda joylashuvi

**1. "Be" fe'lidan keyin:**
- She **is always** happy. — U doim baxtli.

**2. Asosiy fe'ldan oldin:**
- I **usually wake up** at 7. — Men odatda soat 7da uyg'onaman.
- He **never eats** meat. — U hech qachon go'sht yemaydi.

**3. Modal/auxiliary fe'ldan keyin, asosiy fe'ldan oldin:**
- I **can never remember** her name. — Men uning ismini hech qachon eslay olmayman.
- She **has often visited** Paris. — U tez-tez Parijga tashrif buyurgan.

## "Sometimes" ning maxsus xususiyati
"Sometimes" gap boshida yoki oxirida ham kelishi mumkin:
- **Sometimes**, I feel tired. — Ba'zan men charchagan his qilaman.
- I feel tired **sometimes**.

## Misollar
- We **often** go to the cinema. — Biz tez-tez kinoga boramiz.
- They are **rarely** late. — Ular kamdan-kam kech qoladi.
- I have **never** been to Japan. — Men hech qachon Yaponiyada bo'lmaganman.

## Keng tarqalgan xatolar
- ❌ I always am tired. → ✅ I **am always** tired. (be dan keyin keladi)
- ❌ She goes always to work by bus. → ✅ She **always goes** to work by bus.

## Mashq
1. He ___ (never/is never) drinks coffee.
2. She ___ (is usually/usually is) on time.
3. I have ___ (often/is often) visited that museum.

topics.name: 3. Adverbs of Degree
topics.content:
# Adverbs of Degree (Daraja Ravishlari)

## Ta'rif
Sifat, ravish yoki fe'lning darajasini (qanchalik kuchli/zaif ekanligini) bildiradi: very, quite, too, enough, extremely, so, kabi.

## Eng ko'p ishlatiladiganlari

**Very** — juda (kuchli darajada):
- She is **very** intelligent. — U juda aqlli.

**Quite** — anchagina (o'rtacha kuchli, sifatga qarab "juda" ma'nosini ham berishi mumkin):
- The film was **quite** good. — Film anchagina yaxshi edi.

**Too** — haddan tashqari (salbiy ma'noda, muammo tug'diradi):
- This coffee is **too** hot. — Bu qahva juda issiq (ichib bo'lmaydi).

**Enough** — yetarli (sifatdan **keyin** keladi!):
- This coffee is not hot **enough**. — Bu qahva yetarlicha issiq emas.

**Extremely** — o'ta, nihoyatda:
- It's **extremely** cold today. — Bugun nihoyatda sovuq.

**So** — shunchalik (ta'kid uchun, ko'pincha "that" bilan):
- She was **so** tired that she fell asleep. — U shunchalik charchagan ediki, uxlab qoldi.

## Too vs Very — muhim farq
- **Very** — shunchaki darajani bildiradi, muammo yo'q: The bag is **very** heavy. (og'ir, lekin ko'tarsa bo'ladi)
- **Too** — muammo bor, imkonsizlik bildiradi: The bag is **too** heavy (to carry). — juda og'ir (ko'tarib bo'lmaydi)

## Enough ning joylashuvi
- Sifatdan **keyin**: old **enough**, big **enough**
- Otdan **oldin**: **enough** money, **enough** time

## Misollar
- Is she old **enough** to drive? — U mashina haydashga yetarlicha katta bo'ldimi?
- We don't have **enough** time. — Bizda yetarli vaqt yo'q.
- This exercise is **too** difficult for me. — Bu mashq men uchun juda qiyin.

## Keng tarqalgan xatolar
- ❌ enough big → ✅ big **enough**
- ❌ too much good → ✅ **very/really** good (too — salbiy holatlar uchun)
- ❌ It's very hot to drink. (muammo bildirmoqchi bo'lsa) → ✅ It's **too** hot to drink.

## Mashq
1. This shirt is ___ (too/enough) small for me.
2. She is not tall ___ (enough/too) to reach the shelf.
3. The weather is ___ (very/too) nice today.

topics.name: 1. Comma Usage
topics.content:
# Comma Usage (Vergul Qo'llanilishi)

## Ta'rif
Vergul (,) — gapdagi elementlarni ajratish, ro'yxat tuzish va o'qishni osonlashtirish uchun ishlatiladi.

## Asosiy qoidalar

**1. Ro'yxat tuzishda (3+ element):**
- I bought apples**,** bananas**,** and oranges. — Men olma, banan va apelsin sotib oldim.
- (Oxirgi vergul "Oxford comma" deb ataladi — "and" dan oldin, ixtiyoriy lekin tavsiya etiladi)

**2. Qo'shma gaplarda (and, but, or, so dan oldin, ikkita to'liq gap bo'lsa):**
- I wanted to go**,** but I was too tired. — Men bormoqchi edim, lekin juda charchagan edim.

**3. Ergash gap bosh gapdan oldin kelganda:**
- **Although it was raining,** we went out. — Yomg'ir yog'sa-da, biz tashqariga chiqdik.
- (Aksincha: We went out although it was raining. — vergul kerak emas, chunki ergash gap keyin keladi)

**4. Kirish so'zlaridan keyin:**
- **However,** I disagree. — Biroq, men rozi emasman.
- **First,** let's discuss the budget. — Birinchidan, byudjetni muhokama qilaylik.

**5. Izohli (non-defining) ergash gaplarda:**
- My mother**,** who is 60**,** loves gardening. — Onam, 60 yoshda, bog'dorchilikni yaxshi ko'radi.

**6. Murojaat qilishda:**
- **John,** can you help me? — Jon, menga yordam bera olasanmi?

**7. Sanalarda:**
- July 4**,** 2026

## Qachon vergul KERAK EMAS
- Defining (aniqlovchi) relative clause'larda: The man **who called** is my father. (vergulsiz)
- Qisqa gaplarda "and" bilan: I like tea **and** coffee. (vergul kerak emas, agar ikkita to'liq gap bo'lmasa)

## Keng tarqalgan xatolar
- ❌ I like apples bananas and oranges. (vergulsiz ro'yxat) → ✅ apples**,** bananas**,** and oranges
- ❌ My sister, is a doctor. (keraksiz vergul) → ✅ My sister **is** a doctor.

## Mashq
1. To'g'ri joylashtiring: "Although she was tired she finished her homework."
2. To'g'ri joylashtiring: "I bought milk eggs and bread."

topics.name: 2. Apostrophe
topics.content:
# Apostrophe (Apostrof)

## Ta'rif
Apostrof (') ikki asosiy vazifani bajaradi: **qisqartma** yasash va **egalikni** bildirish.

## 1. Qisqartmalar uchun (Contractions)
Harflar tushirilgan joyni bildiradi:

| To'liq | Qisqartma |
|---|---|
| it is / it has | it's |
| I am | I'm |
| you are | you're |
| do not | don't |
| cannot | can't |
| I will | I'll |
| they have | they've |
| let us | let's |

Misol: **It's** raining outside. — Tashqarida yomg'ir yog'yapti.

## 2. Egalik uchun (Possession)
**Birlik otga: 's**
- the boy**'s** book — bolaning kitobi
- James**'s** car — Jeymsning mashinasi

**-s bilan tugagan ko'plik otga: faqat '**
- the boys**'** books — bolalarning kitoblari
- my parents**'** house — ota-onamning uyi

**-s bilan tugamagan ko'plik otga: 's**
- the children**'s** toys — bolalarning o'yinchoqlari

## Muhim farq: Its vs It's
- **Its** — egalik (apostrofsiz): The dog wagged **its** tail.
- **It's** — "it is/it has" qisqartmasi: **It's** a nice day.

Bu — eng ko'p uchraydigan yozma xatolardan biri!

## Keng tarqalgan xatolar
- ❌ The dog wagged it's tail. → ✅ The dog wagged **its** tail.
- ❌ The girls' (bitta qiz nazarda tutilsa) → ✅ The **girl's** (bitta qiz uchun 's)
- ❌ Its raining. → ✅ **It's** raining.
- ❌ Two dog's are playing. (ko'plikda apostrof kerak emas!) → ✅ Two **dogs** are playing.

## Mashq
1. ___ (Its/It's) getting dark outside.
2. This is my ___ (sisters/sister's) car.
3. The ___ (students/students') homework was excellent. (bir nechta talaba)

topics.name: 3. Capitalization
topics.content:
# Capitalization (Bosh Harflar Qoidalari)

## Ta'rif
Ingliz tilida bosh harf bilan yozilishi shart bo'lgan holatlar mavjud. Bu qoidalarga rioya qilish yozma nutqda juda muhim.

## Bosh harf bilan yoziladigan holatlar

**1. Gap boshida:**
- **The** sun is shining.

**2. "I" olmoshi — gapning istalgan joyida doim katta harf:**
- My friend and **I** went shopping.

**3. Shaxs ismlari va familiyalari:**
- **John Smith**, **Aziza Karimova**

**4. Joy nomlari (mamlakat, shahar, ko'cha):**
- **Uzbekistan**, **Tashkent**, **Amir Temur Street**

**5. Til va millat nomlari:**
- **English**, **Uzbek**, **French**, an **American**

**6. Kunlar, oylar, bayramlar (lekin fasllar EMAS):**
- **Monday**, **December**, **New Year**
- lekin: winter, summer (kichik harf bilan)

**7. Kitob, film, tashkilot nomlari (asosiy so'zlar):**
- **Harry Potter**, **United Nations**

**8. Unvonlar ism bilan birga kelganda:**
- **Doctor** Smith, **President** Biden
- lekin: he is a doctor (unvon yolg'iz kelsa, kichik harf)

**9. Diniy va milliy atamalar:**
- **Islam**, **Christianity**, **Ramadan**

## Keng tarqalgan xatolar
- ❌ i am a student. → ✅ **I** am a student.
- ❌ i live in tashkent, uzbekistan. → ✅ I live in **Tashkent, Uzbekistan**.
- ❌ We celebrate Winter. → ✅ We celebrate **winter**. (fasllar kichik harf)
- ❌ she speaks english. → ✅ She speaks **English**.

## Mashq (to'g'irlang)
1. my brother and i live in samarkand.
2. she was born on monday, in july.
3. i am learning english at school.

topics.name: 4. Colon and Semicolon
topics.content:
# Colon & Semicolon (Ikki Nuqta va Nuqtali Vergul)

## Colon (:) — Ikki Nuqta

**1. Ro'yxat kiritishdan oldin:**
- I need three things**:** milk, bread, and eggs. — Menga uchta narsa kerak: sut, non va tuxum.

**2. Tushuntirish yoki misol keltirishda:**
- There's one thing I love**:** traveling. — Men yaxshi ko'radigan bitta narsa bor: sayohat qilish.

**3. To'liq gapdan keyin sabab yoki natijani izohlashda:**
- She was nervous**:** it was her first interview. — U hayajonlangan edi: bu uning birinchi intervyusi edi.

**4. Vaqt yozishda:**
- 7**:**30 AM

## Semicolon (;) — Nuqtali Vergul

**1. Ikki bog'liq, lekin mustaqil gapni bog'lashda (bog'lovchisiz):**
- I love reading**;** my sister loves painting. — Men o'qishni yaxshi ko'raman; singlim rasm chizishni yaxshi ko'radi.

**2. "However, therefore, moreover" kabi bog'lovchi ravishlardan oldin:**
- I was tired**;** however**,** I finished the work. — Men charchagan edim; biroq, ishni tugatdim.

**3. Vergul bilan to'la murakkab ro'yxatlarda:**
- I visited Paris, France**;** Rome, Italy**;** and Tokyo, Japan.
  (Har bir elementda allaqachon vergul bo'lgani uchun, elementlarni ajratish uchun ; ishlatiladi)

## Colon vs Semicolon — farqi
- **Colon (:)** — tushuntirish, ro'yxat, misol **kiritadi** (bir tomonlama ishora)
- **Semicolon (;)** — ikki **teng va mustaqil** gapni bog'laydi

## Keng tarqalgan xatolar
- ❌ I need: milk, bread, and eggs. (to'liq gapsiz colon ishlatilmaydi, agar ro'yxat oldida to'liq gap bo'lmasa) → ✅ I need **the following items:** milk, bread, and eggs.
- ❌ I love reading, my sister loves painting. (vergul bilan ikkita mustaqil gapni bog'lash — "comma splice" xatosi) → ✅ I love reading**;** my sister loves painting.

## Mashq
1. To'g'ri belgi qo'ying: "She had one goal ___ to win the championship."
2. To'g'ri belgi qo'ying: "It was raining ___ we decided to stay home."

topics.name: 10. Future Continuous
topics.content:
# Future Continuous

## Ta'rif
Kelajakda aniq bir paytda davom etayotgan bo'ladigan harakatni bildiradi.

## Shakllanish

**Ijobiy:** ega + **will be** + fe'l**-ing**
- I **will be working** at 5 PM tomorrow. — Ertaga soat 5da men ishlayotgan bo'laman.

**Inkor:** ega + **won't be** + fe'l**-ing**
- I **won't be sleeping** then. — O'sha payt men uxlamayotgan bo'laman.

**So'roq:** **Will** + ega + **be** + fe'l**-ing**...?
- **Will** you **be sleeping** at midnight? — Yarim tunda uxlayotgan bo'lasizmi?

## Qachon ishlatiladi

**1. Kelajakdagi aniq paytda davom etayotgan harakat:**
- This time tomorrow, I **will be flying** to London. — Ertaga shu payt men Londonga uchayotgan bo'laman.

**2. Rejalashtirilgan, kutilayotgan kelajak harakati (rasmiy ohangda):**
- I **will be meeting** the client at 3 PM. — Men soat 3da mijoz bilan uchrashaman.

**3. Xushmuomalalik bilan so'rash (rejalarni bilish uchun):**
- **Will** you **be using** the car tonight? — Bugun kechqurun mashinadan foydalanasizmi? (xushmuomalalik bilan so'ramoq)

## Future Simple vs Future Continuous farqi
- **Future Simple** — butun harakat: I **will finish** the report by 5 PM. (5gacha tugaydi)
- **Future Continuous** — jarayon davom etadi: I **will be working** on the report at 5 PM. (5da hali ham ishlab turadi)

## Vaqt belgilari
at this time tomorrow, at 5 PM, this time next week

## Keng tarqalgan xatolar
- ❌ I will working. (be yo'q) → ✅ I **will be working**.
- ❌ She will be work. (-ing yo'q) → ✅ She will be **working**.

## Mashq
1. At 8 PM tonight, I ___ (watch) my favorite show.
2. ___ (Will you be using) the kitchen later?
3. This time next year, we ___ (live) in a new house.

topics.name: 11. Future Perfect
topics.content:
# Future Perfect

## Ta'rif
Kelajakdagi ma'lum bir vaqtga qadar tugallangan bo'ladigan harakatni bildiradi — "shu paytga kelib allaqachon qilingan bo'ladi" ma'nosida.

## Shakllanish

**Ijobiy:** ega + **will have** + fe'lning 3-shakli
- I **will have finished** by 6 PM. — Men soat 6gacha tugatgan bo'laman.

**Inkor:** ega + **won't have** + fe'lning 3-shakli
- I **won't have finished** by then. — O'shanga qadar men tugatmagan bo'laman.

**So'roq:** **Will** + ega + **have** + fe'lning 3-shakli...?
- **Will** you **have finished** by tomorrow? — Ertagacha tugatgan bo'lasizmi?

## Qachon ishlatiladi

**1. Kelajakdagi ma'lum bir muddatga qadar tugallanadigan harakat:**
- By next year, I **will have graduated**. — Kelasi yilga qadar men bitirgan bo'laman.
- She **will have finished** the project by Friday. — U loyihani jumagacha tugatgan bo'ladi.

**2. Kelajakda taxmin qilinayotgan holat haqida:**
- He **will have arrived** by now. — U hozirga qadar yetib kelgan bo'lsa kerak.

## Muhim vaqt belgilari
- **by** + vaqt (by 2030, by next month, by the time...)
- **by the time** + gap: By the time you read this, I **will have left**. — Siz buni o'qiganingizda, men allaqachon ketgan bo'laman.

## Future Perfect vs Future Simple
- Future Simple: I **will finish** the report tomorrow. (kelajakda tugaydi, aniq vaqt yo'q)
- Future Perfect: I **will have finished** the report by tomorrow. (ma'lum muddatga qadar tugagan bo'ladi)

## Keng tarqalgan xatolar
- ❌ I will finished by then. → ✅ I **will have finished** by then.
- ❌ By 2030, she will graduate. (aniqlik yetishmaydi) → ✅ By 2030, she **will have graduated**.

## Mashq
1. By the end of this year, I ___ (save) $5000.
2. ___ (Will/Do) you have finished by 5 PM?
3. They ___ (will have/will) built the bridge by 2027.

topics.name: 12. Future Perfect Continuous
topics.content:
# Future Perfect Continuous

## Ta'rif
Kelajakdagi ma'lum bir nuqtaga qadar **qancha vaqt davom etib kelganini** ta'kidlaydi — eng murakkab va kamdan-kam ishlatiladigan zamon.

## Shakllanish

**Ijobiy:** ega + **will have been** + fe'l**-ing**
- By June, I **will have been working** here for 5 years. — Iyungacha men bu yerda 5 yildan beri ishlayotgan bo'laman.

**Inkor:** ega + **won't have been** + fe'l**-ing**
- I **won't have been living** here long. 

**So'roq:** **Will** + ega + **have been** + fe'l**-ing**...?
- **Will** you **have been studying** for 3 hours by then?

## Qachon ishlatiladi
Kelajakdagi ma'lum bir nuqtagacha davom etib kelgan harakatning **davomiyligini** ta'kidlash uchun (odatda **for** bilan):

- By the time she retires, she **will have been teaching** for 30 years. — U nafaqaga chiqqunga qadar, u 30 yildan beri o'qituvchilik qilgan bo'ladi.
- In December, we **will have been living** here for a decade. — Dekabrda biz bu yerda 10 yildan beri yashagan bo'lamiz.

## Future Perfect vs Future Perfect Continuous

| Future Perfect (natija) | Future Perfect Continuous (davomiylik) |
|---|---|
| I **will have written** 3 books by 2030. (nechta) | I **will have been writing** for 10 years by 2030. (qancha vaqt) |

## Muhim eslatma
Bu zamon kundalik nutqda kamdan-kam ishlatiladi — asosan yozma, rasmiy yoki batafsil rejalashtirish kontekstida uchraydi. Ko'pincha oddiyroq Future Perfect yoki Present Perfect Continuous bilan almashtiriladi.

## Vaqt belgilari
by, by the time, for (davomiylik bilan birga)

## Keng tarqalgan xatolar
- ❌ I will have work. → ✅ I **will have been working**.
- ❌ By 2030 I will been working for 10 years. (have tushib qolgan) → ✅ I **will have been** working...

## Mashq
1. By next month, she ___ (work) here for two years.
2. When he turns 40, he ___ (live) in this city for 20 years.

topics.name: 1. Present Simple
topics.content:
# Present Simple

## Ta'rif
Doimiy harakatlar, odatlar, umumiy haqiqatlar va jadval bo'yicha voqealar uchun ishlatiladi.

## Shakllanish

**Ijobiy:**
- I/You/We/They + fe'l (bazaviy shakl)
- He/She/It + fe'l + **-s/-es**

Misol: I **work**. / She **works**.

**Inkor:**
- I/You/We/They + **don't** + fe'l
- He/She/It + **doesn't** + fe'l

Misol: I **don't work**. / She **doesn't work**.

**So'roq:**
- **Do** I/you/we/they + fe'l...?
- **Does** he/she/it + fe'l...?

Misol: **Do** you **work**? / **Does** she **work**?

## Qachon ishlatiladi

**1. Doimiy odat/harakat:**
- I **drink** coffee every morning. — Men har kuni ertalab qahva ichaman.

**2. Umumiy haqiqat:**
- The sun **rises** in the east. — Quyosh sharqdan chiqadi.

**3. Doimiy holat:**
- She **lives** in Tashkent. — U Toshkentda yashaydi.

**4. Jadval, dastur bo'yicha voqealar:**
- The train **leaves** at 9 AM. — Poyezd soat 9da jo'naydi.

## Vaqt belgilari (signal words)
always, usually, often, sometimes, rarely, never, every day/week, on Mondays

## -s/-es qo'shish qoidasi (3-shaxs birlik)
- Odatiy: work → works
- -s,-sh,-ch,-x,-o bilan tugasa: +es — watch → watches, go → goes
- undosh+y bilan tugasa: y→i+es — study → studies

## Keng tarqalgan xatolar
- ❌ She work here. → ✅ She **works** here.
- ❌ Does she works here? → ✅ Does she **work** here? (does bilan -s tushadi)
- ❌ I doesn't like it. → ✅ I **don't** like it.

## Mashq
1. He ___ (go/goes) to work by bus.
2. ___ (Do/Does) you speak English?
3. They ___ (don't/doesn't) live here anymore.

topics.name: 2. Present Continuous
topics.content:
# Present Continuous (Present Progressive)

## Ta'rif
Ayni damda sodir bo'layotgan harakat yoki vaqtinchalik holatlar uchun ishlatiladi.

## Shakllanish

**Ijobiy:** ega + **am/is/are** + fe'l**-ing**
- I **am working**. / She **is working**. / They **are working**.

**Inkor:** ega + **am/is/are not** + fe'l**-ing**
- I **am not working**. / She **isn't working**.

**So'roq:** **Am/Is/Are** + ega + fe'l**-ing**...?
- **Are** you **working**? / **Is** she **working**?

## Qachon ishlatiladi

**1. Hozir, ayni damda sodir bo'layotgan harakat:**
- I **am working** right now. — Men hozir ishlayapman.

**2. Vaqtinchalik holat (hozirgi davrda, doimiy emas):**
- She **is staying** with her friend this week. — U bu hafta do'sti bilan turibdi.

**3. Kelasi rejalar (aniq kelishuv bilan):**
- We **are meeting** them tomorrow. — Biz ular bilan ertaga uchrashamiz.

**4. O'zgarib borayotgan vaziyat:**
- The weather **is getting** colder. — Ob-havo sovuqroq bo'lib bormoqda.

**5. Takrorlanuvchi, ko'pincha norozilikni bildiruvchi harakat (always bilan):**
- He **is always losing** his keys! — U doim kalitlarini yo'qotib qo'yadi!

## Vaqt belgilari
now, right now, at the moment, currently, today, this week, look!, listen!

## -ing qo'shish qoidasi
- Odatiy: work → working
- -e bilan tugasa: e tushadi — make → making
- undosh+unli+undosh (urg'uli bo'g'in): oxirgi undosh ikkilanadi — run → running, sit → sitting

## Stative fe'llar bilan ishlatilmaydi!
know, like, love, want, believe, understand kabi holat fe'llari odatda Continuous shaklda ishlatilmaydi:
- ❌ I am knowing the answer. → ✅ I **know** the answer.

## Keng tarqalgan xatolar
- ❌ She working now. (be fe'li tushib qolgan) → ✅ She **is working** now.
- ❌ I am wanting this. → ✅ I **want** this.

## Mashq
1. Look! It ___ (rain/is raining).
2. She ___ (is study/is studying) for her exam right now.
3. I ___ (am not working/not working) today.

topics.name: 3. Past Simple
topics.content:
# Past Simple

## Ta'rif
O'tmishda tugallangan, aniq vaqtda sodir bo'lgan harakatlar uchun ishlatiladi.

## Shakllanish

**Ijobiy:**
- To'g'ri fe'llar: fe'l + **-ed** (work → work**ed**)
- Noto'g'ri fe'llar: maxsus shakl (go → **went**, see → **saw**)

**Inkor:** ega + **didn't** + fe'l (bazaviy shakl)
- I **didn't go**. (went emas — didn't dan keyin bazaviy shakl)

**So'roq:** **Did** + ega + fe'l (bazaviy shakl)...?
- **Did** you **go**? — Bordingizmi?

## Qachon ishlatiladi

**1. Aniq o'tgan vaqtda tugallangan harakat:**
- I **visited** London last year. — Men o'tgan yili Londonga tashrif buyurdim.

**2. Ketma-ket o'tgan voqealar:**
- She **woke up**, **had** breakfast, and **left** for work. — U uyg'ondi, nonushta qildi va ishga jo'nadi.

**3. O'tmishdagi odat (used to bilan bir xil ma'no):**
- We **lived** in Samarkand when I was young. — Men yosh bo'lganimda biz Samarqandda yashardik.

## Vaqt belgilari
yesterday, last week/month/year, ago, in 2020, when I was young

## -ed qo'shish qoidasi (to'g'ri fe'llar)
- Odatiy: work → worked
- -e bilan tugasa: +d — live → lived
- undosh+y bilan tugasa: y→i+ed — study → studied
- undosh+unli+undosh (urg'uli): oxirgi undosh ikkilanadi — stop → stopped

## Eng ko'p ishlatiladigan noto'g'ri fe'llar

| Bazaviy | Past Simple |
|---|---|
| go | went |
| be | was/were |
| have | had |
| do | did |
| see | saw |
| take | took |
| make | made |
| come | came |
| say | said |
| get | got |

## Keng tarqalgan xatolar
- ❌ I didn't went. → ✅ I **didn't go**. (didn't dan keyin bazaviy shakl)
- ❌ Did you went? → ✅ **Did** you **go**?
- ❌ She goed to school. → ✅ She **went** to school.

## Mashq
1. I ___ (go) to the market yesterday.
2. She ___ (not/see) him last week.
3. ___ (Did/Do) you finish the project?

topics.name: 4. Past Continuous
topics.content:
# Past Continuous (Past Progressive)

## Ta'rif
O'tmishda, aniq bir paytda davom etayotgan harakatni bildiradi.

## Shakllanish

**Ijobiy:** ega + **was/were** + fe'l**-ing**
- I **was working**. / They **were working**.

**Inkor:** ega + **wasn't/weren't** + fe'l**-ing**
- I **wasn't working**. / They **weren't working**.

**So'roq:** **Was/Were** + ega + fe'l**-ing**...?
- **Was** she **working**? — U ishlayotgan edimi?

## Qachon ishlatiladi

**1. O'tmishdagi aniq paytda davom etgan harakat:**
- I **was sleeping** at midnight. — Men yarim tunda uxlayotgan edim.

**2. Ikki harakat bir vaqtda davom etganda (while):**
- I **was cooking** **while** she **was cleaning**. — U tozalayotganda men ovqat pishirayotgan edim.

**3. Uzoq harakat davomida qisqa harakat sodir bo'lganda (Past Simple bilan birga):**
- I **was watching** TV **when** the phone **rang**. — Telefon jiringlaganda men televizor ko'rayotgan edim.
  (Uzoq harakat — Past Continuous, qisqa/to'satdan harakat — Past Simple)

**4. Fon (background) tasvirlash uchun hikoyada:**
- The sun **was shining** and birds **were singing**. — Quyosh charaqlab turardi va qushlar sayrayotgan edi.

## Vaqt belgilari
while, when, at that moment, at 8 o'clock yesterday, all day yesterday

## While vs When farqi
- **While** — uzoq harakatdan oldin ishlatiladi (Past Continuous bilan)
- **When** — qisqa harakatdan oldin ishlatiladi (Past Simple bilan)

## Keng tarqalgan xatolar
- ❌ I was work yesterday. (-ing yo'q) → ✅ I **was working** yesterday.
- ❌ While I cooked, she was cleaning. → ✅ While I **was cooking**, she **was cleaning**.
- ❌ When I was walking, I saw... (bu yerda to'g'ri, lekin) I was walking when I was seeing him → ✅ ...**when I saw** him. (qisqa harakat uchun Past Simple)

## Mashq
1. I ___ (read) a book when you called.
2. They ___ (play) football while it ___ (rain).
3. What ___ (you/do) at 9 PM last night?

topics.name: 5. Present Perfect
topics.content:
# Present Perfect

## Ta'rif
O'tmishda sodir bo'lgan, lekin hozirgi vaqtga bog'liq yoki natijasi hozir muhim bo'lgan harakatlarni bildiradi. Aniq vaqt ko'rsatilmaydi.

## Shakllanish

**Ijobiy:** ega + **have/has** + fe'lning 3-shakli (Past Participle)
- I **have worked**. / She **has worked**.

**Inkor:** ega + **haven't/hasn't** + fe'lning 3-shakli
- I **haven't finished**. / She **hasn't finished**.

**So'roq:** **Have/Has** + ega + fe'lning 3-shakli...?
- **Have** you **finished**? — Tugatdingizmi?

## Qachon ishlatiladi

**1. Hozirgi natijaga ega o'tmish harakati:**
- I **have lost** my keys. (hozir kalitim yo'q — natija muhim) — Men kalitimni yo'qotib qo'ydim.

**2. Hayotiy tajriba (aniq vaqtsiz):**
- I **have been** to Japan. — Men Yaponiyada bo'lganman. (qachon — muhim emas)

**3. Hozirgi paytgacha davom etgan holat (for/since bilan):**
- I **have lived** here **for** 10 years. — Men bu yerda 10 yildan beri yashayman.
- She **has worked** here **since** 2020. — U bu yerda 2020-yildan beri ishlaydi.

**4. Yaqinda sodir bo'lgan harakat (just, already, yet bilan):**
- I **have just finished** my homework. — Men uy vazifamni endigina tugatdim.
- **Have** you **already eaten**? — Siz allaqachon ovqatlanib bo'ldingizmi?
- She **hasn't arrived yet**. — U hali kelmadi.

## For vs Since farqi
- **For** — davomiylik (necha vaqt): for 5 years, for two hours
- **Since** — boshlanish nuqtasi: since 2020, since Monday

## Present Perfect vs Past Simple
- Past Simple — aniq vaqt bor: I **visited** Japan **in 2019**.
- Present Perfect — aniq vaqt yo'q, hozirga bog'liq: I **have visited** Japan.

## Keng tarqalgan xatolar
- ❌ I have seen him yesterday. (aniq vaqt bilan Present Perfect ishlatilmaydi) → ✅ I **saw** him yesterday. (Past Simple)
- ❌ I have lived here since 5 years. → ✅ I have lived here **for** 5 years.
- ❌ She has go. → ✅ She **has gone**.

## Mashq
1. I ___ (never/be) to Africa.
2. She has worked here ___ (for/since) 2018.
3. ___ (Have/Has) you finished your homework ___ (already/yet)?

topics.name: 6. Present Perfect Continuous
topics.content:
# Present Perfect Continuous

## Ta'rif
O'tmishda boshlangan va hozirgacha davom etayotgan (yoki endigina tugagan, natijasi hozir ko'rinib turgan) harakatning **davomiyligini** ta'kidlaydi.

## Shakllanish

**Ijobiy:** ega + **have/has been** + fe'l**-ing**
- I **have been working**. / She **has been working**.

**Inkor:** ega + **haven't/hasn't been** + fe'l**-ing**
- I **haven't been working**.

**So'roq:** **Have/Has** + ega + **been** + fe'l**-ing**...?
- **Have** you **been waiting** long? — Ko'pdan beri kutyapsizmi?

## Qachon ishlatiladi

**1. O'tmishdan hozirgacha davom etayotgan harakat (jarayonga urg'u):**
- I **have been studying** English **for** 3 years. — Men 3 yildan beri ingliz tilini o'rganyapman (va hali ham o'rganyapman).

**2. Yaqinda tugagan, lekin natijasi hozir ko'rinadigan harakat:**
- I'm tired because I **have been running**. — Men charchadim, chunki yugurib yurgan edim (natija: hozir charchagan).
- Her eyes are red — she **has been crying**. — Uning ko'zlari qizarib ketgan — u yig'lagan edi.

## Present Perfect vs Present Perfect Continuous farqi

| Present Perfect (natija/tugallanganlik) | Present Perfect Continuous (jarayon/davomiylik) |
|---|---|
| I **have painted** the wall. (tugadi, natija bor) | I **have been painting** the wall. (jarayon davom etgan/etayotgan) |
| I **have read** 5 books this month. (nechta — miqdor) | I **have been reading** all day. (qancha vaqt — davomiylik) |

## Stative fe'llar bilan ishlatilmaydi
know, believe, love kabi fe'llar Continuous shaklda ishlatilmaydi — o'rniga Present Perfect ishlatiladi:
- ❌ I have been knowing her for years. → ✅ I **have known** her for years.

## Vaqt belgilari
for, since, all day, lately, recently, how long

## Keng tarqalgan xatolar
- ❌ I have been study. (-ing yo'q) → ✅ I have been **studying**.
- ❌ How long you have been waiting? → ✅ **How long have you been** waiting?

## Mashq
1. She ___ (work) here for six months.
2. It ___ (rain) all morning.
3. ___ (How long/How much) have you been learning English?

topics.name: 7. Past Perfect
topics.content:
# Past Perfect

## Ta'rif
O'tmishdagi ikkita harakatdan **birinchi bo'lib sodir bo'lganini** ("o'tmishning o'tmishi") bildiradi.

## Shakllanish

**Ijobiy:** ega + **had** + fe'lning 3-shakli
- I **had finished**. — Men allaqachon tugatgan edim.

**Inkor:** ega + **hadn't** + fe'lning 3-shakli
- I **hadn't finished**.

**So'roq:** **Had** + ega + fe'lning 3-shakli...?
- **Had** you **finished**? — Tugatgan edingizmi?

## Qachon ishlatiladi

**1. Ikkita o'tmish harakatidan birinchisini ko'rsatish uchun:**
- When I arrived, the train **had** already **left**. — Men kelganimda, poyezd allaqachon jo'nab ketgan edi.
  (Ikkinchi harakat "arrived" — Past Simple, birinchi harakat "had left" — Past Perfect)

**2. Sabab-natija munosabatini bildirishda:**
- She was tired because she **had worked** all day. — U charchagan edi, chunki kun bo'yi ishlagan edi.

**3. Reported speech'da (Past Simple → Past Perfect ga o'zgaradi):**
- "I finished." → He said he **had finished**.

**4. Third Conditional'da (shart gaplar):**
- If I **had known**, I would have helped. — Agar bilganimda, yordam bergan bo'lardim.

## Past Simple vs Past Perfect — vaqt tartibi

```
[Past Perfect — birinchi harakat] → [Past Simple — ikkinchi harakat]
had left  →  arrived
```

Misol: The film **had** already **started** when we **arrived**. — Biz kelganimizda, film allaqachon boshlangan edi.

## Vaqt belgilari
before, after, already, just, when, by the time, never (before)

## Keng tarqalgan xatolar
- ❌ When I arrived, the train left. (ketma-ketlik noaniq) → ✅ When I arrived, the train **had left**. (aniqroq — poyezd oldinroq ketgan)
- ❌ I had finish. → ✅ I **had finished**. (3-shakl kerak)

## Mashq
1. By the time she arrived, we ___ (already/leave).
2. He ___ (never/see) snow before he moved to Russia.
3. I was hungry because I ___ (not/eat) breakfast.

topics.name: 8. Past Perfect Continuous
topics.content:
# Past Perfect Continuous

## Ta'rif
O'tmishdagi bir nuqtagacha **davom etib kelgan** harakatning davomiyligini bildiradi — "o'tmishning o'tmishi"ning davomiy shakli.

## Shakllanish

**Ijobiy:** ega + **had been** + fe'l**-ing**
- I **had been working**. — Men (o'sha payt) ishlab kelayotgan edim.

**Inkor:** ega + **hadn't been** + fe'l**-ing**
- I **hadn't been working**.

**So'roq:** **Had** + ega + **been** + fe'l**-ing**...?
- **Had** you **been waiting** long? — Uzoq kutgan edingizmi?

## Qachon ishlatiladi

**1. O'tmishdagi bir nuqtagacha davom etib kelgan harakat (davomiylikka urg'u):**
- I **had been waiting** for an hour when the bus finally came. — Avtobus nihoyat kelganda, men bir soatdan beri kutib turgan edim.

**2. O'tmishdagi holatning sababini tushuntirishda:**
- She was exhausted because she **had been working** all night. — U charchagan edi, chunki kechasi bilan ishlab chiqqan edi.

## Past Perfect vs Past Perfect Continuous farqi

| Past Perfect (natija/miqdor) | Past Perfect Continuous (jarayon/davomiylik) |
|---|---|
| I **had written** 3 letters. (nechta — natija) | I **had been writing** for 2 hours. (qancha vaqt — jarayon) |
| The ground was wet because it **had rained**. (fakt) | The ground was wet because it **had been raining**. (davomiy jarayonga urg'u) |

## Tuzilishi (uch qatlamli vaqt)
```
[Past Perfect Continuous — davom etgan harakat] → [Past Simple — kesib o'tuvchi/tugatuvchi harakat]
had been waiting  →  finally came
```

## Vaqt belgilari
for, since, how long, before

## Keng tarqalgan xatolar
- ❌ I had been work. (-ing yo'q) → ✅ I had been **working**.
- ❌ She had been know him for years. (stative fe'l bilan ishlatilmaydi) → ✅ She **had known** him for years.

## Mashq
1. They ___ (play) football for an hour when it started to rain.
2. He was tired because he ___ (study) all night.
3. How long ___ (you/wait) before the doctor called you?

topics.name: 9. Future Simple
topics.content:
# Future Simple

## Ta'rif
Kelajakda sodir bo'ladigan harakat, spontan qaror, va'da yoki bashorat uchun ishlatiladi. Odatda **will** yordamchi fe'li bilan yasaladi.

## Shakllanish

**Ijobiy:** ega + **will** + fe'l (bazaviy shakl)
- I **will help** you. — Men sizga yordam beraman.

**Inkor:** ega + **won't** + fe'l
- I **won't** be late. — Men kech qolmayman.

**So'roq:** **Will** + ega + fe'l...?
- **Will** you **come**? — Kelasizmi?

## Qachon ishlatiladi

**1. Spontan qaror (gapirish paytida qaror qilinadi):**
- The phone is ringing. — I**'ll answer** it! — Men javob beraman!

**2. Va'da berish:**
- I **will** always **love** you. — Men seni doim sevaman.

**3. Taklif/tayyorlik ko'rsatish:**
- **I'll help** you with your bags. — Men sizga sumkalaringizda yordam beraman.

**4. Bashorat qilish (dalilsiz, umumiy fikr):**
- I think it **will rain** tomorrow. — O'ylaymanki, ertaga yomg'ir yog'adi.

**5. Kelajak haqidagi umumiy faktlar:**
- The sun **will rise** at 6 AM tomorrow. — Ertaga quyosh soat 6da chiqadi.

## Will vs Going to — farqi
- **Will** — spontan qaror, va'da, umumiy bashorat
- **Be going to** — oldindan rejalashtirilgan, dalilga asoslangan bashorat (bu alohida mavzuda batafsil)

## Qisqartma shakllar
- I will → I'll, you will → you'll, will not → won't

## Keng tarqalgan xatolar
- ❌ I will to go. → ✅ I **will go**. ("to" kerak emas)
- ❌ She wills come. → ✅ She **will come**. (will o'zgarmaydi, -s olmaydi)
- ❌ Will you to help me? → ✅ **Will you help** me?

## Mashq
1. I think she ___ (will/going to) like this gift.
2. ___ (Will/Do) you marry me?
3. Don't worry, I ___ (won't/don't) tell anyone.

topics.name: 1. Be going to
topics.content:
# Be going to (Rejalar va Niyatlar)

## Ta'rif
Kelajakda sodir bo'lishi rejalashtirilgan yoki hozirgi dalillarga asoslangan aniq bashorat qilinadigan harakatlarni bildirish uchun ishlatiladi.

## Shakllanish
ega + **am/is/are + going to** + fe'l (bazaviy shakl)
- I **am going to** travel next month. — Men kelasi oy sayohat qilaman (rejalashtirilgan).
- She **is going to** call you. — U sizga qo'ng'iroq qiladi.

**Inkor:** am/is/are **not going to**
- I'**m not going to** go. — Men bormayman.

**So'roq:** Am/Is/Are + ega + **going to**...?
- **Are** you **going to** come? — Kelasizmi?

## Qachon ishlatiladi

**1. Oldindan rejalashtirilgan niyat:**
- I **am going to** study medicine. — Men tibbiyotni o'rganaman (qaror allaqachon qabul qilingan).

**2. Hozirgi dalilga asoslangan bashorat (ko'rinib turgan belgi bilan):**
- Look at those clouds! It **is going to** rain. — Ana o'sha bulutlarga qarang! Yomg'ir yog'adi. (dalil bor — bulutlar)

## Will vs Going to — asosiy farq

| Will | Going to |
|---|---|
| Spontan qaror | Oldindan rejalashtirilgan qaror |
| Dalilsiz umumiy bashorat | Dalilga asoslangan bashorat |
| I think it **will** rain. (umumiy fikr) | Look! It'**s going to** rain. (bulutlarni ko'rib) |
| I**'ll** answer the phone. (hozir qaror qilyapman) | I**'m going to** call her tomorrow. (oldindan rejalashtirilgan) |

## Keng tarqalgan xatolar
- ❌ I going to go. (am/is/are tushib qolgan) → ✅ I **am going to** go.
- ❌ She is going to goes. → ✅ She is going to **go**. (bazaviy shakl)

## Mashq
1. Look at his face! He ___ (is going to/will) cry.
2. I ___ (am going to/will) study abroad next year — I've already applied.
3. Wait, I ___ (will/am going to) help you with that bag! (hozir qaror qilinmoqda)

topics.name: 2. Used to and Would
topics.content:
# Used to & Would (O'tmishdagi Odatlar)

## Ta'rif
Ikkalasi ham o'tmishda muntazam sodir bo'lgan, lekin hozir sodir bo'lmaydigan odatlarni bildiradi.

## Used to
**Shakllanish:** ega + **used to** + fe'l (bazaviy shakl)
- I **used to** play football every weekend. — Men avval har hafta oxirida futbol o'ynardim (hozir o'ynamayman).
- She **used to** live in Paris. — U avval Parijda yashagan (endi yashamaydi).

**Inkor:** didn't use to (used emas!)
- I **didn't use to** like coffee. — Men avval qahvani yoqtirmasdim.

**So'roq:** Did + ega + use to...?
- **Did** you **use to** smoke? — Avval chekar edingizmi?

## Used to — ham odat, ham holat uchun
- **Odat:** I **used to** go jogging every morning.
- **Holat:** There **used to** be a cinema here. — Bu yerda avval kinoteatr bo'lgan.

## Would (o'tmishdagi odat uchun)
Faqat **takrorlanuvchi harakatlar** uchun ishlatiladi (holat uchun EMAS):
- When I was a child, I **would** visit my grandmother every summer. — Bolaligimda men har yozda buvimni ziyorat qilardim.

**Muhim farq:** "Would" holatni bildirish uchun ishlatilmaydi:
- ❌ There would be a cinema here. → ✅ There **used to be** a cinema here.
- ✅ We **would** play in the garden. (harakat — to'g'ri)

## Used to vs Be used to — chalkashtirmang!
- **Used to + fe'l** — o'tmishdagi odat: I **used to** live there.
- **Be used to + gerund/ot** — o'rganib qolgan, moslashgan: I **am used to** living here. (hozir ham shu holatga o'rganib qolganman)

## Keng tarqalgan xatolar
- ❌ I use to play football. (hozirgi vaqt shaklida ishlatib bo'lmaydi) → ✅ I **used to** play football.
- ❌ I didn't used to like it. → ✅ I **didn't use to** like it. (did dan keyin used emas, use)
- ❌ There would be a shop here. (holat uchun) → ✅ There **used to be** a shop here.

## Mashq
1. I ___ (use to/used to) hate vegetables when I was young.
2. ___ (Did you use to/Did you used to) play any instruments?
3. There ___ (used to be/would be) a park near my house.

topics.name: 3. Present Forms for Future
topics.content:
# Present Forms for Future (Kelajak Uchun Hozirgi Zamon Shakllari)

## Ta'rif
Ba'zi hollarda kelajakdagi voqealarni bildirish uchun **Present Simple** yoki **Present Continuous** ishlatiladi — bu odatda jadval yoki aniq kelishuvlarga tegishli.

## 1. Present Simple — jadval, dastur bo'yicha kelajak voqealari
Rasmiy jadval, transport jadvali, dars jadvali kabi o'zgarmas rejalar uchun:
- The train **leaves** at 9 AM tomorrow. — Poyezd ertaga soat 9da jo'naydi.
- The meeting **starts** at 10 o'clock. — Yig'ilish soat 10da boshlanadi.
- School **begins** on September 1st. — Maktab 1-sentyabrda boshlanadi.

## 2. Present Continuous — aniq shaxsiy kelishuv/reja
Shaxsiy, aniq kelishilgan kelajak rejalari uchun (odatda vaqt/joy ko'rsatilgan):
- I **am meeting** John at 5 PM tomorrow. — Men ertaga soat 5da Jon bilan uchrashaman.
- We **are flying** to Paris next week. — Biz kelasi hafta Parijga uchamiz.

## Farqi: Present Simple vs Present Continuous (kelajak uchun)

| Present Simple (jadval) | Present Continuous (shaxsiy reja) |
|---|---|
| The film **starts** at 8. (kinoteatr jadvali) | I**'m watching** a film with her at 8. (shaxsiy reja) |
| The plane **departs** at 6 AM. | We**'re flying** to London at 6 AM. |

## Be going to bilan solishtirish
- **Going to** — umumiy niyat: I'**m going to** travel this summer.
- **Present Continuous** — aniq, kelishilgan reja: I'**m flying** to Rome on Friday. (chipta olingan, aniq)

## Keng tarqalgan xatolar
- ❌ The train leaving at 9. (be tushib qolgan) → ✅ The train **is leaving**/**leaves** at 9.
- ❌ I go to the dentist tomorrow at 3 (shaxsiy uchrashuv uchun Simple noto'g'ri, lekin ba'zan ishlatiladi) → tabiiyroq: I'**m going** to the dentist tomorrow at 3.

## Mashq
1. The concert ___ (starts/is starting) at 7 PM sharp. (jadval)
2. I ___ (meet/am meeting) my friends for dinner tonight. (shaxsiy reja)
3. The shop ___ (opens/is opening) at 9 AM every day.

topics.name: 4. Stative vs Dynamic Verbs
topics.content:
# Stative vs Dynamic Verbs (Holat va Harakat Fe'llari)

## Ta'rif
Fe'llar ikki turga bo'linadi: **stative** (holat fe'llari — his-tuyg'u, fikr, egalikni bildiradi) va **dynamic** (harakat fe'llari — jismoniy/faol harakatni bildiradi). Bu farq Continuous zamonlarni to'g'ri ishlatish uchun juda muhim.

## Stative Fe'llar (odatda -ing shaklda ISHLATILMAYDI)

**Fikr/aql:** know, believe, understand, think (fikr ma'nosida), remember, forget
**His-tuyg'u:** like, love, hate, want, prefer, need
**Egalik:** have (egalik ma'nosida), own, belong, possess
**Sezgi:** see, hear, smell, taste (idrok ma'nosida)
**Boshqa:** seem, appear, cost, weigh, contain, consist

Misollar:
- ❌ I am knowing the answer. → ✅ I **know** the answer.
- ❌ She is loving this song. → ✅ She **loves** this song.
- ❌ This bag is costing $50. → ✅ This bag **costs** $50.

## Dynamic Fe'llar (Continuous shaklda ishlatilishi mumkin)
run, eat, write, play, work, talk, walk, cook, study
- I **am running**. — Men yugurayapman.
- She **is cooking** dinner. — U kechki ovqat tayyorlayapti.

## Ikki xil ma'noga ega fe'llar (holat HAM, harakat HAM bo'lishi mumkin)

| Fe'l | Stative (holat) ma'noda | Dynamic (harakat) ma'noda |
|---|---|---|
| think | I **think** it's true. (fikr) | I**'m thinking** about you. (jarayon) |
| have | I **have** a car. (egalik) | I**'m having** lunch. (harakat — ovqatlanish) |
| see | I **see** a bird. (ko'rish, idrok) | I**'m seeing** a doctor tomorrow. (uchrashish) |
| taste | This soup **tastes** good. (xususiyat) | She**'s tasting** the soup. (harakat — tatib ko'ryapti)|

## Nega bu muhim
Present Continuous, Past Continuous kabi zamonlarni to'g'ri ishlatish uchun fe'lning stative yoki dynamic ekanini bilish shart.

## Keng tarqalgan xatolar
- ❌ I am understanding you. → ✅ I **understand** you.
- ❌ She is wanting to leave. → ✅ She **wants** to leave.
- ❌ Are you believing me? → ✅ **Do you believe** me?

## Mashq
1. I ___ (am thinking/think) that she is right. (fikr)
2. He ___ (is having/has) a shower right now. (harakat)
3. This cake ___ (is tasting/tastes) delicious. (xususiyat)

topics.name: 1. Ability - Can Could
topics.content:
# Ability: Can / Could (Qobiliyat)

## Ta'rif
"Can" va "could" — qobiliyat, imkoniyat bildirish uchun ishlatiladigan modal fe'llar.

## Can — hozirgi qobiliyat
- I **can** swim. — Men suzishni bilaman.
- She **can** speak three languages. — U uch tilda gaplasha oladi.

**Inkor:** can't / cannot
- I **can't** drive. — Men mashina hayday olmayman.

**So'roq:** Can + ega + fe'l...?
- **Can** you help me? — Menga yordam bera olasizmi?

## Could — o'tmishdagi qobiliyat
- When I was young, I **could** run very fast. — Yosh bo'lganimda men juda tez yugura olardim.
- She **could** read at the age of 4. — U 4 yoshida o'qiy olardi.

**Inkor:** couldn't
- I **couldn't** swim when I was 5. — Men 5 yoshimda suzishni bilmasdim.

## Bir martalik o'tgan muvaffaqiyat uchun "could" ISHLATILMAYDI
Umumiy qobiliyat uchun "could" ishlatiladi, lekin **bir martalik, aniq muvaffaqiyatga erishilgan** harakat uchun "was/were able to" yoki "managed to" ishlatiladi:
- ❌ I could pass the exam yesterday.
- ✅ I **was able to** pass the exam yesterday. / I **managed to** pass the exam.
- ✅ (Umumiy qobiliyat uchun to'g'ri: I **could** speak French when I was a child.)

## Be able to — boshqa zamonlarda qobiliyat
"Can/could" faqat hozirgi va o'tmish uchun to'liq shaklga ega, boshqa zamonlarda "be able to" ishlatiladi:
- I **will be able to** help you tomorrow. — Ertaga sizga yordam bera olaman.
- I **have been able to** finish it. — Men uni tugata oldim.

## Keng tarqalgan xatolar
- ❌ I can to swim. → ✅ I **can swim**. ("to" kerak emas)
- ❌ She cans speak English. → ✅ She **can speak** English. (can -s olmaydi)
- ❌ I could finish the marathon yesterday. (bir martalik muvaffaqiyat) → ✅ I **was able to** finish the marathon yesterday.

## Mashq
1. My grandfather ___ (can/could) speak five languages when he was alive.
2. I ___ (can/am able to) come to your party tomorrow.
3. She ___ (could/was able to) solve the puzzle after trying many times. (bir martalik muvaffaqiyat)

topics.name: 2. Permission - May Can
topics.content:
# Permission: May / Can (Ruxsat)

## Ta'rif
Ruxsat so'rash yoki berish uchun ishlatiladigan modal fe'llar.

## May — rasmiy ruxsat
- **May** I come in? — Kirsam maylimi? (rasmiy)
- You **may** leave now. — Siz hozir ketishingiz mumkin. (rasmiy ruxsat berish)

## Can — norasmiy ruxsat (kundalik nutqda ko'proq ishlatiladi)
- **Can** I use your phone? — Telefoningizdan foydalansam bo'ladimi?
- You **can** go now. — Endi ketsangiz bo'ladi.

## Could — yanada xushmuomalaroq so'rash
- **Could** I ask you something? — Sizdan biror narsa so'rasam bo'ladimi? (yanada muloyim)

## Rasmiylik darajasi (kamdan ko'pga)
```
Can (norasmiy) < Could (muloyim) < May (rasmiy)
```

## Ruxsat berish va rad etish

**Ruxsat berish:**
- Yes, you **may**. / Yes, you **can**. / Sure, go ahead.

**Rad etish:**
- No, you **may not**. / No, you **can't**. / I'm afraid not.

## Inkor shakl — taqiqlash uchun
- You **may not** smoke here. — Bu yerda chekish mumkin emas. (rasmiy taqiq)
- You **can't** park here. — Bu yerda to'xtash mumkin emas.

## May vs Might — farqi (ehtimollik uchun, ruxsat emas)
Eslatma: "May" ruxsat MA'NOSIDAN tashqari, ehtimollikni ham bildiradi:
- It **may** rain later. — Keyinroq yomg'ir yog'ishi mumkin. (bu — ruxsat emas, ehtimollik)

## Keng tarqalgan xatolar
- ❌ Can I to leave? → ✅ **Can I leave**? ("to" kerak emas)
- ❌ May I to ask a question? → ✅ **May I ask** a question?

## Mashq
1. ___ (May/Can) I borrow your pen, please? (rasmiy so'rash)
2. You ___ (may not/can) enter without a ticket.
3. ___ (Could/May) you pass the salt? (norasmiy, muloyim)

topics.name: 3. Obligation - Must Have to
topics.content:
# Obligation: Must / Have to (Majburiyat)

## Ta'rif
Majburiyat, zaruratni bildirish uchun ishlatiladi — "qilishi shart" ma'nosida.

## Must — ichki majburiyat (shaxsning o'z fikri)
- I **must** finish this report today. — Men bu hisobotni bugun tugatishim kerak. (o'zim shunday deb hisoblayman)
- You **must** study harder. — Siz ko'proq o'qishingiz kerak. (kuchli tavsiya/buyruq)

## Have to — tashqi majburiyat (qoida, qonun, boshqa birov talab qiladi)
- I **have to** wear a uniform at work. — Men ishda forma kiyishim kerak. (kompaniya qoidasi)
- She **has to** renew her passport. — U pasportini yangilashi kerak. (qonun talabi)

## Must vs Have to — farqi

| Must | Have to |
|---|---|
| Ichki his, shaxsiy fikr | Tashqi qoida, boshqa birov belgilagan |
| I **must** call my mother. (o'zim his qilaman) | I **have to** wear a helmet. (qonun talabi) |
| Faqat hozirgi zamonda ishlatiladi | Barcha zamonlarda ishlatiladi (had to, will have to) |

## Inkor shakllar — MUHIM FARQ!
- **Mustn't** — taqiqlash (qilish MUMKIN EMAS):
  - You **mustn't** smoke here. — Bu yerda chekish mumkin emas (taqiqlangan).
- **Don't have to** — zarurat yo'q (qilish shart emas, lekin mumkin):
  - You **don't have to** come if you're busy. — Agar band bo'lsangiz, kelishingiz shart emas.

Bu ikkalasi butunlay boshqa ma'noni bildiradi!

## Boshqa zamonlarda
Must faqat hozirgi zamonda ishlatiladi. Boshqa zamonlar uchun "have to" ishlatiladi:
- Past: I **had to** work yesterday.
- Future: I **will have to** work tomorrow.

## Keng tarqalgan xatolar
- ❌ I must to go. → ✅ I **must go**. ("to" kerak emas)
- ❌ You mustn't come if you're busy. (noto'g'ri ma'no — "taqiqlangan" bo'lib qoladi) → ✅ You **don't have to** come if you're busy.
- ❌ I musted go yesterday. → ✅ I **had to** go yesterday.

## Mashq
1. You ___ (mustn't/don't have to) tell anyone — it's a secret.
2. I ___ (don't have to/mustn't) work tomorrow, it's a holiday.
3. Students ___ (must/has to) wear uniforms at this school.

topics.name: 4. Advice - Should
topics.content:
# Advice: Should (Maslahat)

## Ta'rif
Maslahat berish, tavsiya qilish uchun ishlatiladigan modal fe'l — "qilgan ma'qul" ma'nosida.

## Shakllanish
ega + **should** + fe'l (bazaviy shakl)
- You **should** see a doctor. — Siz shifokorga ko'rinsangiz yaxshi bo'lardi.
- We **should** leave now. — Bizga hozir ketgan ma'qul.

**Inkor:** shouldn't
- You **shouldn't** eat too much sugar. — Sizga ko'p shakar yemaslik kerak.

**So'roq:** Should + ega + fe'l...?
- **Should** I call her? — Unga qo'ng'iroq qilsam bo'ladimi?

## Should vs Must — kuchi farqi
- **Should** — maslahat, tavsiya (majburiy emas): You **should** exercise more.
- **Must** — kuchli majburiyat: You **must** wear a seatbelt. (qonun)

## Ought to — should bilan bir xil ma'noda
"Ought to" — "should" bilan deyarli bir xil ma'noni bildiradi, biroz rasmiyroq:
- You **ought to** apologize. = You **should** apologize.

## Had better — kuchliroq maslahat (ogohlantirish bilan)
"Had better" — "should" dan kuchliroq, salbiy oqibat haqida ogohlantiradi:
- You **had better** hurry, or you'll miss the bus. — Shoshiling, aks holda avtobusga ulgurmaysiz.
- Qisqartma: You**'d better**...

## Should have + 3-shakl — o'tmishdagi pushaymonlik
O'tmishda qilinmagan, lekin qilinishi kerak bo'lgan ish haqida:
- I **should have studied** more. — Menga ko'proq o'qishim kerak edi (lekin o'qimadim).
- You **shouldn't have said** that. — Sizga buni aytmasligingiz kerak edi.

## Keng tarqalgan xatolar
- ❌ You should to see a doctor. → ✅ You **should see** a doctor.
- ❌ You should studied more. → ✅ You **should have studied** more.
- ❌ She shoulds call him. → ✅ She **should call** him. (should -s olmaydi)

## Mashq
1. You ___ (should/must) try this restaurant, it's amazing.
2. I ___ (should have/should) called her yesterday, but I forgot.
3. You'd ___ (better/should) leave now, the traffic is bad.

topics.name: 5. Deduction - Must be
topics.content:
# Deduction: Must be (Mantiqiy Xulosa)

## Ta'rif
Dalillar asosida qilingan mantiqiy xulosa yoki taxminni bildiradi — "aftidan, ...bo'lsa kerak" ma'nosida.

## Ehtimollik darajasi bo'yicha modal fe'llar

| Modal | Ma'no | Ishonch darajasi |
|---|---|---|
| **must** | albatta shunday (kuchli ishonch) | ~95% |
| **may/might/could** | ehtimol shunday | ~50% |
| **can't** | albatta bunday emas (kuchli inkor) | ~95% (salbiy) |

## Must — kuchli ijobiy xulosa
- She hasn't eaten all day. She **must be** hungry. — U kun bo'yi ovqat yemadi. U och bo'lsa kerak.
- He knows everything about Paris. He **must have** been there before. — U Parij haqida hammasini biladi. U avval u yerda bo'lgan bo'lsa kerak.

## Can't — kuchli inkor xulosa
- He **can't be** at home — I just saw him at the office. — U uyda bo'lishi mumkin emas — men uni hozirgina ofisda ko'rdim.

## May/Might/Could — noaniq taxmin
- She **might be** at work now. — U hozir ishda bo'lishi mumkin.
- It **could rain** later. — Keyinroq yomg'ir yog'ishi mumkin.

## O'tmish haqida xulosa: modal + have + 3-shakl
- He **must have forgotten** the meeting. — U yig'ilishni unutgan bo'lsa kerak.
- She **can't have said** that. — U buni aytgan bo'lishi mumkin emas.
- They **might have missed** the bus. — Ular avtobusga ulgurmagan bo'lishlari mumkin.

## Muhim eslatma
"Mustn't" — bu yerda **taqiqni** bildiradi, "ehtimol emas" degan ma'noni EMAS. Ehtimol emaslikni bildirish uchun **can't** ishlatiladi:
- ❌ He mustn't be at home. (noto'g'ri — bu taqiq bo'lib qoladi)
- ✅ He **can't be** at home.

## Keng tarqalgan xatolar
- ❌ She must to be tired. → ✅ She **must be** tired.
- ❌ He must went there before. → ✅ He **must have gone** there before.
- ❌ It mustn't be true. (ehtimol emas ma'nosida) → ✅ It **can't be** true.

## Mashq
1. The lights are off. They ___ (must/can't) be home.
2. She speaks perfect Japanese. She ___ (might/must) have lived in Japan.
3. He ___ (can't have/must have) forgotten — he always remembers birthdays.

topics.name: 6. Past Modals
topics.content:
# Past Modals (Should have, Could have, Would have)

## Ta'rif
Modal fe'llar + **have + fe'lning 3-shakli** tuzilmasi o'tmishdagi imkoniyat, pushaymonlik yoki taxminni bildiradi.

## Should have + 3-shakl — pushaymonlik/tanqid
Qilinmagan, lekin qilinishi kerak bo'lgan ish haqida pushaymonlik:
- I **should have studied** harder. — Menga ko'proq o'qishim kerak edi (o'qimadim, endi pushaymonman).
- You **shouldn't have shouted** at him. — Sizga unga baqirmasligingiz kerak edi.

## Could have + 3-shakl — o'tmishdagi imkoniyat (amalga oshmagan)
Imkoniyat bor edi, lekin amalga oshmadi:
- I **could have helped** you, but you didn't ask. — Men sizga yordam bera olardim, lekin siz so'ramadingiz.
- She **could have won** the race, but she fell. — U poygada g'olib chiqishi mumkin edi, lekin yiqilib tushdi.

## Would have + 3-shakl — shart bajarilganda bo'lardigan natija
Odatda Third Conditional bilan ishlatiladi:
- If I had known, I **would have told** you. — Agar bilganimda, sizga aytган bo'lardim.

## Must have + 3-shakl — o'tmish haqida kuchli taxmin
- He **must have left** already. — U allaqachon ketgan bo'lsa kerak.

## Might/May have + 3-shakl — o'tmish haqida noaniq taxmin
- She **might have forgotten** about the meeting. — U yig'ilish haqida unutgan bo'lishi mumkin.

## Solishtirma jadval

| Tuzilma | Ma'no | Misol |
|---|---|---|
| should have | pushaymonlik/tanqid | You **should have called**. |
| could have | amalga oshmagan imkoniyat | I **could have gone**. |
| would have | shartli natija | I **would have helped**. |
| must have | kuchli taxmin | He **must have known**. |
| might have | noaniq taxmin | She **might have left**. |

## Talaffuz eslatmasi
Og'zaki nutqda "have" ko'pincha "of" kabi talaffuz qilinadi (should've, could've) — lekin yozishda **"should of"** deb yozish katta xato!
- ❌ I should of called you. → ✅ I **should have** called you. (should've)

## Keng tarqalgan xatolar
- ❌ I should have go. → ✅ I should have **gone**. (3-shakl kerak)
- ❌ She could helped me. (have tushib qolgan) → ✅ She could **have** helped me.

## Mashq
1. I ___ (should have/could have) apologized, but I was too proud.
2. If I had more time, I ___ (would have/should have) finished the project.
3. He looks upset. Something bad ___ (must have/might have) happened.

topics.name: 1. Gerund
topics.content:
# Gerund (V+ing — Ot O'rnidagi Fe'l)

## Ta'rif
Gerund — fe'lga **-ing** qo'shish orqali hosil qilingan, lekin **ot vazifasini** bajaruvchi shakl.

## Ishlatilish holatlari

**1. Gapning egasi sifatida:**
- **Swimming** is good for health. — Suzish sog'liq uchun foydali.

**2. Ba'zi fe'llardan keyin (to'ldiruvchi sifatida):**
Quyidagi fe'llardan keyin faqat gerund ishlatiladi: enjoy, finish, avoid, mind, suggest, consider, practice, admit, deny, imagine, miss, quit, risk

- I **enjoy reading** books. — Men kitob o'qishni yoqtiraman.
- She **finished cleaning** the house. — U uyni tozalashni tugatdi.
- Would you mind **closing** the door? — Eshikni yopishni malol olmaysizmi?

**3. Predlogdan keyin (doim gerund!):**
- She is interested **in learning** French. — U fransuz tilini o'rganishga qiziqadi.
- I'm good **at cooking**. — Men ovqat pishirishda yaxshiman.
- Thank you **for helping** me. — Yordam berganingiz uchun rahmat.

**4. Ba'zi iboralardan keyin:**
- It's no use **crying**. — Yig'lashning foydasi yo'q.
- There's no point **in waiting**. — Kutishning ma'nosi yo'q.

## Gerund vs Infinitive tanlovi
Ba'zi fe'llar faqat gerund, ba'zilari faqat infinitive, ba'zilari ikkalasini ham qabul qiladi (bu keyingi mavzularda batafsil ko'riladi).

## Keng tarqalgan xatolar
- ❌ I enjoy to read. → ✅ I enjoy **reading**.
- ❌ She is good in cook. → ✅ She is good **at cooking**.
- ❌ I look forward to see you. → ✅ I look forward to **seeing** you. ("to" bu yerda predlog, gerund kerak)

## Mashq
1. I finished ___ (write) the report.
2. She is afraid of ___ (fly).
3. Thank you for ___ (help) me yesterday.

topics.name: 2. To Infinitive
topics.content:
# To Infinitive (To + Fe'l)

## Ta'rif
"To" + fe'lning bazaviy shakli — maqsad, niyat yoki ba'zi fe'llardan keyin to'ldiruvchi sifatida ishlatiladi.

## Ishlatilish holatlari

**1. Maqsadni bildirish uchun ("...uchun"):**
- I went to the shop **to buy** milk. — Men sut sotib olish uchun do'konga bordim.
- She called **to ask** about the meeting. — U yig'ilish haqida so'rash uchun qo'ng'iroq qildi.

**2. Ba'zi fe'llardan keyin (to'ldiruvchi sifatida):**
Quyidagi fe'llardan keyin faqat to-infinitive ishlatiladi: want, need, decide, plan, hope, promise, agree, refuse, offer, learn, manage, expect

- I **want to travel** the world. — Men dunyoni sayohat qilishni xohlayman.
- She **decided to study** abroad. — U chet elda o'qishga qaror qildi.
- They **agreed to help** us. — Ular bizga yordam berishga rozi bo'lishdi.

**3. Sifatdan keyin:**
- It's important **to be** honest. — Halol bo'lish muhim.
- I'm happy **to see** you. — Sizni ko'rganimdan xursandman.

**4. Ba'zi otlardan keyin:**
- I have a lot of work **to do**. — Menda qiladigan ko'p ishim bor.
- It's time **to go**. — Ketish vaqti keldi.

**5. "Too" va "enough" bilan:**
- This box is too heavy **to carry**. — Bu quti ko'tarish uchun juda og'ir.
- She's old **enough to** drive. — U mashina haydashga yetarlicha katta.

## Bare Infinitive bilan chalkashtirmang
- To infinitive: I want **to go**.
- Bare infinitive (to siz): I can **go**. (modal fe'llardan keyin "to" ishlatilmaydi — bu alohida mavzu)

## Keng tarqalgan xatolar
- ❌ I want go home. ("to" tushib qolgan) → ✅ I want **to go** home.
- ❌ She decided going abroad. → ✅ She decided **to go** abroad.
- ❌ I went to shop for buy milk. → ✅ I went to the shop **to buy** milk.

## Mashq
1. I need ___ (finish) this project today.
2. She promised ___ (call) me later.
3. It's too cold ___ (swim) in the sea.

topics.name: 3. Bare Infinitive
topics.content:
# Bare Infinitive ('To'siz Fe'l)

## Ta'rif
"To" siz ishlatiladigan fe'lning bazaviy shakli — modal fe'llardan va ba'zi boshqa fe'llardan keyin ishlatiladi.

## 1. Modal fe'llardan keyin (doim "to" siz!)
can, could, will, would, shall, should, may, might, must

- I **can swim**. — Men suza olaman. (can to swim EMAS)
- You **must go**. — Siz borishingiz kerak.
- She **should call** him. — U unga qo'ng'iroq qilishi kerak.

## 2. Let, make bilan (sabab fe'llari — causative)
- She **let** me **borrow** her book. — U menga kitobini olishimga ruxsat berdi.
- He **made** me **laugh**. — U meni kuldirdi.

Eslatma: "get" bilan esa **to** ishlatiladi: She **got** me **to help** her. (bu istisno)

## 3. Sezgi fe'llaridan keyin (see, hear, feel, watch, notice)
To'liq harakatni ko'rish/eshitishda:
- I **saw** him **leave**. — Men uning ketganini ko'rdim.
- She **heard** them **talk**. — U ularning gaplashganini eshitdi.

(Eslatma: agar harakat davomida — -ing shakli ham ishlatilishi mumkin: I saw him **leaving** — jarayonni ko'rgan ma'nosida)

## 4. "Had better" va "would rather" dan keyin
- You **had better go** now. — Siz hozir ketganingiz ma'qul.
- I **would rather stay** home. — Men uyda qolishni afzal ko'raman.

## 5. "Why not" iborasida
- **Why not try** something new? — Nega yangi narsani sinab ko'rmaslik kerak?

## Solishtirma jadval

| To Infinitive | Bare Infinitive |
|---|---|
| I want **to go**. | I can **go**. |
| She decided **to help**. | She let me **help**. |
| He needs **to leave**. | He must **leave**. |

## Keng tarqalgan xatolar
- ❌ I can to swim. → ✅ I **can swim**.
- ❌ She made me to laugh. → ✅ She made me **laugh**.
- ❌ You should to call her. → ✅ You should **call** her.

## Mashq
1. My parents let me ___ (go/to go) to the party.
2. You must ___ (finish/to finish) your homework.
3. The teacher made us ___ (rewrite/to rewrite) the essay.

topics.name: 1. Separable Phrasal Verbs
topics.content:
# Separable Phrasal Verbs (Ajraladigan Frazaviy Fe'llar)

## Ta'rif
Frazaviy fe'l — fe'l + predlog/ravish birikmasidan iborat bo'lib, ma'nosi ko'pincha so'zma-so'z tarjimadan farq qiladi. "Separable" (ajraladigan) turlari — to'ldiruvchi fe'l bilan ravish orasiga kirishi mumkin.

## Qoida
Separable phrasal verb'larda to'ldiruvchi (obyekt) ikki joyda bo'lishi mumkin:
1. Fe'l + ravish + obyekt
2. Fe'l + obyekt + ravish

**Lekin agar obyekt olmosh (it, him, her, them) bo'lsa — FAQAT o'rtaga qo'yiladi!**

## Misollar

**Turn off (o'chirmoq):**
- **Turn off** the light. / **Turn** the light **off**. — Chiroqni o'chir. (ikkalasi ham to'g'ri)
- **Turn** it **off**. ✅ (olmosh bilan — faqat shu tartib)
- ❌ Turn off it.

**Pick up (ko'tarmoq, olib ketmoq):**
- **Pick up** the phone. / **Pick** the phone **up**.
- **Pick** it **up**. ✅
- ❌ Pick up it.

## Eng ko'p ishlatiladigan separable phrasal verbs

| Phrasal Verb | Ma'nosi |
|---|---|
| turn on/off | yoqmoq/o'chirmoq |
| pick up | ko'tarmoq, olib ketmoq |
| put on | kiymoq |
| take off | yechmoq |
| give up | tark etmoq |
| fill in/out | to'ldirmoq |
| write down | yozib qo'ymoq |
| throw away | tashlab yubormoq |

## Misollar to'liq gapda
- Please **fill** this form **in**. / Please **fill in** this form.
- I **wrote down** her number. / I **wrote** her number **down**.
- Could you **turn** the music **down**? — Musiqani pasaytira olasizmi?

## Keng tarqalgan xatolar
- ❌ Turn off it. → ✅ **Turn it off**.
- ❌ Pick up her. → ✅ **Pick her up**.

## Mashq
1. Can you turn ___ the TV? It's too loud. (down)
2. I need to pick ___ my kids from school. (up) — ___ them ___ ?
3. Please take ___ your shoes. (off)

topics.name: 2. Inseparable Phrasal Verbs
topics.content:
# Inseparable Phrasal Verbs (Ajralmaydigan Frazaviy Fe'llar)

## Ta'rif
Ba'zi frazaviy fe'llarda fe'l va predlog/ravish ORASIGA hech narsa kirmaydi — obyekt doim fe'l birikmasidan KEYIN keladi.

## Qoida
**Fe'l + predlog + obyekt** (obyekt hech qachon o'rtaga kirmaydi)

- **Look after** the baby. — Chaqaloqqa qarash.
- **Look after him**. ✅
- ❌ Look him after.

## Eng ko'p ishlatiladigan inseparable phrasal verbs

| Phrasal Verb | Ma'nosi |
|---|---|
| look after | g'amxo'rlik qilmoq, qaramoq |
| look into | tekshirmoq, o'rganmoq |
| get over | dan tuzalmoq, yengib o'tmoq |
| run into | tasodifan uchramoq |
| come across | tasodifan topmoq/uchramoq |
| deal with | shug'ullanmoq |
| take after | o'xshamoq (oila a'zosiga) |
| go through | boshdan kechirmoq |

## Misollar
- She **looks after** her little brother every day. — U har kuni ukasiga qaraydi.
- We need to **look into** this problem. — Biz bu muammoni tekshirishimiz kerak.
- I **ran into** an old friend yesterday. — Men kecha eski do'stimga tasodifan duch keldim.
- He **takes after** his father. — U otasiga o'xshaydi.

## Uch qismli phrasal verbs (ham inseparable)
Ba'zi phrasal verbs ikkita predlogdan iborat bo'ladi — bular ham ajralmaydi:
- **look forward to** — intiqlik bilan kutmoq: I **look forward to seeing** you.
- **get along with** — kelisha olmoq: She **gets along with** everyone.
- **come up with** — o'ylab topmoq: He **came up with** a great idea.

## Separable vs Inseparable — qanday farqlash mumkin
Aniq qoida yo'q — bu har bir phrasal verb uchun alohida yodlanishi kerak. Lug'atlarda odatda ko'rsatilgan bo'ladi.

## Keng tarqalgan xatolar
- ❌ Look the baby after. → ✅ **Look after** the baby.
- ❌ I ran an old friend into. → ✅ I **ran into** an old friend.

## Mashq
1. Who is looking ___ your dog while you're away? (after)
2. I came ___ an interesting article today. (across)
3. She always gets along ___ her colleagues. (with)

topics.name: 3. Common Phrasal Verbs List
topics.content:
# Common Phrasal Verbs List (Eng Ko'p Ishlatiladigan Frazaviy Fe'llar)

## Ta'rif
Kundalik nutqda eng tez-tez uchraydigan frazaviy fe'llar ro'yxati — mavzular bo'yicha guruhlangan.

## Kunlik hayot
- **wake up** — uyg'onmoq: I **wake up** at 7 AM.
- **get up** — o'rnidan turmoq: He **got up** late today.
- **get dressed** — kiyinmoq
- **turn on/off** — yoqmoq/o'chirmoq
- **clean up** — tozalamoq: Let's **clean up** the kitchen.

## Ijtimoiy hayot
- **hang out** — vaqt o'tkazmoq (do'stlar bilan): We **hang out** every weekend.
- **catch up** — yangiliklarni bilib olmoq: Let's **catch up** over coffee.
- **get along (with)** — kelisha olmoq
- **fall out (with)** — janjallashmoq: They **fell out** over money.
- **make up** — yarashmoq (janjaldan keyin)

## Ish va o'qish
- **give up** — tark etmoq, taslim bo'lmoq
- **carry on** — davom etmoq
- **look into** — tekshirmoq
- **come up with** — g'oya topmoq
- **hand in** — topshirmoq: **Hand in** your homework.
- **figure out** — tushunib yetmoq: I can't **figure out** this problem.

## Sayohat va harakat
- **check in** — ro'yxatdan o'tmoq (aeroport, mehmonxona)
- **check out** — chiqib ketmoq (mehmonxona)
- **set off** — yo'lga chiqmoq
- **take off** — parvoz qilmoq (samolyot); yechmoq (kiyim)
- **get on/off** — chiqmoq/tushmoq (transport)

## His-tuyg'u va munosabat
- **look forward to** — intiqlik bilan kutmoq
- **get over** — tuzalmoq, unutmoq
- **cheer up** — ko'nglini ko'tarmoq
- **calm down** — tinchlanmoq

## Misollar to'liq gapda
- I **look forward to** seeing you soon. — Sizni tez orada ko'rishni intiqlik bilan kutaman.
- Don't **give up**! You can do it. — Taslim bo'lma! Sen bunga qodirsan.
- We need to **figure out** a solution. — Biz yechim topishimiz kerak.

## O'rganish maslahati
Phrasal verb'larni alohida so'z sifatida emas, **butun ibora** sifatida (masalan, "give up" — bitta birlik) yodlash kerak, chunki ularning ma'nosi ko'pincha so'zma-so'z tarjimadan farq qiladi.

## Mashq
1. I need to ___ (figure out/give up) how to fix this.
2. Don't ___ (give up/hang out) on your dreams.
3. We ___ (checked in/checked out) at the hotel at 2 PM.

topics.name: 1. So plus auxiliary
topics.content:
# So + Auxiliary ("So do I")

## Ta'rif
Boshqa birovning **ijobiy** fikriga qo'shilish, "men ham" degan ma'noni bildirish uchun ishlatiladi.

## Tuzilish formulasi
**So + auxiliary fe'l + ega**

## Qoida: auxiliary fe'l tanlash
Auxiliary fe'l — birinchi gapdagi zamon/fe'lga mos bo'lishi kerak:

| Birinchi gap | Javob |
|---|---|
| I **like** coffee. | **So do I.** |
| She **is** tired. | **So am I.** |
| We **have finished**. | **So have I.** |
| He **can swim**. | **So can I.** |
| I **went** there. | **So did I.** |

## Misollar to'liq dialogda
- A: I love pizza. — B: **So do I**! (Men ham yoqtiraman!)
- A: She is a teacher. — B: **So is** my sister. (Mening singlim ham o'qituvchi.)
- A: We have visited Paris. — B: **So have** we. (Biz ham tashrif buyurganmiz.)

## So'z tartibi — muhim!
"So" dan keyin auxiliary va ega **joy almashadi** (savol tartibida):
- ✅ **So do I.** (to'g'ri tartib)
- ❌ So I do.

## "So" vs "Too" — farqi
- **So** + auxiliary + ega: **So do I.**
- Ega + auxiliary + **too**: **I do, too.**

Ikkalasi ham bir xil ma'noni beradi, faqat tuzilishi farq qiladi.

## Keng tarqalgan xatolar
- ❌ So I am. → ✅ **So am I.**
- ❌ So does she like it. → ✅ **So does she.**

## Mashq
1. A: I'm hungry. — B: ___ (So am I / So I am).
2. A: They went to the party. — B: ___ (So did we / So we did).
3. A: She can drive. — B: ___ (So can I / So I can).

topics.name: 2. Neither plus auxiliary
topics.content:
# Neither + Auxiliary ("Neither do I")

## Ta'rif
Boshqa birovning **inkor** fikriga qo'shilish, "men ham...emasman" degan ma'noni bildirish uchun ishlatiladi.

## Tuzilish formulasi
**Neither + auxiliary fe'l (ijobiy shaklda) + ega**

Muhim: "Neither" o'zi allaqachon inkor ma'no berganligi uchun, undan keyingi auxiliary **ijobiy** shaklda bo'ladi (do, am, have — not qo'shilmaydi).

## Misollar

| Birinchi gap | Javob |
|---|---|
| I **don't like** coffee. | **Neither do I.** |
| She **isn't** hungry. | **Neither am I.** |
| We **haven't finished**. | **Neither have I.** |
| He **can't swim**. | **Neither can I.** |

## Misollar to'liq dialogda
- A: I don't eat meat. — B: **Neither do I**. (Men ham yemayman.)
- A: She can't come tonight. — B: **Neither can** I. (Men ham kela olmayman.)
- A: We haven't seen that film. — B: **Neither have** we. (Biz ham ko'rmaganmiz.)

## "Neither" vs "Nor" — ikkalasi ham ishlatiladi
- **Neither do I.** = **Nor do I.** (ikkalasi ham to'g'ri, "neither" ko'proq ishlatiladi)

## "Neither" o'rniga "Me neither" (norasmiy)
Kundalik og'zaki nutqda qisqaroq shakl ham ishlatiladi:
- A: I don't like spicy food. — B: **Me neither**. (norasmiy, lekin juda keng tarqalgan)

## So'z tartibi — muhim!
"Neither" dan keyin auxiliary va ega joy almashadi (savol tartibida), xuddi "so" kabi:
- ✅ **Neither do I.**
- ❌ Neither I do.

## Keng tarqalgan xatolar
- ❌ Neither don't I. (auxiliary ijobiy bo'lishi kerak) → ✅ **Neither do I.**
- ❌ Neither I am. → ✅ **Neither am I.**

## Mashq
1. A: I don't like horror movies. — B: ___ (Neither do I / Neither don't I).
2. A: She isn't coming. — B: ___ (Neither is she / Neither am I).
3. A: We can't afford it. — B: ___ (Neither can we / So can we).

topics.name: 3. Too and As well
topics.content:
# Too / As well (Qo'shimcha Rozilik — Ijobiy)

## Ta'rif
"Too" va "as well" — ijobiy gaplarga "men ham" qo'shish uchun ishlatiladi, lekin "so" dan farqli o'laroq, gap **oxirida** keladi.

## Tuzilish formulasi
**Ega + fe'l + ... + too / as well.**

## Misollar

| Birinchi gap | Javob |
|---|---|
| I like coffee. | I like it, **too**. / I like it **as well**. |
| She is tired. | I am, **too**. |
| We went there. | I went **too**. |

## To'liq dialog misollari
- A: I'm going to the party. — B: I'm going, **too**! (Men ham boraman!)
- A: She speaks French. — B: He speaks French, **as well**. (U ham fransuz tilida gapiradi.)

## Too vs As well — farqi
Ma'no jihatidan bir xil, faqat rasmiylik darajasi farq qiladi:
- **Too** — neytral, keng qo'llaniladi (og'zaki va yozma)
- **As well** — biroz rasmiyroq, ko'proq yozma tilda

## "Too" ning joylashuvi
Odatda gap oxirida, ba'zan o'rtada ham bo'lishi mumkin:
- I **too** like pizza. (rasmiyroq, kamroq ishlatiladi)
- I like pizza, **too**. (tabiiy, ko'proq ishlatiladi)

## So vs Too — tuzilish farqi (ikkalasi ham ijobiy uchun)

| So (auxiliary avval) | Too (gap oxirida) |
|---|---|
| **So do** I. | I do, **too**. |
| **So am** I. | I am, **too**. |

## Keng tarqalgan xatolar
- ❌ Too, I like it. (gap boshida "too" tabiiy emas) → ✅ I like it, **too**.
- ❌ I like it to. (imlo xatosi — "to" emas "too") → ✅ I like it, **too**.

## Mashq
1. A: I love this song! — B: I love it, ___ (too/either)!
2. Rewrite using "too": "I have a car." → "So do I." = "I have a car ___."
3. She can cook well, and I can cook well ___ (too/neither).

topics.name: 4. Either negative agreement
topics.content:
# Either (Salbiy Qo'shimcha Rozilik)

## Ta'rif
"Either" — inkor gaplarga "men ham...emasman" qo'shish uchun ishlatiladi, gap **oxirida** keladi (xuddi "too" ning inkor versiyasi).

## Tuzilish formulasi
**Ega + inkor fe'l + ... + either.**

## Misollar

| Birinchi gap | Javob |
|---|---|
| I don't like coffee. | I don't like it, **either**. |
| She isn't hungry. | I'm not hungry, **either**. |
| We haven't finished. | I haven't finished, **either**. |

## To'liq dialog misollari
- A: I don't eat meat. — B: I don't eat meat, **either**. (Men ham yemayman.)
- A: She can't swim. — B: He can't swim, **either**. (U ham suza olmaydi.)

## Either vs Neither — tuzilish farqi (ikkalasi ham inkor uchun)

| Neither (auxiliary avval, ijobiy shaklda) | Either (gap oxirida, inkor gap) |
|---|---|
| **Neither do** I. | I **don't**, **either**. |
| **Neither am** I. | I'**m not**, **either**. |
| **Neither can** I. | I **can't**, **either**. |

Ikkalasi ham bir xil ma'noni beradi — faqat tuzilish farq qiladi!

## Muhim eslatma: Either faqat INKOR gaplarda
"Either" ijobiy gaplarda "too" o'rnida ishlatilmaydi:
- ❌ I like it, either. → ✅ I like it, **too**.
- ✅ I don't like it, **either**.

## Solishtirma jadval — barcha to'rttasi

| | Ijobiy | Inkor |
|---|---|---|
| Auxiliary bilan (boshida) | **So** do I. | **Neither** do I. |
| Gap oxirida | I do, **too**. | I don't, **either**. |

## Keng tarqalgan xatolar
- ❌ I don't like it, too. → ✅ I don't like it, **either**.
- ❌ Me either. (to'g'ri norasmiy shakl bu emas) → ✅ **Me neither**. (norasmiy javob uchun "neither" ishlatiladi)

## Mashq
1. A: I can't drive. — B: I can't drive, ___ (too/either).
2. A: She doesn't smoke. — B: He doesn't smoke, ___ (either/neither).
3. Choose correct: "I'm not tired, ___." (either/too)

topics.name: 1. Zero Conditional
topics.content:
# Zero Conditional (Nol Shart Gap)

## Ta'rif
Umumiy haqiqatlar, ilmiy faktlar va har doim to'g'ri bo'lgan qonuniyatlarni bildirish uchun ishlatiladi.

## Tuzilish formulasi
**If + Present Simple, ... Present Simple**

- **If** you **heat** ice, it **melts**. — Agar muzni qizdirsangiz, u eriydi.
- **If** you **mix** blue and yellow, you **get** green. — Agar ko'k va sariqni aralashtirsangiz, yashil rang hosil bo'ladi.

## "If" o'rniga "When" ham ishlatilishi mumkin
Zero Conditional'da "if" va "when" deyarli bir xil ma'noni beradi (chunki bu doim to'g'ri qonuniyat):
- **When** you **heat** water to 100°C, it **boils**. — Suvni 100°C gacha qizdirsangiz, u qaynaydi.

## Qachon ishlatiladi

**1. Ilmiy/tabiiy faktlar:**
- **If** the sun **goes** down, it **gets** dark. — Quyosh botsa, qorong'i tushadi.
