**2. Umumiy qoidalar/ko'rsatmalar:**
- **If** you **press** this button, the machine **stops**. — Agar bu tugmani bossangiz, mashina to'xtaydi.

**3. Odatiy natijalar:**
- **If** I **drink** coffee at night, I **can't** sleep. — Agar kechqurun qahva ichsam, uxlay olmayman.

## Muhim eslatma
Zero Conditional'da natija **har doim** to'g'ri bo'ladi — bu Kelajak yoki taxmin emas, balki qonuniyat.

## First Conditional bilan solishtirish (chalkashtirmaslik uchun)
- Zero: **If** it **rains**, the ground **gets** wet. (har doim, umumiy qonuniyat)
- First: **If** it **rains** tomorrow, we **will stay** home. (aniq bir kelajak vaziyat)

## Keng tarqalgan xatolar
- ❌ If you heat ice, it will melt. (bu Zero Conditional uchun emas, First Conditional aralashtirilgan) → ✅ If you heat ice, it **melts**.
- ❌ If it rain, plants grow. (fe'l -s olmagan) → ✅ If it **rains**, plants **grow**.

## Mashq
1. If you ___ (not water) plants, they ___ (die).
2. Ice ___ (melt) if you ___ (heat) it.
3. If people ___ (not eat), they ___ (get) hungry.

topics.name: 2. First Conditional
topics.content:
# First Conditional (Birinchi Shart Gap)

## Ta'rif
Kelajakda real, amalga oshishi mumkin bo'lgan shart va uning natijasini bildiradi.

## Tuzilish formulasi
**If + Present Simple, ... will + fe'l (bazaviy shakl)**

- **If** it **rains**, I **will stay** home. — Agar yomg'ir yog'sa, men uyda qolaman.
- **If** you **study** hard, you **will pass** the exam. — Agar qattiq o'qisangiz, imtihondan o'tasiz.

## Muhim qoida: "If" qismida hech qachon "will" ishlatilmaydi
- ❌ If it will rain, I will stay home.
- ✅ **If it rains**, I will stay home.

## Modal fe'llar bilan ham ishlatilishi mumkin (will o'rniga)
Natija qismida "will" dan tashqari boshqa modal fe'llar ham ishlatilishi mumkin:
- **If** you finish early, you **can** leave. — Agar erta tugatsangiz, ketishingiz mumkin.
- **If** she calls, you **should** answer. — Agar u qo'ng'iroq qilsa, javob berishingiz kerak.
- **If** it rains, we **might** cancel the trip. — Agar yomg'ir yog'sa, safarni bekor qilishimiz mumkin.

## Gap tartibi — ikkala variant ham to'g'ri
- **If**-qism birinchi: **If** it rains, I will stay home. (vergul bilan)
- **If**-qism ikkinchi: I will stay home **if** it rains. (vergulsiz)

## Qachon ishlatiladi
Real, ehtimoli yuqori bo'lgan kelajak shartlari uchun:
- **If** I **have** time, I **will visit** you. — Agar vaqtim bo'lsa, sizga tashrif buyuraman.
- **If** you **don't hurry**, you **will miss** the bus. — Agar shoshilmasangiz, avtobusga ulgurmaysiz.

## Zero vs First Conditional farqi
- Zero — har doim to'g'ri qonuniyat: If you heat water, it **boils**.
- First — aniq bir kelajak imkoniyati: If you heat this water, it **will boil** in 5 minutes.

## Keng tarqalgan xatolar
- ❌ If it will rain, we will stay home. → ✅ **If it rains**, we will stay home.
- ❌ If I will see her, I will tell her. → ✅ If I **see** her, I will tell her.

## Mashq
1. If you ___ (not study), you ___ (fail) the exam.
2. If she ___ (call) me, I ___ (tell) her the news.
3. We ___ (go) to the beach if the weather ___ (be) nice.

topics.name: 3. Second Conditional
topics.content:
# Second Conditional (Ikkinchi Shart Gap)

## Ta'rif
Hozirgi yoki kelajakdagi **noreal, xayoliy** vaziyatlarni bildiradi — haqiqatda bo'lmagan yoki ehtimoli juda past bo'lgan shartlar.

## Tuzilish formulasi
**If + Past Simple, ... would + fe'l (bazaviy shakl)**

- **If** I **had** a million dollars, I **would buy** a house. — Agar mening million dollarim bo'lsa, uy sotib olardim. (haqiqatda yo'q)
- **If** I **were** you, I **would apologize**. — Agar men sizning o'rningizda bo'lsam, kechirim so'rardim.

## Muhim qoida: "Were" barcha egalar bilan
Rasmiy/klassik ingliz tilida "be" fe'li bilan barcha egalar uchun **were** ishlatiladi (was emas):
- If I **were** rich... (was emas, garchi norasmiy nutqda "was" ham eshitiladi)
- If she **were** here... 

**"If I were you"** — maslahat berishning eng keng tarqalgan iborasi.

## Modal fe'llar bilan (would o'rniga)
- **If** I had more time, I **could** help you. — Agar ko'proq vaqtim bo'lsa, sizga yordam bera olardim.
- **If** she studied harder, she **might** pass. — Agar u qattiqroq o'qisa, o'tishi mumkin edi.

## Qachon ishlatiladi

**1. Xayoliy, haqiqatga zid vaziyat:**
- **If** I **could fly**, I **would travel** everywhere. — Agar uchishni bilsam, hamma joyga sayohat qilardim.

**2. Ehtimoli juda past bo'lgan kelajak:**
- **If** I **won** the lottery, I **would quit** my job. — Agar lotereyada yutsam, ishdan ketardim.

**3. Maslahat berish:**
- **If** I **were** you, I **would talk** to her. — Sening o'rningda bo'lsam, u bilan gaplashardim.

## First vs Second Conditional farqi

| First (real, mumkin) | Second (noreal, xayoliy) |
|---|---|
| If it **rains**, I **will stay** home. (haqiqatan mumkin) | If I **were** a bird, I **would fly**. (imkonsiz) |
| If I **have** money, I **will help** you. (ehtimoli bor) | If I **had** a million dollars... (haqiqatda yo'q) |

## Keng tarqalgan xatolar
- ❌ If I would have money, I would buy a car. (if qismida would ishlatilmaydi) → ✅ If I **had** money, I would buy a car.
- ❌ If I was you... (rasmiy tilda "were" to'g'ri) → ✅ If I **were** you...

## Mashq
1. If I ___ (be) rich, I ___ (travel) around the world.
2. If she ___ (know) the answer, she ___ (tell) us.
3. What ___ (you/do) if you ___ (win) the lottery?

topics.name: 4. Third Conditional
topics.content:
# Third Conditional (Uchinchi Shart Gap)

## Ta'rif
O'tmishda amalga oshmagan, **haqiqatga zid** shart va uning o'tmishdagi natijasini bildiradi — pushaymonlik yoki o'tmishni tasavvur qilish uchun ishlatiladi.

## Tuzilish formulasi
**If + Past Perfect, ... would have + fe'lning 3-shakli**

- **If** I **had studied**, I **would have passed** the exam. — Agar o'qigan bo'lsam, imtihondan o'tgan bo'lardim. (o'qimadim, o'tmadim)
- **If** she **had known**, she **would have come**. — Agar bilganida, kelgan bo'lardi. (bilmadi, kelmadi)

## Muhim tushuncha: bu o'tmish haqida, haqiqatga zid
Third Conditional har doim **o'zgarmas o'tmish** haqida — endi o'zgartirib bo'lmaydi, faqat "agar boshqacha bo'lganida edi" deb tasavvur qilinadi.

## Modal fe'llar bilan (would o'rniga)
- **If** I **had had** more time, I **could have finished**. — Agar ko'proq vaqtim bo'lganida, tugatib qo'yardim (imkoniyatim bo'lardi).
- **If** he **had listened**, he **might have understood**. — Agar u tinglaganida, tushunishi mumkin edi.

## Qachon ishlatiladi

**1. O'tmishdagi pushaymonlik:**
- **If** I **hadn't missed** the bus, I **wouldn't have been** late. — Agar avtobusga ulgurmay qolmaganimda, kech qolmagan bo'lardim.

**2. O'tmishni tasavvur qilish (nima bo'lishi mumkin edi):**
- **If** they **had won** the match, they **would have celebrated**. — Agar o'yinda g'olib chiqishganida, nishonlashgan bo'lardi.

## Second vs Third Conditional — asosiy farq

| Second (hozirgi/kelajak, noreal) | Third (o'tmish, haqiqatga zid) |
|---|---|
| If I **had** money, I **would buy** a car. (hozir yo'q) | If I **had had** money, I **would have bought** a car. (o'tmishda bo'lmagan) |

## Keng tarqalgan xatolar
- ❌ If I would have known, I would have told you. (if qismida would ishlatilmaydi) → ✅ If I **had known**, I would have told you.
- ❌ If I had went there... → ✅ If I **had gone** there...

## Mashq
1. If she ___ (study) harder, she ___ (pass) the exam.
2. If I ___ (know) about the party, I ___ (come).
3. We ___ (not miss) the flight if we ___ (leave) earlier.

topics.name: 5. Mixed Conditionals
topics.content:
# Mixed Conditionals (Aralash Shart Gaplar)

## Ta'rif
Ikki turli vaqt oralig'ini (o'tmish va hozir) bir gapda birlashtiradi — o'tmishdagi shartning hozirgi natijasini yoki hozirgi holatning o'tmishdagi natijasini bildiradi.

## Tur 1: O'tmish shart → Hozirgi natija
**If + Past Perfect, ... would + fe'l (bazaviy shakl)**

O'tmishda boshqacha bo'lganida, hozir vaziyat boshqacha bo'lar edi:
- **If** I **had studied** medicine, I **would be** a doctor now. — Agar tibbiyotni o'rgangan bo'lsam, hozir shifokor bo'lardim.
- **If** she **hadn't married** him, she **would be** happier now. — Agar u bilan turmush qurmaganida, hozir baxtliroq bo'lardi.

## Tur 2: Hozirgi holat → O'tmishdagi natija
**If + Past Simple, ... would have + fe'lning 3-shakli**

Agar hozirgi holat boshqacha bo'lganida, o'tmishda natija boshqacha bo'lar edi:
- **If** I **weren't** so busy, I **would have helped** you yesterday. — Agar shunchalik band bo'lmasam, kecha sizga yordam bergan bo'lardim.
- **If** he **didn't hate** flying, he **would have gone** with us. — Agar u uchishni yomon ko'rmasa, biz bilan borgan bo'lardi.

## Solishtirma jadval

| Tur | Shart (If) | Natija |
|---|---|---|
| O'tmish → Hozir | Past Perfect | would + bazaviy fe'l |
| Hozir → O'tmish | Past Simple | would have + 3-shakl |

## Misollar batafsil

**O'tmish → Hozir:**
- **If** I **hadn't lost** my job, I **would have** more money now. — Agar ishimni yo'qotmaganimda, hozir ko'proq pulim bo'lardi.

**Hozir → O'tmish:**
- **If** she **spoke** French, she **would have understood** the film. — Agar u fransuzcha bilsa edi, filmni tushungan bo'lardi. (u umuman fransuzcha bilmaydi — hozirgi holat)

## Nega bu muhim
Real hayotda vaqt chegaralari har doim ham to'g'ri kelavermaydi — Mixed Conditionals bu murakkab vaziyatlarni aniq ifodalash imkonini beradi.

## Keng tarqalgan xatolar
- ❌ If I had studied medicine, I would have been a doctor now. (hozirgi natija uchun "would have been" emas, "would be" kerak) → ✅ ...I **would be** a doctor now.

## Mashq
1. If I ___ (not miss) the flight, I ___ (be) in Paris right now.
2. If he ___ (be) more careful, he ___ (not break) his leg last year.

topics.name: 6. Wishes
topics.content:
# Wishes (I wish) — Istaklar

## Ta'rif
"I wish" — hozirgi, o'tmish yoki kelajakdagi vaziyatdan noroziligimizni yoki istagimizni bildirish uchun ishlatiladi ("...sa edi" ma'nosida).

## 1. Hozirgi vaziyat haqida afsus: I wish + Past Simple
Hozirgi vaziyat boshqacha bo'lishini xohlaganda:
- I **wish** I **had** more money. — Ko'proq pulim bo'lsa edi. (hozir yo'q)
- I **wish** I **knew** the answer. — Javobni bilsam edi. (hozir bilmayman)
- I **wish** she **were** here. — U shu yerda bo'lsa edi. ("were" — barcha egalar bilan, rasmiy)

## 2. O'tmish haqida afsus: I wish + Past Perfect
O'tmishda boshqacha bo'lishini xohlaganda (pushaymonlik):
- I **wish** I **had studied** harder. — Qattiqroq o'qigan bo'lsam edi. (o'qimadim)
- I **wish** I **hadn't said** that. — Buni aytmagan bo'lsam edi. (aytdim, pushaymonman)

## 3. Vaziyatdan norozilik/o'zgarish istagi: I wish + would
Boshqa birovning xatti-harakatidan norozi bo'lganda, o'zgarishni xohlaganda:
- I **wish** you **would stop** smoking. — Chekishni to'xtatsangiz edi. (norozilik)
- I **wish** it **would stop** raining. — Yomg'ir to'xtasa edi.

Eslatma: "I wish + would" o'zimiz haqimizda ishlatilmaydi, faqat boshqalar yoki vaziyat haqida.

## If only — "I wish" ning kuchliroq versiyasi
"If only" xuddi "I wish" bilan bir xil qoidalarga bo'ysunadi, lekin his-tuyg'u kuchliroq:
- **If only** I **had listened** to you! — Sizni tinglaganimda edi!

## Solishtirma jadval

| Vaqt | Tuzilma | Misol |
|---|---|---|
| Hozirgi | wish + Past Simple | I wish I **were** taller. |
| O'tmish | wish + Past Perfect | I wish I **had gone**. |
| Norozilik/o'zgarish | wish + would | I wish you **would listen**. |

## Keng tarqalgan xatolar
- ❌ I wish I have more time. → ✅ I wish I **had** more time.
- ❌ I wish I would know the answer. (o'z holati uchun "would" ishlatilmaydi) → ✅ I wish I **knew** the answer.
- ❌ I wish I have studied harder. → ✅ I wish I **had studied** harder.

## Mashq
1. I wish I ___ (be) taller.
2. I wish I ___ (not eat) so much yesterday.
3. I wish you ___ (stop) interrupting me.

topics.name: 1. Passive Formation
topics.content:
# Passive Formation (Be + V3)

## Ta'rif
Majhul nisbat (Passive Voice) — harakatni bajaruvchiga emas, balki harakat **qaratilgan narsaga/shaxsga** urg'u berish uchun ishlatiladi.

## Tuzilish formulasi
**be (mos zamonda) + fe'lning 3-shakli (Past Participle)**

## Active vs Passive — solishtirish
- Active: **Tom wrote** the letter. — Tom xatni yozdi. (kim yozgani muhim)
- Passive: The letter **was written** (by Tom). — Xat yozildi. (nima bo'lgani muhim)

## Zamonlar bo'yicha Passive shakllari

| Zamon | Passive tuzilma | Misol |
|---|---|---|
| Present Simple | am/is/are + V3 | The house **is cleaned** every week. |
| Past Simple | was/were + V3 | The house **was cleaned** yesterday. |
| Present Continuous | am/is/are being + V3 | The house **is being cleaned** now. |
| Past Continuous | was/were being + V3 | The house **was being cleaned** then. |
| Present Perfect | have/has been + V3 | The house **has been cleaned**. |
| Past Perfect | had been + V3 | The house **had been cleaned**. |
| Future Simple | will be + V3 | The house **will be cleaned**. |
| Modal fe'llar | modal + be + V3 | The house **must be cleaned**. |

## Passive'ga o'tkazish qadamlari
1. Active gapdagi **obyektni** — passive gapning **egasi** qiling
2. Fe'lni **be + V3** shakliga o'zgartiring (zamonni saqlab qolib)
3. Active gapdagi ega — "**by**" bilan oxiriga qo'shiladi (agar kerak bo'lsa)

Misol: Chefs **cook** the food. → The food **is cooked** by chefs.

## Qachon Passive ishlatiladi

**1. Harakatni bajaruvchi noma'lum yoki muhim bo'lmaganda:**
- My car **was stolen**. — Mening mashinam o'g'irlandi. (kim o'g'irlagani muhim emas)

**2. Harakat natijasiga urg'u berish uchun (ilmiy, rasmiy uslubda):**
- The experiment **was conducted** carefully. — Tajriba ehtiyotkorlik bilan o'tkazildi.

**3. Bajaruvchi aniq bo'lganda ham urg'u obyektga qaratilganda:**
- The Mona Lisa **was painted** by Leonardo da Vinci.

## Keng tarqalgan xatolar
- ❌ The letter written by Tom. (be tushib qolgan) → ✅ The letter **was written** by Tom.
- ❌ The house is clean every week. (V3 emas, sifat ishlatilgan) → ✅ The house **is cleaned** every week.

## Mashq
1. English ___ (speak) in many countries.
2. The report ___ (write) by John yesterday.
3. This bridge ___ (build) in 1990.

topics.name: 2. By plus Agent
topics.content:
# By + Agent (Bajaruvchini Ko'rsatish)

## Ta'rif
Passive gaplarda harakatni kim bajarganini ko'rsatish uchun **"by"** predlogi ishlatiladi. Bu qism "agent" deb ataladi.

## Tuzilish
**Passive gap + by + bajaruvchi**

- The book **was written by** J.K. Rowling. — Kitob J.K. Rouling tomonidan yozilgan.
- The window **was broken by** the children. — Deraza bolalar tomonidan sindirilgan.

## Qachon "by + agent" ishlatiladi
Faqat bajaruvchi haqidagi ma'lumot **muhim yoki qiziqarli** bo'lganda qo'shiladi:
- The painting **was created by** a famous artist. — Rasm mashhur rassom tomonidan yaratilgan. (kim yaratgani muhim)

## Qachon "by + agent" TUSHIRIB QOLDIRILADI
Bajaruvchi **noma'lum, muhim emas yoki aniq** bo'lganda:

**1. Bajaruvchi noma'lum:**
- My phone **was stolen**. — Telefonim o'g'irlandi. (kim o'g'irlagani noma'lum)

**2. Bajaruvchi aniq (kontekstdan tushunarli):**
- He **was arrested** yesterday. — U kecha hibsga olindi. (albatta politsiya — aytish shart emas)

**3. Bajaruvchi umumiy odamlar:**
- English **is spoken** all over the world. — Ingliz tili butun dunyoda gapiriladi. (kim gapirishi aniq — odamlar)

## By vs With — farqi
- **By** — kim bajargan (shaxs/sabab): The door was opened **by** John.
- **With** — qanday vosita bilan bajargan: The door was opened **with** a key.

Misol: The letter was written **by** Anna **with** a pen. — Xat Anna tomonidan ruchka bilan yozilgan.

## Misollar
- The Eiffel Tower **was designed by** Gustave Eiffel. — Eyfel minorasi Gustav Eyfel tomonidan loyihalashtirilgan.
- Dinner **was cooked by** my mother **with** fresh vegetables.

## Keng tarqalgan xatolar
- ❌ The cake was made with my sister. (shaxs uchun "with" emas "by") → ✅ The cake was made **by** my sister.
- ❌ My bag was stolen by someone. (norasmiy, aslida "by someone" ko'pincha tushirib qoldiriladi) → tabiiyroq: My bag **was stolen**.

## Mashq
1. The bridge was built ___ (by/with) engineers.
2. The wall was painted ___ (by/with) a brush.
3. This song was written ___ Ed Sheeran.

topics.name: 3. Causative Have Something Done
topics.content:
# Causative: Have Something Done

## Ta'rif
"Have something done" tuzilmasi — biror ishni **o'zimiz emas, boshqa birov** (mutaxassis, xizmat ko'rsatuvchi) uchun bajarilishini bildiradi.

## Tuzilish formulasi
**have/get + obyekt + fe'lning 3-shakli (V3)**

- I **had my hair cut**. — Men sochimni oldirdim. (o'zim kesmadim, sartarosh kesdi)
- She **had her car repaired**. — U mashinasini ta'mirlattirdi.
- We **are having** our house **painted**. — Bizning uyimiz bo'yalyapti (mutaxassis tomonidan).

## Have vs Get — farqi
Ikkalasi ham bir xil ma'noni beradi, "get" biroz norasmiyroq:
- I **had** my phone **fixed**. = I **got** my phone **fixed**.

## Zamonlar bo'yicha ishlatilishi
- Present: I **have** my car **washed** every week.
- Past: I **had** my car **washed** yesterday.
- Future: I **will have** my car **washed** tomorrow.
- Present Perfect: I **have had** my car **washed**.

## "Have something done" vs Passive Voice — farqi
- Passive: My car **was washed**. (shunchaki ma'lumot — kim yuvgani muhim emas)
- Causative: I **had** my car **washed**. (urg'u: buni men **buyurtma qilib** qildirganman, o'zim emas)

## Salbiy vaziyatlarda ham ishlatiladi
Ba'zan nohush voqea (o'zi xohlamagan holda sodir bo'lgan) haqida ham ishlatiladi:
- She **had** her purse **stolen**. — Uning sumkasi o'g'irlandi. (o'zi xohlamagan holda)

## Misollar to'liq gapda
- I need to **have** my teeth **checked**. — Men tishlarimni tekshirtirishim kerak.
- He **had** the documents **translated**. — U hujjatlarni tarjima qildirdi.
- We should **get** the roof **fixed** before winter. — Qishdan oldin tomni ta'mirlatishimiz kerak.

## Keng tarqalgan xatolar
- ❌ I had cut my hair. (bu "men soch kesdim" degan ma'noni bildiradi, xato tuzilma) → ✅ I **had my hair cut**.
- ❌ I had my hair to cut. → ✅ I had my hair **cut**. ("to" kerak emas, V3 kerak)

## Mashq
1. She ___ (have/her nails/do) every month.
2. We ___ (get/the windows/clean) last week.
3. I need to ___ (have/this letter/translate) into English.

topics.name: 1. Reported Statements
topics.content:
# Reported Statements (Darak Gaplarni O'zlashtirish)

## Ta'rif
Boshqa birovning so'zlarini o'z so'zlarimiz bilan, to'g'ridan-to'g'ri iqtibos keltirmasdan yetkazish.

## Asosiy qoida: Tense Backshift (zamon bir qadam orqaga suriladi)

| To'g'ridan-to'g'ri nutq | O'zlashtirma gap |
|---|---|
| Present Simple → | Past Simple |
| Present Continuous → | Past Continuous |
| Present Perfect → | Past Perfect |
| Past Simple → | Past Perfect |
| will → | would |
| can → | could |
| must → | had to |

## Misollar

- "I **work** here." → He said (that) he **worked** there.
- "I **am watching** TV." → She said (that) she **was watching** TV.
- "I **have finished**." → He said (that) he **had finished**.
- "I **went** there." → She said (that) she **had gone** there.
- "I **will help** you." → He said (that) he **would help** me.

## Olmoshlar va joy/vaqt so'zlarining o'zgarishi

| To'g'ridan-to'g'ri | O'zlashtirma |
|---|---|
| I | he/she |
| my | his/her |
| this | that |
| here | there |
| now | then |
| today | that day |
| tomorrow | the next day |
| yesterday | the day before |

Misol: "I will call you **tomorrow**." → He said he would call me **the next day**.

## Say vs Tell — farqi
- **Say** — kimga aytilganini ko'rsatmaydi: He **said** (that) he was tired.
- **Tell** — kimga aytilganini ko'rsatadi (to'ldiruvchi bilan): He **told me** (that) he was tired.

Eslatma: "say to me" emas — "tell me" to'g'ri!

## Muhim eslatma: agar fakt hali ham to'g'ri bo'lsa
Agar aytilgan gap hali ham amal qiladigan haqiqat bo'lsa, zamonni o'zgartirish shart emas:
- "The Earth **is** round." → She said the Earth **is** round. (umumiy haqiqat — o'zgarmasligi ham mumkin)

## Keng tarqalgan xatolar
- ❌ He said to me that... → ✅ He **told me** that... / He **said** that...
- ❌ She said she is tired. (agar aniq o'tmish nutqi bo'lsa, backshift kerak) → ✅ She said she **was** tired.

## Mashq
1. "I am hungry." → She said ___.
2. "I will call you." → He said ___.
3. "I finished my homework." → She said ___.

topics.name: 2. Reported Questions
topics.content:
# Reported Questions (So'roq Gaplarni O'zlashtirish)

## Ta'rif
Boshqa birovning savolini bilvosita, o'z so'zlarimiz bilan yetkazish.

## Muhim qoida: SAVOL TARTIBI O'ZGARADI
O'zlashtirma savolda **savol tartibi emas, darak gap tartibi** ishlatiladi (auxiliary va ega joyini almashtirmaydi), va **so'roq belgisi (?) qo'yilmaydi**.

## Yes/No savollar: "if" yoki "whether" bilan
- "**Do** you **like** coffee?" → He asked **if/whether** I **liked** coffee.
- "**Are** you **coming**?" → She asked **if** I **was coming**.

## Wh-savollar: so'roq so'zi saqlanadi
- "**Where do** you **live**?" → He asked **where I lived**.
- "**What** is your name?" → She asked **what my name was**.
- "**Why** were you late?" → He asked **why I had been** late.

## Zamon backshift — oddiy o'zlashtirma gap kabi
Reported statements'dagi kabi, zamon bir qadam orqaga suriladi:
- "**Do** you **work** here?" → He asked if I **worked** there.
- "**Did** you **see** him?" → She asked if I **had seen** him.

## Ask so'zining tuzilishi
- **ask + if/whether** (yes/no savollar uchun)
- **ask + so'roq so'zi** (wh-savollar uchun)
- **ask + object + to + fe'l** (iltimos/buyruq uchun — keyingi mavzuda)

## Misollar to'liq

- "**Where** are you going?" → He asked me **where I was going**.
- "**Have** you **finished** your work?" → She asked **if I had finished** my work.
- "**Can** you **help** me?" → He asked **if I could help** him.

## Keng tarqalgan xatolar
- ❌ He asked where was I going. (savol tartibi noto'g'ri qoldirilgan) → ✅ He asked where **I was going**.
- ❌ She asked if did I like it. → ✅ She asked **if I liked** it.
- ❌ He asked what did she want. → ✅ He asked **what she wanted**.

## Mashq
1. "Where do you live?" → He asked me ___.
2. "Are you happy?" → She asked if ___.
3. "What time does the film start?" → He wanted to know ___.

topics.name: 3. Reported Orders
topics.content:
# Reported Orders (Buyruqlarni O'zlashtirish)

## Ta'rif
Buyruq, iltimos yoki maslahatni bilvosita yetkazish uchun ishlatiladi.

## Tuzilish formulasi
**tell/ask/order + obyekt + to + fe'l (ijobiy buyruq uchun)**
**tell/ask/order + obyekt + not to + fe'l (inkor buyruq uchun)**

## Ijobiy buyruq
- "**Close** the door." → He **told** me **to close** the door. — U menga eshikni yopishni aytdi.
- "**Sit** down." → She **told** them **to sit** down.

## Inkor buyruq
- "**Don't touch** that!" → He **told** me **not to touch** that.
- "**Don't be** late." → She **told** him **not to be** late.

## Turli fe'llar bilan (kontekstga qarab)

| Fe'l | Ma'nosi | Misol |
|---|---|---|
| tell | buyurmoq/aytmoq | He **told** me to wait. |
| order | qattiq buyurmoq | The general **ordered** them to attack. |
| ask | iltimos qilmoq | She **asked** me to help her. |
| advise | maslahat bermoq | The doctor **advised** him to rest. |
| warn | ogohlantirmoq | She **warned** us not to go there. |
| remind | eslatmoq | He **reminded** me to call her. |
| invite | taklif qilmoq | They **invited** us to join them. |

## Iltimos (so'roq shaklidagi buyruq)
- "**Could** you **close** the window, please?" → She **asked** me **to close** the window.
- "**Please help** me." → He **asked** me **to help** him.

## Muhim qoida: "Say" bilan buyruq o'zlashtirilmaydi
"Say" — buyruq uchun ishlatilmaydi, faqat "tell/ask/order" kabi fe'llar ishlatiladi:
- ❌ He said me to close the door.
- ✅ He **told** me **to close** the door.

## Misollar to'liq
- "**Don't be** afraid." → She **told** us **not to be** afraid.
- "**Please wait** here." → He **asked** me **to wait** there.
- "**Never lie** to me." → She **warned** him **never to lie** to her.

## Keng tarqalgan xatolar
- ❌ He told me close the door. ("to" tushib qolgan) → ✅ He told me **to close** the door.
- ❌ She told to me to wait. ("to" ortiqcha) → ✅ She **told me** to wait.
- ❌ He told me don't touch it. → ✅ He told me **not to touch** it.

## Mashq
1. "Close the window." → The teacher told the student ___.
2. "Don't be late!" → She warned him ___.
3. "Could you help me?" → She asked me ___.

topics.name: 1. Prefixes
topics.content:
# Prefixes (Old Qo'shimchalar)

## Ta'rif
Prefiks — so'z boshiga qo'shilib, uning ma'nosini o'zgartiradigan qo'shimcha. Ko'pincha inkor yoki qarama-qarshi ma'no beradi.

## Eng ko'p ishlatiladigan prefikslar

**Inkor ma'no beruvchi:**
| Prefiks | Ma'nosi | Misol |
|---|---|---|
| un- | -mas, -siz | happy → **un**happy |
| dis- | -mas, aksi | agree → **dis**agree |
| in- | -mas | correct → **in**correct |
| im- (p/m dan oldin) | -mas | possible → **im**possible |
| il- (l dan oldin) | -mas | legal → **il**legal |
| ir- (r dan oldin) | -mas | responsible → **ir**responsible |
| non- | -mas, yo'q | sense → **non**sense |

**Qayta/oldin ma'nosini beruvchi:**
| Prefiks | Ma'nosi | Misol |
|---|---|---|
| re- | qayta | do → **re**do, write → **re**write |
| pre- | oldin | view → **pre**view, historic → **pre**historic |
| post- | keyin | war → **post**war |

**Boshqa keng tarqalgan prefikslar:**
| Prefiks | Ma'nosi | Misol |
|---|---|---|
| mis- | noto'g'ri | understand → **mis**understand |
| over- | ortiqcha | eat → **over**eat |
| under- | yetarli emas | estimate → **under**estimate |
| super- | ustun, super | market → **super**market |
| inter- | orasida | national → **inter**national |
| co- | birgalikda | operate → **co**operate |
| anti- | qarshi | social → **anti**social |

## Misollar to'liq gapda
- She was **un**happy about the decision. — U qaror haqida noroziy edi.
- I **dis**agree with you. — Men sizga rozi emasman.
- He **mis**understood my question. — U mening savolimni noto'g'ri tushundi.
- Please **re**write this paragraph. — Iltimos, bu paragrafni qayta yozing.

## Muhim eslatma
Qaysi prefiks qaysi so'z bilan ishlatilishi qat'iy qoidaga bo'ysunmaydi — bu ko'p hollarda yodlash orqali o'rganiladi.

## Keng tarqalgan xatolar
- ❌ inpossible → ✅ **im**possible (p dan oldin im-)
- ❌ inresponsible → ✅ **ir**responsible (r dan oldin ir-)
- ❌ unlegal → ✅ **il**legal (l dan oldin il-)

## Mashq
1. She is ___ (happy — inkor qiling).
2. This information is ___ (correct — inkor qiling).
3. Please ___ (write — qayta qiling) your essay.

topics.name: 2. Suffixes
topics.content:
# Suffixes (Oxirgi Qo'shimchalar)

## Ta'rif
Suffiks — so'z oxiriga qo'shilib, ko'pincha uning **so'z turkumini** (ot, sifat, ravish) o'zgartiradi.

## Ot yasovchi suffikslar

| Suffiks | Misol |
|---|---|
| -tion/-sion | educate → educa**tion**, decide → deci**sion** |
| -ness | happy → happi**ness**, kind → kind**ness** |
| -ment | develop → develop**ment**, agree → agree**ment** |
| -er/-or | teach → teach**er**, act → act**or** |
| -ity | possible → possibil**ity** |
| -ship | friend → friend**ship** |

## Sifat yasovchi suffikslar

| Suffiks | Misol |
|---|---|
| -ful | care → care**ful**, help → help**ful** |
| -less | care → care**less**, hope → hope**less** |
| -able/-ible | comfort → comfort**able**, response → respons**ible** |
| -ous | danger → danger**ous** |
| -al | nation → nation**al** |
| -ive | create → creat**ive** |
| -y | rain → rain**y**, wind → wind**y** |

## Ravish yasovchi suffiks
| Suffiks | Misol |
|---|---|
| -ly | quick → quick**ly**, careful → careful**ly** |

## -ful vs -less — qarama-qarshi ma'no
- care**ful** — ehtiyotkor (g'amxo'rlik bilan) ↔ care**less** — beparvo (g'amxo'rliksiz)
- hope**ful** — umidli ↔ hope**less** — umidsiz

## Bir so'zdan turli suffikslar bilan turli so'z turkumlari

| Ot | Sifat | Ravish |
|---|---|---|
| care | careful/careless | carefully |
| beauty | beautiful | beautifully |
| success | successful | successfully |

## Misollar to'liq gapda
- Her kind**ness** touched everyone. — Uning mehribonligi hammani hayajonga soldi.
- This is a comfort**able** chair. — Bu qulay stul.
- He is a very care**less** driver. — U juda beparvo haydovchi.

## Keng tarqalgan xatolar
- ❌ hopeful → hopefull (ikkita l) → ✅ hope**ful** (bitta l)
- ❌ beautyful → ✅ **beautiful** (y → i o'zgaradi)

## Mashq
1. success + ful → ___
2. care + less → ___
3. develop + ment → ___

topics.name: 3. Noun Verb Adjective Conversion
topics.content:
# Noun/Verb/Adjective Conversion (So'z Turkumlari O'zgarishi)

## Ta'rif
Ba'zi ingliz so'zlari shaklini o'zgartirmasdan, turli so'z turkumi (ot, fe'l, sifat) sifatida ishlatilishi mumkin. Bu "zero derivation" yoki "conversion" deb ataladi.

## Misollar: bir xil shakl, turli vazifa

**Water — ot va fe'l:**
- I drank some **water**. (ot — suv)
- Please **water** the plants. (fe'l — sug'ormoq)

**Book — ot va fe'l:**
- I'm reading a **book**. (ot — kitob)
- I need to **book** a table. (fe'l — bron qilmoq)

**Email — ot va fe'l:**
- I got an **email**. (ot — xat)
- I'll **email** you later. (fe'l — xat yubormoq)

**Clean — sifat va fe'l:**
- The room is **clean**. (sifat — toza)
- I need to **clean** the room. (fe'l — tozalamoq)

**Empty — sifat va fe'l:**
- The bottle is **empty**. (sifat — bo'sh)
- Please **empty** the trash. (fe'l — bo'shatmoq)

## O'zgargan urg'u bilan (ot/fe'l farqi)
Ba'zi so'zlarda ot va fe'l shakli bir xil harflardan iborat, lekin **urg'u joyi** farq qiladi:

| So'z | Ot (birinchi bo'g'inga urg'u) | Fe'l (ikkinchi bo'g'inga urg'u) |
|---|---|---|
| record | RE-cord (yozuv) | re-CORD (yozib olmoq) |
| present | PRE-sent (sovg'a) | pre-SENT (taqdim etmoq) |
| increase | IN-crease (o'sish) | in-CREASE (oshmoq) |
| export | EX-port (eksport) | ex-PORT (eksport qilmoq) |

## Misollar to'liq gapda
- Can you **google** it? (ot brendidan fe'l yasalgan)
- I need to **text** you the address. (ot "text" dan fe'l yasalgan — SMS yubormoq)
- Let's **friend** each other on social media. (ot "friend"dan fe'l — do'st qo'shmoq)

## Keng tarqalgan xatolar
- ❌ I will EMAIL-ling you. (fe'l shakli buzilgan) → ✅ I will **email** you.
- ❌ noto'g'ri urg'u bilan "I want to RECORD it" (ot o'rniga) → ✅ fe'l uchun re-**CORD**, ot uchun **REC**ord

## Mashq
1. "Water" so'zini ham ot, ham fe'l sifatida gapda ishlating.
2. "Clean" so'zini ham sifat, ham fe'l sifatida gapda ishlating.
3. "Record" so'zining ot va fe'l shaklidagi urg'usini ayting.

topics.name: 1. Make vs Do
topics.content:
# Make vs Do

## Ta'rif
Ikkalasi ham "qilmoq" deb tarjima qilinishi mumkin, lekin ingliz tilida ular butunlay boshqa kontekstlarda ishlatiladi.

## Do — ish, vazifa, faoliyat (natija yaratilmaydi)
Umumiy faoliyat, vazifa, mehnat haqida gapirganda:
- **do** homework, **do** housework, **do** exercise, **do** a job, **do** business
- I need to **do** my homework. — Men uy vazifamni qilishim kerak.
- She **does** the cleaning every day. — U har kuni tozalash ishlarini qiladi.

## Make — yaratish, ishlab chiqarish (yangi narsa hosil bo'ladi)
Biror narsa yaratish, tayyorlash haqida gapirganda:
- **make** a cake, **make** a decision, **make** a mistake, **make** money, **make** a plan
- She **made** a delicious cake. — U mazali tort tayyorladi.
- I **made** a mistake. — Men xato qildim.

## Eng ko'p ishlatiladigan iboralar

**DO bilan:**
do a favor, do your best, do business, do damage, do a job, do research, do the shopping, do the dishes

**MAKE bilan:**
make a decision, make an effort, make progress, make a phone call, make friends, make an appointment, make noise, make a difference

## Solishtirma jadval

| Do | Make |
|---|---|
| do homework | make a cake |
| do the dishes | make a decision |
| do a favor | make a mistake |
| do exercise | make money |
| do business | make friends |

## Misollar to'liq gapda
- Can you **do** me a favor? — Menga xizmat qila olasizmi?
- We need to **make** a decision soon. — Tez orada qaror qabul qilishimiz kerak.
- I **did** my best, but I still **made** a mistake. — Men qo'limdan kelganini qildim, lekin baribir xato qildim.

## Keng tarqalgan xatolar
- ❌ make homework → ✅ **do** homework
- ❌ do a cake → ✅ **make** a cake
- ❌ do a mistake → ✅ **make** a mistake
- ❌ make exercise → ✅ **do** exercise

## Mashq
1. I need to ___ (make/do) my homework tonight.
2. She ___ (made/did) a huge mistake.
3. Let's ___ (make/do) a plan for the weekend.

topics.name: 2. Say vs Tell
topics.content:
# Say vs Tell

## Ta'rif
Ikkalasi ham "aytmoq" ma'nosini bildiradi, lekin grammatik tuzilishi farq qiladi.

## Say — kimga aytilgani ko'rsatilmaydi (yoki "to" bilan)
- He **said** he was tired. — U charchaganini aytdi.
- She **said** "Hello". — U "Salom" dedi.
- **Say to me** — mumkin, lekin kamdan-kam ishlatiladi va noqulay eshitiladi

## Tell — kimga aytilgani ko'rsatiladi (to'ldiruvchi bilan, "to" siz!)
- He **told me** he was tired. — U menga charchaganini aytdi.
- She **told** us a story. — U bizga hikoya aytib berdi.

**MUHIM:** Tell dan keyin to'g'ridan-to'g'ri shaxs keladi, "to" ishlatilmaydi:
- ❌ He told to me.
- ✅ He **told me**.

## Solishtirma jadval

| Say (kimga — ko'rsatilmaydi yoki to bilan) | Tell (kimga — to'g'ridan-to'g'ri) |
|---|---|
| She **said** (that) she was busy. | She **told me** (that) she was busy. |
| He **said** "I'm leaving." | He **told** her "I'm leaving." (kamroq ishlatiladi) |

## Tell bilan ishlatiladigan maxsus iboralar
tell a story, tell a lie, tell the truth, tell a joke, tell the difference, tell the time

- Can you **tell** me the time? — Menga vaqtni ayta olasizmi?
- Don't **tell** lies. — Yolg'on gapirma.
- I can't **tell** the difference. — Farqini ayta olmayman.

## Say bilan ishlatiladigan iboralar
say hello/goodbye, say a prayer, say sorry, say yes/no

- He **said** goodbye and left. — U xayrlashib, ketdi.
- She **said** sorry for being late. — U kechikkani uchun kechirim so'radi.

## Keng tarqalgan xatolar
- ❌ He said me that he was busy. → ✅ He **told me** that he was busy.
- ❌ She told that she was tired. (tell dan keyin to'ldiruvchi kerak) → ✅ She **told me** (that) she was tired. yoki She **said** (that) she was tired.
- ❌ Tell to your friend. → ✅ **Tell** your friend.

## Mashq
1. He ___ (said/told) me the truth.
2. She ___ (said/told) "Good morning" to everyone.
3. Can you ___ (say/tell) me your name?

topics.name: 3. Bring vs Take
topics.content:
# Bring vs Take

## Ta'rif
Ikkalasi ham narsani bir joydan boshqa joyga olib borish/kelish ma'nosini bildiradi, lekin **yo'nalish** (gapiruvchiga tomon yoki gapiruvchidan uzoqqa) farqlanadi.

## Bring — gapiruvchi tomon (bu yerga)
Narsa/shaxs **gapiruvchi turgan joyga** olib kelinadi:
- Please **bring** me some water. — Menga (bu yerga) suv olib kelib bering.
- Can you **bring** your friends to the party? — Do'stlaringizni ziyofatga (bu yerga) olib kelasizmi?
- I always **bring** my laptop to work. — Men doim noutbukimni ishga (bu yerga) olib kelaman.

## Take — gapiruvchidan uzoqqa (u yerga)
Narsa/shaxs **gapiruvchi turgan joydan boshqa joyga** olib boriladi:
- Please **take** this letter to the post office. — Iltimos, bu xatni pochtaga (u yerga) olib boring.
- I'll **take** my umbrella with me. — Men soyabonimni o'zim bilan (u yerga) olib boraman.
- Don't forget to **take** your keys. — Kalitlaringizni olishni unutmang.

## Eslab qolish usuli
- **Bring** — "keltirmoq" (bu yerga, gapiruvchiga tomon)
- **Take** — "olib bormoq" (u yerga, gapiruvchidan uzoqqa)

Tasavvur qiling: siz uyingizdasiz.
- Do'stingizga: "**Bring** some snacks (to my house)." — Uyimga gazak olib kel.
- O'zingiz ketayotganda: "I will **take** some snacks (to the party)." — Men ziyofatga gazak olib boraman.

## Boshqa ma'nolarda ishlatilishi

**Take** — boshqa ko'p ma'nolarda ham ishlatiladi:
- **take** a shower (dush qabul qilmoq)
- **take** a break (tanaffus qilmoq)
- **take** medicine (dori ichmoq)
- **take** a photo (surat olmoq)
- **take** time (vaqt olmoq)

## Misollar to'liq gapda
- Can you **bring** your ID card tomorrow? — Ertaga guvohnomangizni olib kela olasizmi? (bu yerga)
- She **took** her dog for a walk. — U itini sayr qildirdi (uzoqqa olib bordi).

## Keng tarqalgan xatolar
- ❌ Bring this to the store. (agar gapiruvchi do'konda bo'lmasa) → ✅ **Take** this to the store.
- ❌ Take me some water. (agar gapiruvchi shu yerda bo'lsa) → ✅ **Bring** me some water.

## Mashq
1. Please ___ (bring/take) me my glasses, they're on the table right there.
2. Don't forget to ___ (bring/take) your umbrella when you leave.
3. Can I ___ (bring/take) a friend to your party tonight?

topics.name: 4. Its vs Its Apostrophe
topics.content:
# Its vs It's

## Ta'rif
Bu ikkala so'z bir xil talaffuz qilinadi, lekin butunlay boshqa vazifani bajaradi — bu ingliz tilidagi eng ko'p uchraydigan yozma xatolardan biri.

## Its — egalik (apostrofsiz)
"Its" — narsa yoki hayvonning egalik shakli ("uning" ma'nosida), boshqa possessive determiner'lar kabi (his, her, their):
- The dog wagged **its** tail. — It dumini likillatdi.
- The company changed **its** policy. — Kompaniya o'z siyosatini o'zgartirdi.
- Every rule has **its** exception. — Har bir qoidaning o'z istisnosi bor.

## It's — qisqartma (apostrof bilan)
"It's" = "**it is**" yoki "**it has**" ning qisqartmasi:
- **It's** raining. = **It is** raining. — Yomg'ir yog'yapti.
- **It's** been a long day. = **It has** been a long day. — Uzoq kun bo'ldi.
- **It's** a beautiful day. = **It is** a beautiful day.

## Qanday farqlash mumkin (test usuli)
Gapga "it is" yoki "it has" qo'yib ko'ring — agar ma'no to'g'ri chiqsa, **it's** yozing. Agar chiqmasa, **its** yozing:
- The cat licked ___ paw. → "The cat licked it is paw"? ❌ Ma'nosiz → **its**
- ___ raining outside. → "It is raining outside"? ✅ To'g'ri → **it's**

## Boshqa possessive determiner'lar bilan solishtirish
Hech qaysi egalik olmoshi apostrof bilan yozilmaydi:
- his (o'zi apostrofsiz), her (apostrofsiz), **its** (apostrofsiz), their (apostrofsiz), our (apostrofsiz)

Bu qoidani eslab qolish uchun: "its" — "his/her" oilasiga tegishli, ular hech qachon apostrof olmaydi.

## Misollar
- **It's** important to know the difference. — Farqni bilish muhim.
- The bird built **its** nest in the tree. — Qush daraxtda o'z uyasini qurdi.
- **It's** been raining for **its** whole life... (bu yerda ikkalasi ham to'g'ri ishlatilgan — birinchisi "it has", ikkinchisi egalik)

## Keng tarqalgan xatolar
- ❌ The cat licked it's paw. → ✅ The cat licked **its** paw.
- ❌ Its raining today. → ✅ **It's** raining today.
- ❌ The company lost it's profits. → ✅ The company lost **its** profits.

## Mashq
1. ___ (Its/It's) a beautiful morning.
2. The dog wagged ___ (its/it's) tail happily.
3. ___ (Its/It's) been a while since we talked.

topics.name: 5. Affect vs Effect
topics.content:
# Affect vs Effect

## Ta'rif
Bu ikkala so'z talaffuzda o'xshash, lekin turli so'z turkumiga tegishli va turlicha ma'no bildiradi.

## Affect — FE'L (ta'sir qilmoq)
"Affect" deyarli har doim **fe'l** sifatida ishlatiladi — biror narsaga ta'sir qilish, o'zgartirish ma'nosida:
- Stress can **affect** your health. — Stress sog'lig'ingizga ta'sir qilishi mumkin.
- The weather **affected** our plans. — Ob-havo bizning rejalarimizga ta'sir qildi.
- Her words **affected** me deeply. — Uning so'zlari menga chuqur ta'sir qildi.

## Effect — OT (natija, ta'sir)
"Effect" deyarli har doim **ot** sifatida ishlatiladi — natija, oqibat ma'nosida:
- Smoking has a bad **effect** on health. — Chekish sog'liqqa yomon ta'sir qiladi.
- The medicine had no **effect**. — Dori hech qanday natija bermadi.
- Climate change has many negative **effects**. — Iqlim o'zgarishining ko'p salbiy oqibatlari bor.

## Eslab qolish usuli
- **A**ffect = **A**ction (fe'l, harakat)
- **E**ffect = **E**nd result (ot, natija)

Yoki: "The **A**ffect is the **A**ction, the **E**ffect is the **E**nd result."

## Maxsus holat: "Effect" fe'l sifatida (kamdan-kam, rasmiy)
Juda kamdan-kam holatlarda "effect" fe'l sifatida ham ishlatiladi — "amalga oshirmoq" ma'nosida (rasmiy uslub):
- The new manager **effected** several changes. — Yangi menejer bir necha o'zgarishlarni amalga oshirdi. (kamdan-kam ishlatiladi)

Kundalik nutqda bu holatni bilish shart emas — asosiy qoidaga amal qilish yetarli.

## Misollar to'liq gapda
- The new policy will **affect** thousands of workers. — Yangi siyosat minglab ishchilarga ta'sir qiladi.
- The **effect** of the policy was positive. — Siyosatning ta'siri ijobiy bo'ldi.

## Keng tarqalgan xatolar
- ❌ This will effect our plans. (fe'l o'rniga "effect" ishlatilgan) → ✅ This will **affect** our plans.
- ❌ The affect was huge. (ot o'rniga "affect" ishlatilgan) → ✅ The **effect** was huge.

## Mashq
1. Lack of sleep can ___ (affect/effect) your concentration.
2. The medicine had a positive ___ (affect/effect) on her health.
3. How did the news ___ (affect/effect) you?

topics.name: 6. Few vs A few Little vs A little
topics.content:
# Few vs A Few / Little vs A Little (Qayta Ko'rib Chiqish)

## Ta'rif
Bu mavzu Quantifiers bo'limidagi "Few vs Little" mavzusining chuqurlashtirilgan, chalkash so'zlar nuqtai nazaridan ko'rib chiqilishi — chunki bu juda ko'p xato qilinadigan joy.

## Asosiy tafovut: "a" borligi ma'noni butunlay o'zgartiradi

| Ibora | Ma'no | Hissiyot |
|---|---|---|
| **few** + ko'plik ot | deyarli yo'q | salbiy |
| **a few** + ko'plik ot | bir nechta bor | ijobiy/neytral |
| **little** + sanalmaydigan ot | deyarli yo'q | salbiy |
| **a little** + sanalmaydigan ot | biroz bor | ijobiy/neytral |

## Chuqur solishtirish misollari

- I have **few** friends. — Do'stim deyarli yo'q. (yolg'izlik, achinish hissi)
- I have **a few** friends. — Bir nechta do'stim bor. (yetarli, xotirjam)

- There's **little** hope. — Umid deyarli yo'q. (umidsizlik)
- There's **a little** hope. — Biroz umid bor. (umid bor, ijobiy)

## Kontekstda qanday ta'sir qiladi
Bir xil vaziyatni ikki xil tarzda tasvirlash mumkin — gapiruvchining munosabatiga bog'liq:
- "We have **little** time left." — Vaqtimiz deyarli qolmadi! (tashvish)
- "We have **a little** time left." — Bizda biroz vaqt bor. (xotirjam, yetarli)

## "Quite a few" — maxsus ibora
"Quite a few" — aslida **ko'p** degan ma'noni bildiradi (chalkashtiruvchi, lekin keng tarqalgan):
- **Quite a few** people came to the party. — Ziyofatga anchagina odam keldi. (ko'p degani!)

## Very few / very little — kuchaytirilgan salbiy ma'no
- **Very few** students passed. — Juda kam o'quvchi o'tdi.
- We have **very little** time. — Bizda juda oz vaqt bor.

## Keng tarqalgan xatolar
- ❌ I have few friends. (agar "bir nechta do'stim bor, yaxshi" demoqchi bo'lsangiz) → ✅ I have **a few** friends.
- ❌ Quite few people came (maqsad "ko'p odam" bo'lsa) → ✅ **Quite a few** people came.

## Mashq
1. Choose the right meaning: "She has few friends" — bu (a) ko'p do'sti bor (b) deyarli do'sti yo'q
2. I need ___ (a little/little) more time to finish this — noto'g'ri bo'lmasin, iltimos kutib turing (ijobiy ohang).
3. Unfortunately, we have ___ (little/a little) chance of winning. (salbiy ohang)

topics.name: 1. Relative Clauses
topics.content:
# Relative Clauses (Aniqlovchi Ergash Gaplar)

## Ta'rif
Otga qo'shimcha ma'lumot berish uchun ishlatiladigan ergash gap turi — who, which, that, whose, where, when kabi nisbiy olmoshlar bilan boshlanadi.

## Ikki turi

### 1. Defining Relative Clauses (Aniqlovchi — zarur ma'lumot)
Gap ma'nosi uchun **zarur** ma'lumot beradi, vergul bilan ajratilmaydi:
- The man **who called** yesterday is my uncle. — Kecha qo'ng'iroq qilgan odam mening amakim.
- I lost the book **that** you gave me. — Menga bergan kitobingni yo'qotib qo'ydim.

Bu turda **that** ishlatilishi mumkin va ko'pincha nisbiy olmosh tushirilib qoldiriladi (agar u to'ldiruvchi bo'lsa):
- The book (**that**) I bought is great. — that/which tushirilishi mumkin

### 2. Non-defining Relative Clauses (Izohli — qo'shimcha, zarur bo'lmagan ma'lumot)
Gap ma'nosi uchun **zarur bo'lmagan**, qo'shimcha ma'lumot beradi, **vergul bilan** ajratiladi:
- My mother, **who is 60**, loves gardening. — Onam, 60 yoshda, bog'dorchilikni yaxshi ko'radi.
- Paris, **which is the capital of France**, is beautiful. — Parij, Fransiyaning poytaxti, go'zal.

Bu turda **that** ISHLATILMAYDI, va olmosh tushirilib qoldirilmaydi.

## Nisbiy olmoshlar jadvali

| So'z | Ishlatilishi |
|---|---|
| who | shaxslar (ega) |
| whom | shaxslar (to'ldiruvchi, rasmiy) |
| whose | egalik |
| which | narsalar/hayvonlar |
| that | shaxslar va narsalar (defining'da) |
| where | joy |
| when | vaqt |

## Misollar
- This is the house **where** I grew up. — Bu men o'sgan uy.
- I remember the day **when** we met. — Biz uchrashgan kunni eslayman.
- The woman **whose** car was stolen called the police. — Mashinasi o'g'irlangan ayol politsiyaga qo'ng'iroq qildi.

## Keng tarqalgan xatolar
- ❌ My mother, that is 60, loves... (non-defining'da that ishlatilmaydi) → ✅ My mother, **who** is 60...
- ❌ The book which I bought it is great. (ortiqcha "it") → ✅ The book which I bought is great.

## Mashq
1. The man ___ (who/which) lives next door is a doctor.
2. My car, ___ (that/which) is very old, still works well.
3. This is the restaurant ___ (where/which) we had our first date.

topics.name: 2. Participle Clauses
topics.content:
# Participle Clauses (Qisqartirilgan Ergash Gaplar)

## Ta'rif
Ergash gaplarni qisqartirish uchun ishlatiladi — fe'lning -ing (Present Participle) yoki -ed/3-shakl (Past Participle) formasidan foydalaniladi, bu yozma nutqni ixchamroq va rasmiyroq qiladi.

## 1. -ing Participle Clause (faol ma'no)
Harakatni bajaruvchi ega bilan bog'liq, faol (active) ma'noni bildiradi:

- **Feeling** tired, she went to bed early. — Charchaganini his qilib, u erta yotdi. (= Because she felt tired...)
- **Walking** home, I saw an old friend. — Uyga qaytayotib, men eski do'stimni ko'rdim. (= While I was walking home...)
- The man **standing** by the door is my teacher. — Eshik oldida turgan odam — mening o'qituvchim. (= The man who is standing...)

## 2. -ed/3-shakl Participle Clause (majhul ma'no)
Harakat egaga nisbatan majhul (passive) ma'noni bildiradi:

- **Written** in 1990, the book became a bestseller. — 1990-yilda yozilgan bu kitob bestsellerga aylandi. (= The book, which was written in 1990...)
- **Confused** by the instructions, she asked for help. — Ko'rsatmalardan chalkashib, u yordam so'radi. (= Because she was confused...)

## Qachon ishlatiladi

**1. Ikki harakat bir vaqtda sodir bo'lganda:**
- **Smiling**, she opened the door. — Tabassum qilib, u eshikni ochdi.

**2. Sabab-natija munosabatini bildirishda:**
- **Not knowing** what to say, he remained silent. — Nima deyishni bilmay, u jim qoldi.

**3. Relative clause'ni qisqartirishda:**
- The girl **sitting** next to me is my cousin. (= who is sitting)
- The letter **sent** yesterday hasn't arrived. (= that was sent)

## Muhim qoida: Ega bir xil bo'lishi shart
Participle clause va bosh gapning egasi **bir xil shaxs/narsa** bo'lishi kerak, aks holda gap noto'g'ri chiqadi ("dangling participle" xatosi):
- ❌ **Walking** home, the rain started. (yomg'ir yurmaydi!) → ✅ **Walking** home, **I** got caught in the rain.

## Keng tarqalgan xatolar
- ❌ Written by a famous author, I read the book. (ma'no noto'g'ri — men yozilmaganman) → ✅ **Written** by a famous author, the book became popular.
- ❌ Feel tired, she went to bed. (-ing kerak) → ✅ **Feeling** tired, she went to bed.

## Mashq
1. ___ (Not know) the answer, I stayed silent.
2. The car ___ (park) outside is mine.
3. ___ (Exhaust) from the trip, they went straight to sleep.

topics.name: 1. Simple Sentences
topics.content:
# Simple Sentences (Sodda Gaplar)

## Ta'rif
Simple sentence — bitta mustaqil gapdan (independent clause) iborat bo'lib, bitta ega va bitta kesim (fe'l) bor. Eng oddiy gap turi.

## Tuzilishi
**Ega + Kesim (+ boshqa elementlar)**

- **She** **sings**. — U qo'shiq aytadi.
- **The dog** **barked** loudly. — It baland ovozda hurdi.
- **My sister and I** **went** to the market. — (birlashtirilgan ega bilan ham sodda gap bo'lishi mumkin)

## Bir nechta ega yoki kesim bilan ham "sodda" bo'lishi mumkin
Agar bog'lovchi (and, or) faqat ega yoki kesimni bog'lasa, gap hali ham **sodda** hisoblanadi (chunki faqat bitta mustaqil fikr bor):
- **Tom and Jerry** **play** together. (ikkita ega, bitta fikr — sodda gap)
- She **sang and danced** at the party. (ikkita kesim, bitta fikr — sodda gap)

## Qachon "sodda" bo'lmaydi
Agar gapda **ikkita to'liq mustaqil fikr** (ikkita ega + ikkita kesim, alohida) bo'lsa, bu endi compound yoki complex gap bo'ladi:
- ❌ Sodda emas: Tom plays football, and Jerry watches TV. (bu — compound sentence)

## Misollar
- **Birds fly.** — Qushlar uchadi.
- **I love coffee.** — Men qahvani yoqtiraman.
- **The children played happily in the garden.** — Bolalar bog'da baxtli o'ynashdi.

## Nega muhim
Sodda gaplar yozma va og'zaki nutqning asosini tashkil qiladi — ular tushunarli, aniq va ta'kidlash uchun kuchli vosita.

## Keng tarqalgan xatolar
- ❌ Because it was raining. (bu — to'liq gap emas, ergash gap qismi, mustaqil bo'la olmaydi)
- ✅ To'liq sodda gap: **It was raining.**

## Mashq (aniqlang: sodda gapmi?)
1. "The sun rose early." — sodda gapmi?
2. "She cooked and cleaned all morning." — sodda gapmi?
3. "Although tired, she finished the race." — sodda gapmi?

topics.name: 2. Compound Sentences
topics.content:
# Compound Sentences (Qo'shma Gaplar)

## Ta'rif
Compound sentence — ikki yoki undan ortiq **mustaqil (independent) gap**ning bog'lovchi yordamida birlashtirilishidan iborat. Har ikkala qism ham o'zi alohida to'liq gap bo'lishi mumkin.

## Bog'lash usullari

**1. FANBOYS bog'lovchilari bilan (vergul + bog'lovchi):**
For, And, Nor, But, Or, Yet, So

- I wanted to go, **but** I was too tired. — Bormoqchi edim, lekin juda charchagan edim.
- She studied hard, **so** she passed the exam. — U qattiq o'qidi, shuning uchun imtihondan o'tdi.
- You can call me, **or** you can send an email. — Menga qo'ng'iroq qilishingiz mumkin, yoki email yuborishingiz mumkin.

**2. Nuqtali vergul bilan (semicolon):**
- I love reading; my sister loves painting. — Men o'qishni yaxshi ko'raman; singlim rasm chizishni yaxshi ko'radi.

**3. Bog'lovchi ravish bilan (however, therefore, moreover + vergul):**
- I was tired; **however**, I finished the work. — Men charchagan edim; biroq, ishni tugatdim.

## FANBOYS ma'nolari

| Bog'lovchi | Ma'nosi |
|---|---|
| For | chunki |
| And | va |
| Nor | na... na |
| But | lekin |
| Or | yoki |
| Yet | shunga qaramay |
| So | shuning uchun |

## Muhim qoida: har ikkala qism ham TO'LIQ gap bo'lishi kerak
- ✅ **I like tea, and she likes coffee.** (ikkalasi ham to'liq gap)
- ❌ I like tea, and coffee. (bu compound emas — bu shunchaki ro'yxat)

## Comma Splice xatosi (juda keng tarqalgan!)
Ikkita mustaqil gapni faqat vergul bilan (bog'lovchisiz) bog'lash — bu grammatik xato:
- ❌ I love reading, my sister loves painting. (comma splice)
- ✅ I love reading**,** **and** my sister loves painting.
- ✅ I love reading**;** my sister loves painting.

## Keng tarqalgan xatolar
- ❌ I was tired but I finished the work. (vergul yo'q) → ✅ I was tired**,** but I finished the work.
- ❌ She is smart, she studies hard. (comma splice) → ✅ She is smart**, and** she studies hard.

## Mashq
1. To'g'ri bog'lang: "It was raining." + "We stayed home." (but/so bilan)
2. To'g'ri belgi qo'ying: "I called her___she didn't answer." (bog'lovchisiz, ; bilan)

topics.name: 3. Complex Sentences
topics.content:
# Complex Sentences (Ergashgan Qo'shma Gaplar)

## Ta'rif
Complex sentence — bitta **mustaqil gap** (independent clause) va bitta yoki undan ortiq **ergash gap** (dependent/subordinate clause)dan iborat. Ergash gap yolg'iz holda mustaqil fikr bera olmaydi.

## Tuzilishi
**Mustaqil gap + Ergash gap** (yoki aksincha)

- I stayed home **because it was raining**. — Yomg'ir yog'gani uchun men uyda qoldim.
- **Although she was tired**, she finished the race. — Charchagan bo'lsa-da, u poygani tugatdi.

## Ergash gaplarni bog'lovchilar (subordinating conjunctions)

| Turkum | Bog'lovchilar |
|---|---|
| Sabab | because, since, as |
| Vaqt | when, while, before, after, until, as soon as |
| Shart | if, unless, provided that |
| Qarama-qarshilik | although, though, even though, while |
| Maqsad | so that, in order that |

## Vergul qoidasi
- Agar ergash gap **bosh gapdan oldin** kelsa — vergul kerak:
  - **When it rains**, I stay home.
- Agar ergash gap **bosh gapdan keyin** kelsa — odatda vergul kerak EMAS:
  - I stay home **when it rains**.

## Misollar
- **Because she studied hard**, she passed the exam. — Qattiq o'qigani uchun u imtihondan o'tdi.
- I'll call you **when I arrive**. — Kelganimda sizga qo'ng'iroq qilaman.
- **If you need help**, let me know. — Agar yordam kerak bo'lsa, menga xabar bering.
- She left early **so that she wouldn't be late**. — Kech qolmaslik uchun u erta ketdi.

## Relative Clause bilan ham Complex Sentence hosil bo'ladi
- The man **who called yesterday** is my uncle. (relative clause — ergash gap)

## Ergash gap yolg'iz to'liq fikr bera olmaydi
- ❌ To'liq gap emas: "Because it was raining." (bu — ergash gap, mustaqil emas)
- ✅ To'liq: "I stayed home **because it was raining**."

## Compound vs Complex — farqi
- **Compound** — ikkita TENG mustaqil gap: I like tea, **and** she likes coffee.
- **Complex** — bitta mustaqil + bitta ergash (teng emas): I like tea **because it's healthy**.

## Keng tarqalgan xatolar
- ❌ Although she was tired. She finished the race. (ergash gap alohida gap sifatida yozilgan — xato) → ✅ **Although she was tired, she finished** the race.

## Mashq
1. Combine: "I was hungry." + "I ate a sandwich." (because bilan)
2. Combine: "She is smart." + "She studies hard." (although bilan qarama-qarshilik yasang, agar mos bo'lsa)

topics.name: 4. Compound-Complex Sentences
topics.content:
# Compound-Complex Sentences (Aralash Qo'shma Gaplar)

## Ta'rif
Eng murakkab gap turi — kamida **ikkita mustaqil gap** (independent clause) va kamida **bitta ergash gap** (dependent clause)dan iborat. Compound va Complex gaplarning xususiyatlarini birlashtiradi.

## Tuzilishi
**Mustaqil gap 1 + bog'lovchi + Mustaqil gap 2 + ergash gap**

## Misollar

- **Although it was raining**, I went for a run**, and** my dog joined me.
  — Yomg'ir yog'ayotgan bo'lsa-da, men yugurishga chiqdim, va itim ham menga qo'shildi.
  (Ergash gap: "Although it was raining" + Mustaqil gap 1: "I went for a run" + Mustaqil gap 2: "my dog joined me")

- **When she arrived**, everyone was happy**, but** the party had already started.
  — U kelganida, hamma xursand bo'ldi, lekin ziyofat allaqachon boshlangan edi.

- I called my friend **because** I needed advice**, and** she helped me immediately.
  — Maslahat kerak bo'lgani uchun do'stimga qo'ng'iroq qildim, va u darrov menga yordam berdi.

## Qismlarni ajratib ko'rish

Har bir compound-complex gapda quyidagilarni topish mumkin:
1. **Kamida 2 ta mustaqil gap** (FANBOYS yoki nuqtali vergul bilan bog'langan)
2. **Kamida 1 ta ergash gap** (subordinating conjunction bilan boshlangan)

## Nega bu gap turi muhim
Bu gap turi murakkab fikrlarni, sabab-natija va vaqt munosabatlarini bir gapda ifodalash imkonini beradi — akademik va professional yozuvda keng qo'llaniladi.

## Qadam-baqadam yasash
1. Ikkita sodda gap tanlang: "I was tired." + "I finished my work."
2. Ularni bog'lovchi bilan bog'lang: "I was tired, **but** I finished my work."
3. Ergash gap qo'shing: "**Although it was late**, I was tired, but I finished my work."

## Keng tarqalgan xatolar
- Bog'lovchilar orasida vergulni to'g'ri qo'ymaslik — har bir qismni diqqat bilan tekshirish kerak.
- ❌ Although it was late I was tired but I finished my work. (vergullar yetishmayapti) → ✅ **Although it was late**, I was tired**, but** I finished my work.

## Mashq
1. Quyidagi gaplarni birlashtirib compound-complex gap yasang: "She was nervous." + "She had practiced a lot." + "She passed the interview."
2. Yuqoridagi gapdagi mustaqil va ergash gaplarni ajratib ko'rsating.

topics.name: 1. Cleft Sentences
topics.content:
# Cleft Sentences (Bo'lingan Gaplar)

## Ta'rif
Cleft sentence — gapning bir qismiga alohida urg'u berish uchun uni ikkiga "bo'lib" qayta tuzish usuli. Ingliz tilida so'z tartibi qat'iy bo'lgani uchun, urg'u berish uchun maxsus tuzilmalar ishlatiladi.

## 1. "It is/was...that" tuzilmasi
Gapning ma'lum bir qismini ta'kidlash uchun:

Oddiy gap: **Tom** broke the window yesterday.

Urg'u bilan:
- **It was Tom** that broke the window yesterday. — Aynan Tom derazani sindirgan edi (boshqa hech kim emas).
- **It was the window** that Tom broke yesterday. — Aynan derazani Tom sindirgan edi (boshqa narsa emas).
- **It was yesterday** that Tom broke the window. — Aynan kecha Tom derazani sindirgan edi.

## 2. "What...is/was" tuzilmasi (Wh-cleft)
- **What I need** is a vacation. — Menga kerak bo'lgan narsa — bu ta'til. (oddiy: I need a vacation.)
- **What she wants** is your support. — Uning xohlagan narsasi — sizning yordamingiz.
- **What surprised me** was his honesty. — Meni hayratga solgan narsa — uning halolligi edi.

## Qachon ishlatiladi
1. Ma'lum bir ma'lumotni **ayniqsa ta'kidlash** uchun
2. Kontrast yaratish uchun (bu, boshqasi emas)
3. Yozma va rasmiy nutqda fikrni aniqroq ifodalash uchun

## Solishtirish: oddiy va cleft gap

| Oddiy gap | Cleft gap (urg'u bilan) |
|---|---|
| I like her cooking. | **What I like** is her cooking. |
| She solved the problem. | **It was she who** solved the problem. |

## Keng tarqalgan xatolar
- ❌ It was Tom who broke the window that. (ortiqcha "that") → ✅ It was Tom **who/that** broke the window.
- ❌ What I need a vacation. ("is" tushib qolgan) → ✅ What I need **is** a vacation.

## Mashq
1. Ta'kidlang: "Sarah won the competition." → It ___ won the competition.
2. Ta'kidlang: "I need more time." → What ___ is more time.

topics.name: 2. Inversion for Emphasis
topics.content:
# Inversion for Emphasis (Ta'kid uchun Teskari So'z Tartibi)

## Ta'rif
Odatda ega + fe'l tartibida bo'lgan gapda, salbiy yoki cheklovchi ravish gap boshiga chiqarilganda, **auxiliary va ega joyini almashtiradi** (savol tartibiga o'xshab) — bu adabiy, rasmiy va ta'kidlovchi uslubda ishlatiladi.

## Tuzilish formulasi
**Salbiy/cheklovchi ravish + auxiliary + ega + fe'l**

## Eng ko'p ishlatiladigan inversion iboralari

**Never:**
- **Never have I seen** such beauty. — Men hech qachon bunday go'zallikni ko'rmaganman. (oddiy: I have never seen...)

**Rarely/Seldom:**
- **Rarely does she complain**. — U kamdan-kam shikoyat qiladi.

**Not only...but also:**
- **Not only did he win**, but he also broke the record. — U nafaqat yutdi, balki rekordni ham yangiladi.

**No sooner...than:**
- **No sooner had I arrived** than it started raining. — Men kelishim bilanoq yomg'ir yog'a boshladi.

**Little:**
- **Little did she know** that he was lying. — U uning yolg'on gapirayotganini deyarli bilmasdi.

**Under no circumstances:**
- **Under no circumstances should you open** this door. — Hech qanday sharoitda bu eshikni ochmasligingiz kerak.

## Nega ishlatiladi
Bu tuzilma juda **rasmiy, adabiy va dramatik** effekt yaratadi — kundalik og'zaki nutqda kam ishlatiladi, lekin yozma tilda, nutqda va adabiyotda ta'sirchan usul hisoblanadi.

## Auxiliary fe'l qanday tanlanadi
Oddiy so'roq gap yasashdagi kabi — agar auxiliary yo'q bo'lsa, do/does/did qo'shiladi:
- She rarely **complains**. → **Rarely does she complain**.
- He had never seen it. → **Never had he seen** it.

## Keng tarqalgan xatolar
- ❌ Never I have seen that. (tartib noto'g'ri) → ✅ **Never have I seen** that.
- ❌ Rarely she complains. (auxiliary yo'q) → ✅ **Rarely does she complain**.

## Mashq
1. Rewrite with inversion: "I have never seen such a beautiful sunset." → ___
2. Rewrite with inversion: "She rarely goes out at night." → ___
3. Rewrite with inversion: "He had no sooner sat down than the phone rang." → ___

topics.name: 3. Do Does Did for Emphasis
topics.content:
# Do/Does/Did for Emphasis (Ta'kid uchun Yordamchi Fe'l)

## Ta'rif
Odatda darak gaplarda "do/does/did" ishlatilmaydi (chunki bu auxiliary faqat inkor va so'roqda kerak), lekin **ta'kidlash** uchun ijobiy gapda ham qo'shilishi mumkin.

## Tuzilish formulasi
**do/does/did + fe'l (bazaviy shakl)**

Bu yerda "do" kuchli urg'u bilan talaffuz qilinadi (yozishda ko'pincha kursiv yoki bold bilan ko'rsatiladi).

## Misollar

- I **do** like this song! — Men bu qo'shiqni chindan ham yoqtiraman! (kuchli tasdiqlash)
- She **does** work hard. — U chindan ham qattiq ishlaydi. (shubhaga qarshi ta'kid)
- He **did** call you yesterday! — U kecha sizga chindan ham qo'ng'iroq qilgan edi! (inkorga qarshi tasdiqlash)

## Qachon ishlatiladi

**1. Boshqa birovning shubhasini yoki inkorini rad etishda:**
- A: "You don't love me." — B: "I **do** love you!" — Men seni chindan ham sevaman!

**2. Kuchli his-tuyg'u yoki ta'kidni bildirishda:**
- She **does** look tired today. — U bugun chindan ham charchagandek ko'rinadi.

**3. Iltimos/buyruqni kuchaytirishda:**
- **Do** sit down. — Iltimos, o'tiring (xushmuomalik bilan ta'kidlash).
- **Do** be careful! — Iltimos, ehtiyot bo'ling!

## Zamon mosligi
"Do/does/did" gapning zamoniga mos tanlanadi, asosiy fe'l esa doim bazaviy shaklda qoladi:
- Present: I **do** understand. / She **does** understand.
- Past: He **did** finish the work. (finished emas!)

## Keng tarqalgan xatolar
- ❌ I do liked it. (fe'l bazaviy shaklda bo'lishi kerak) → ✅ I **do like** it.
- ❌ She does worked hard. → ✅ She **does work** hard.
- ❌ He did called me. → ✅ He **did call** me.

## Mashq
1. Ta'kidlang: "I like your idea." → I ___ like your idea!
2. Ta'kidlang: "She finished the report." → She ___ finish the report!
3. Ta'kidlang (buyruq): "Sit down." → ___ sit down, please.

topics.name: 1. Vocabulary Differences
topics.content:
# Vocabulary Differences (Lug'aviy Farqlar)

## Ta'rif
Britaniya va Amerika ingliz tilida bir xil narsa uchun turli so'zlar ishlatiladi. Bu farqlarni bilish tushunishni osonlashtiradi.

## Eng ko'p uchraydigan farqlar

| British English | American English | Tarjima |
|---|---|---|
| flat | apartment | kvartira |
| lift | elevator | lift |
| lorry | truck | yuk mashinasi |
| rubbish | trash/garbage | axlat |
| holiday | vacation | ta'til |
| chips | fries | qovurilgan kartoshka |
| crisps | chips | chips |
| biscuit | cookie | pechene |
| trousers | pants | shim |
| pavement | sidewalk | piyodalar yo'lkasi |
| petrol | gas/gasoline | benzin |
| autumn | fall | kuz |
| cinema | movie theater | kinoteatr |
| queue | line | navbat |
| mobile phone | cell phone | mobil telefon |
| football | soccer | futbol |
| tap | faucet | jo'mrak |
| torch | flashlight | fonar |
| postcode | zip code | pochta indeksi |
| chemist | drugstore/pharmacy | dorixona |
| jumper | sweater | sviter |

## Misollar to'liq gapda

**British:** I live in a **flat** and take the **lift** to the ground floor.
**American:** I live in an **apartment** and take the **elevator** to the ground floor.

**British:** Can you put the **rubbish** in the bin?
**American:** Can you put the **trash** in the can?

## Nega bu muhim
Ikkala variant ham to'g'ri va tushunarli — lekin qaysi davlatda (Britaniya, AQSh, Avstraliya va h.k.) bo'lsangiz, o'sha yerning so'zlaridan foydalanish tabiiyroq eshitiladi. Imtihonlarda (IELTS — British, TOEFL — American) mos lug'atdan foydalanish tavsiya etiladi.

## Keng tarqalgan xatolar
Ikkala variantni bir matnda aralashtirib yuborish — bu izchil emas ko'rinadi:
- ❌ I put my mobile phone in my pants pocket. (mobile — British, pants — American — aralash)
- ✅ Izchil: I put my **cell phone** in my **pants** pocket. (American) yoki I put my **mobile phone** in my **trousers** pocket. (British)

## Mashq
1. British so'zni Amerikacha ekvivalentiga o'girish: "biscuit" → ___
2. American so'zni Britaniyachaga o'girish: "vacation" → ___
3. "I need to buy new trousers." — bu British yoki American?

topics.name: 2. Spelling Differences
topics.content:
# Spelling Differences (Imlo Farqlari)

## Ta'rif
Ba'zi so'zlar Britaniya va Amerika ingliz tilida bir xil talaffuz qilinadi, lekin yozilishi farq qiladi.

## Asosiy imlo farqlari

**-our (British) vs -or (American):**
| British | American |
|---|---|
| col**our** | col**or** |
| favour**ite** | favor**ite** |
| honour | honor |
| neighbour | neighbor |

**-re (British) vs -er (American):**
| British | American |
|---|---|
| cent**re** | cent**er** |
| theat**re** | theat**er** |
| met**re** | met**er** |

**-ise (British) vs -ize (American):**
| British | American |
|---|---|
| organ**ise** | organ**ize** |
| real**ise** | real**ize** |
| recogn**ise** | recogn**ize** |

**-yse (British) vs -yze (American):**
| British | American |
|---|---|
| anal**yse** | anal**yze** |

**Undosh harf ikkilanishi:**
| British | American |
|---|---|
| trave**ll**ing | trave**l**ing |
| cance**ll**ed | cance**l**ed |

**Boshqa farqlar:**
| British | American |
|---|---|
| gr**ey** | gr**ay** |
| defen**ce** | defen**se** |
| licen**ce** (ot) | licen**se** |
| catalo**gue** | catalo**g** |
| programme | program |

## Misollar to'liq gapda
- British: I **realised** my **favourite colour** was **grey**.
- American: I **realized** my **favorite color** was **gray**.

## Nega bu muhim
Yozma matnda **izchillik** muhim — bitta matn ichida bir xil imlo tizimidan (British YOKI American) foydalanish kerak, ikkalasini aralashtirmaslik lozim.

## Qaysi birini tanlash kerak
- Britaniya, Hindiston, Avstraliya, ko'pchilik Sharqiy hamdo'stlik davlatlari — **British** imlo
- AQSh, ko'p hollarda Kanada — **American** imlo
- IELTS imtihonida — ikkalasi ham qabul qilinadi, lekin izchil bo'lish shart

## Keng tarqalgan xatolar
- ❌ colour va organize'ni bir matnda aralashtirish (izchil emas)
- ❌ centre (British) va color (American) — aralash yozish

## Mashq
1. "color" so'zini British imlosida yozing.
2. "organise" so'zini American imlosida yozing.
3. "theatre" so'zini American imlosida yozing.

topics.name: 3. Grammar Differences
topics.content:
# Grammar Differences (Grammatik Farqlar)

## Ta'rif
Lug'at va imlodan tashqari, Britaniya va Amerika ingliz tilida ba'zi grammatik qoidalar ham farq qiladi.

## 1. Present Perfect vs Past Simple
**British** — "yet, already, just" bilan Present Perfect ko'proq ishlatiladi:
- I**'ve just finished** my homework. (British, ustunlik)

**American** — xuddi shu vaziyatda Past Simple ham keng qo'llaniladi:
- I **just finished** my homework. (American, ham qabul qilinadi)

## 2. Have got vs Have
**British** — "have got" egalikni bildirish uchun keng ishlatiladi:
- I**'ve got** a car. (British)

**American** — oddiy "have" ko'proq ishlatiladi:
- I **have** a car. (American, ustunlik)

## 3. Collective nouns (jamoaviy otlar) — birlik/ko'plik fe'l
**British** — jamoaviy otlar (team, family, government) ko'pincha **ko'plik** fe'l bilan keladi (guruh a'zolariga urg'u):
- The team **are** playing well. (British)

**American** — jamoaviy otlar odatda **birlik** fe'l bilan keladi (guruh yagona birlik sifatida):
- The team **is** playing well. (American)

## 4. Past Simple vs Past Participle (ba'zi noto'g'ri fe'llar)
| Fe'l | British | American |
|---|---|---|
| learn | learn**t** | learn**ed** |
| burn | burn**t** | burn**ed** |
| dream | dream**t** | dream**ed** |
| get (3-shakl) | got | **gotten** |

Misol: I have **gotten** better at English. (American) / I have **got** better at English. (British)

## 5. Predloglar bilan farqlar
| British | American |
|---|---|
| at the weekend | **on** the weekend |
| different **from/to** | different **from/than** |
| write **to** someone | write someone (predlogsiz ham bo'ladi) |

## 6. "Shall" ishlatilishi
**British** — "shall" birinchi shaxs bilan hali ham ishlatiladi (rasmiy/taklif uchun):
- **Shall** we go? (British, keng tarqalgan)

**American** — "shall" kamdan-kam ishlatiladi, o'rniga "will/should":
- **Should** we go? (American, tabiiyroq)

## Keng tarqalgan xatolar
Bu ikkalasi ham "to'g'ri" — xato emas, lekin bitta matn ichida ikkala uslubni aralashtirish tavsiya etilmaydi.

## Mashq
1. "The team ___ (is/are) winning." — qaysi biri British, qaysi biri American?
2. British uslubda yozing: "I have a new phone." → I've ___ a new phone.
3. American uslubda: "I have got better." → I have ___ better.

topics.name: 1. Common Idioms
topics.content:
# Common Idioms (Keng Tarqalgan Idiomalar)

## Ta'rif
Idioma — so'zma-so'z tarjima qilinganda ma'nosiz bo'lgan, lekin majoziy ma'noga ega bo'lgan barqaror ibora. Idiomalarni yaxlit birlik sifatida yodlash kerak.

## Eng ko'p ishlatiladigan idiomalar

**Break the ice** — muzni buzmoq (noqulaylikni yo'qotish, suhbatni boshlash)
- He told a joke to **break the ice** at the meeting.

**Piece of cake** — juda oson
- The exam was a **piece of cake**. — Imtihon juda oson edi.

**Under the weather** — o'zini yomon his qilmoq (kasal)
- I'm feeling a bit **under the weather** today.

**Cost an arm and a leg** — juda qimmat turmoq
- This car **cost an arm and a leg**.

**Hit the sack** — uxlashga yotmoq
- I'm tired, I'm going to **hit the sack**.

**Once in a blue moon** — juda kamdan-kam
- He visits us **once in a blue moon**.

**Let the cat out of the bag** — sirni oshkor qilmoq
- She **let the cat out of the bag** about the surprise party.

**Speak of the devil** — "og'zidan gap uchiriladi" (birov haqida gapirilayotganda o'sha kishi paydo bo'lganda aytiladi)
- **Speak of the devil**, here comes John now!

**Hit the nail on the head** — aynan to'g'ri topmoq
- You **hit the nail on the head** with that comment.

**Bite the bullet** — qiyin vaziyatga dosh bermoq
- I have to **bite the bullet** and finish this project.

**On the fence** — ikkilanish, qaror qila olmaslik
- I'm still **on the fence** about the new job offer.

**Cut corners** — arzon/tez, lekin sifatsiz bajarish
- Don't **cut corners** when it comes to safety.

## Idiomalarni o'rganish maslahati
Idiomalarni alohida so'zlar sifatida emas, balki **kontekst bilan birga**, jumlalarda o'rganish eng samarali usul.

## Keng tarqalgan xato
So'zma-so'z tarjima qilishga urinish — bu ko'pincha ma'nosiz bo'ladi. Idiomalarni har doim **butun ibora** sifatida yodlash kerak.

## Mashq
1. "The test was ___ (a piece of cake/an arm and a leg)." — juda oson ma'nosida to'g'ri idiomani tanlang.
2. "I need to ___ (hit the sack/break the ice) — I'm exhausted."
3. "She accidentally ___ (let the cat out of the bag/bit the bullet) about the surprise."

topics.name: 2. Collocations
topics.content:
# Collocations (So'z Birikmalari)

## Ta'rif
Kollokatsiya — ma'lum so'zlarning tabiiy ravishda birga ishlatilishi. Ba'zi so'zlar grammatik jihatdan to'g'ri bo'lsa-da, ingliz tilida "tabiiy" eshitilmaydi — ona tilida so'zlashuvchilar muayyan so'z birikmalarini ishlatishga odatlangan.

## Fe'l + Ot kollokatsiyalari

| To'g'ri kollokatsiya | Noto'g'ri (tabiiy emas) |
|---|---|
| **make** a decision | ~~do a decision~~ |
| **make** a mistake | ~~do a mistake~~ |
| **do** homework | ~~make homework~~ |
| **take** a photo | ~~make a photo~~ |
| **have** a shower | ~~take a shower⁴~~ (aslida bu ham to'g'ri, American variant) |
| **catch** a cold | ~~take a cold~~ |
| **pay** attention | ~~give attention~~ |
| **keep** a promise | ~~hold a promise~~ |

## Sifat + Ot kollokatsiyalari

- **heavy** rain (og'ir yomg'ir emas — "kuchli yomg'ir")
- **strong** coffee (kuchli qahva) — ~~powerful coffee~~ emas
- **fast** food (tez ovqat) — ~~quick food~~ emas
- **major** problem (jiddiy muammo)
- **deep** sleep (chuqur uyqu)

## Ravish + Sifat kollokatsiyalari
- **deeply** disappointed — chuqur hafsalasi pir bo'lgan
- **highly** unlikely — juda ehtimoldan yiroq
- **fully** aware — to'liq xabardor
- **bitterly** disappointed — qattiq xafa bo'lgan

## Fe'l + Predlog kollokatsiyalari
- **depend on** — bog'liq bo'lmoq
- **rely on** — ishonmoq
- **consist of** — tashkil topmoq
- **succeed in** — muvaffaqiyat qozonmoq
- **apologize for** — kechirim so'ramoq

## Misollar to'liq gapda
- She **made** a big decision yesterday. — U kecha katta qaror qabul qildi.
- It's **raining heavily** outside. — Tashqarida kuchli yomg'ir yog'yapti.
- I **strongly** recommend this book. — Men bu kitobni qattiq tavsiya qilaman.
- Success **depends on** hard work. — Muvaffaqiyat mehnatga bog'liq.

## Nega kollokatsiyalar muhim
To'g'ri kollokatsiyalarni bilish nutqni **tabiiy va ona tiliga yaqin** qiladi — grammatik jihatdan to'g'ri bo'lsa-da, noto'g'ri kollokatsiya ishlatilsa, nutq "sun'iy" eshitiladi.

## Keng tarqalgan xatolar
- ❌ do a decision → ✅ **make** a decision
- ❌ do a mistake → ✅ **make** a mistake
- ❌ powerful rain → ✅ **heavy** rain

## Mashq
1. "I need to ___ (make/do) a phone call."
2. "It's ___ (strong/heavy) traffic today."
3. "Success ___ (depends on/depends of) effort."

topics.name: 0.1. Python nima, tarixi va o'rnatish
topics.content:
# Python nima, tarixi va o'rnatish

## Bu darsda nimalarni o'rganasiz

- Python nima ekanini va uni qayerda ishlatilishini tushuntira olasiz
- Joriy Python versiyalarini va ular orasidagi farqni bilasiz
- Python'ni kompyuteringizga to'g'ri o'rnata olasiz
- Virtual muhit (`venv`) yaratish nima uchun kerakligini tushuntira olasiz

## Nazariy qism

### Python nima va nega mashhur

**Python** — Guido van Rossum tomonidan 1991-yilda yaratilgan, oddiy va o'qilishi oson sintaksisga ega, umumiy maqsadli dasturlash tili. Python'ning asosiy falsafasi — kod **inson uchun o'qilishi oson** bo'lishi kerak, hatto bu ba'zan bir oz ko'proq belgi yozishni talab qilsa ham (masalan, boshqa tillardagi `{}` o'rniga Python'da qatorlar chekinishi — indentatsiya — orqali bloklarni belgilaydi).

Python bugungi kunda quyidagi sohalarda keng qo'llaniladi: veb-dasturlash (Django, FastAPI, Flask), ma'lumotlar tahlili va sun'iy intellekt (Pandas, NumPy, PyTorch, TensorFlow), avtomatlashtirish va skriptlar, Telegram botlar (Aiogram), va ilmiy hisob-kitoblar. Aynan shu ko'p qirralilik — Python'ning dunyoda eng ko'p o'rganiladigan tillardan biriga aylanishining asosiy sababi.

### Versiyalar haqida — nima tanlash kerak

Hozirgi kunda ikkita asosiy versiya keng qo'llaniladi: **Python 3.14** (2025-yil oktabrda chiqqan, eng so'nggi) va **Python 3.13** (hali ham ko'p loyihada barqaror ishlatiladi). Bu kursda **Python 3.12+** sintaksisi asos qilib olinadi — bu yerda o'rgatiladigan deyarli barcha narsa 3.10 va undan yuqori versiyalarda ishlaydi, faqat ba'zi eng yangi imkoniyatlar (masalan, 6-bobda ko'rilgan ba'zi tur maslahatlari sintaksisi) 3.12+ talab qilishi mumkin — bunday joylarda alohida eslatib o'tiladi.

> ⚠️ **Python 2 — butunlay eskirgan.** 2020-yildan beri rasmiy qo'llab-quvvatlash to'xtatilgan. Agar internetdan `print "salom"` (qavssiz `print`) kabi kod ko'rsangiz — bu Python 2, uni hech qachon ishlatmang.

### O'rnatish (Ubuntu)

_Ushbu kursdagi barcha terminal buyruqlari **Ubuntu** (va boshqa Debian-asosidagi distributivlar) uchun moslashtirilgan — chunki ko'pchilik server va development muhitlarida aynan shu tizim ishlatiladi._

Ubuntu'da odatda Python 3 tizim bilan birga allaqachon o'rnatilgan bo'ladi, lekin `pip` va `venv` modullari alohida paket sifatida qo'shilishi kerak bo'lishi mumkin:

```bash
sudo apt update
sudo apt install python3 python3-pip python3-venv -y
```

O'rnatishni tekshirish:

```bash
python3 --version
# Python 3.12.x  (yoki tizimingizdagi versiya)
```

> ⚠️ **Muhim: Ubuntu'da `python` emas, `python3`.** Ko'pchilik Ubuntu versiyasida `python` buyrug'i mavjud emas — faqat `python3` ishlaydi (bu ataylab shunday qilingan, chunki eski Python 2 bilan chalkashmaslik uchun). Xuddi shunday, paket o'rnatish uchun ham `pip3` ishlatiladi. Ushbu kursda barcha misollarda **`python3`** va **`pip3`** ishlatiladi — agar boshqa manbada oddiy `python`/`pip` ko'rsangiz, bilingki bu ko'pincha Windows yoki virtual muhit faollashtirilgan holat uchun yozilgan (virtual muhit ichida `python` va `python3` odatda bir xil narsaga ishora qiladi).

Agar eng so'nggi Python versiyasini (masalan, 3.13 yoki 3.14) rasmiy Ubuntu repozitoriyasida topa olmasangiz, `deadsnakes` PPA orqali qo'shish mumkin:

```bash
sudo add-apt-repository ppa:deadsnakes/ppa
sudo apt update
sudo apt install python3.13 python3.13-venv -y
```

### IDE (kod yozish muhiti) tanlash va o'rnatish

Yangi boshlovchi uchun eng ko'p tavsiya etiladigan ikkita variant: **VS Code** (bepul, yengil, Python kengaytmasi bilan) va **PyCharm** (Python uchun maxsus yaratilgan, ko'proq imkoniyatli, Community nashri bepul). Ikkalasi ham to'liq professional darajada ishlatilishi mumkin — tanlov shaxsiy did masalasi. Ubuntu'da ikkalasini ham `snap` orqali oson o'rnatish mumkin:

```bash
sudo snap install code --classic          # VS Code
sudo snap install pycharm-community --classic   # PyCharm Community
```

VS Code o'rnatilgach, ichida **Python** kengaytmasini (Microsoft tomonidan) o'rnatishni unutmang — bu sintaksis bo'yash, avtomatik to'ldirish va debug qilish imkoniyatlarini beradi.

### Virtual muhit (venv) — nega loyihaning boshidanoq kerak

Agar barcha loyihalaringiz uchun kutubxonalarni kompyuterga "global" o'rnatsangiz, bir loyihangiz `django==4.2` talab qilsa, ikkinchisi `django==5.2` — ular to'qnashadi. **Virtual muhit** har bir loyiha uchun alohida, izolyatsiya qilingan Python muhiti yaratadi:

```bash
python3 -m venv venv         # "venv" nomli virtual muhit yaratish
source venv/bin/activate     # faollashtirish (Ubuntu/Linux)
```

Faollashtirilgandan so'ng, muhit ichida oddiy `python` va `pip` buyruqlari ham ishlaydi (ular avtomatik `python3`/`pip3`ga ishora qiladi) — shuning uchun `venv` faollashtirilgan holatda ko'p qo'llanmalarda oddiy `python`/`pip` ko'rishingiz mumkin, bu xato emas.

Faollashtirilgan muhitda terminalda odatda `(venv)` yozuvi paydo bo'ladi — bu hozir aynan shu izolyatsiya qilingan muhitda ishlayotganingizni bildiradi. Bu tushuncha — butun kurs davomida, ayniqsa 3-bobda kutubxonalar o'rnatishni boshlaganda, doimiy ishlatiladi.

## Amaliy misol

O'rnatishdan tortib, birinchi tekshiruvgacha to'liq ketma-ketlik:

```bash
# 1. Versiyani tekshirish
python3 --version
# Python 3.13.2

# 2. Loyiha papkasi va virtual muhit yaratish
mkdir mening_birinchi_loyiham
cd mening_birinchi_loyiham
python3 -m venv venv
source venv/bin/activate     # (venv) terminalda paydo bo'ladi

# 3. pip (paket o'rnatuvchi) versiyasini tekshirish
pip --version
# pip 24.x from ... (python 3.13)

# 4. Muhitni o'chirish (kerak bo'lganda)
deactivate
```

Bu bosqichdan so'ng, kompyuteringiz Python kodini yozish va ishga tushirishga to'liq tayyor.

## Keng tarqalgan xatolar

**Xato 1:** `python3-venv` paketini o'rnatmasdan turib `venv` yaratishga urinish.
❌ `python3 -m venv venv` buyrug'i `Error: Command '['.../venv/bin/python3', ...]' returned non-zero exit status 1` yoki `ensurepip is not available` kabi xato beradi, chunki Ubuntu'da `venv` moduli asosiy `python3` paketidan **alohida** paket sifatida tarqatiladi.
✅ To'g'ri: `sudo apt install python3-venv -y` orqali kerakli paketni o'rnating, so'ng `python3 -m venv venv`ni qayta ishga tushiring.

**Xato 2:** virtual muhitni faollashtirmasdan kutubxona o'rnatishga urinish.
❌ `pip install django` — bu holda Django kompyuterning **global** Python muhitiga o'rnatiladi, boshqa loyihalar bilan versiya to'qnashuvi ehtimoli oshadi.
✅ To'g'ri: har doim avval `source venv/bin/activate`, terminalda `(venv)` yozuvini ko'rgach, keyingina `pip install` qiling.

**Xato 3:** eski, internetdan topilgan Python 2 kodini (masalan, `print "salom"`) ishlatishga urinish.
❌ Python 3'da bu `SyntaxError` beradi, chunki `print` Python 3'da funksiya (`print("salom")`), Python 2'dagidek buyruq (statement) emas.
✅ To'g'ri: har doim Python 3 sintaksisiga (`print(...)`, qavs bilan) amal qiling — bu butun kurs davomida ishlatiladigan yagona standart.

## Mashq/topshiriq

**(Oson)** Python'ni kompyuteringizga o'rnating (agar hali o'rnatilmagan bo'lsa) va `python3 --version` buyrug'i orqali versiyani tekshiring, natijani yozib qo'ying.
